```tsx
interface TactileKeycapButtonProps {
  label: string;
  badge?: string;
  active?: boolean;
  rivalActive?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
  ariaLabel: string;
  onPressChange?: (pressed: boolean) => void;
  onClick?: () => void;
}

function TactileKeycapButton({
  label,
  badge,
  active = false,
  rivalActive = false,
  title,
  className = '',
  ariaLabel,
  onPressChange,
  onClick,
}: TactileKeycapButtonProps) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      title={title}
      onClick={onClick}
      onPointerDown={
        onPressChange
          ? (e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              onPressChange(true);
            }
          : undefined
      }
      onPointerUp={onPressChange ? () => onPressChange(false) : undefined}
      onPointerCancel={onPressChange ? () => onPressChange(false) : undefined}
      onPointerLeave={onPressChange ? () => onPressChange(false) : undefined}
      className={`h-[29px] rounded-[7px] border-2 border-[#111111] font-black text-[11px] leading-none flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 select-none cursor-pointer transition-all duration-75 ${
        active
          ? 'bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111] translate-y-[1.5px] shadow-[0_1px_0_#111111]'
          : rivalActive
            ? 'bg-[#E6F9FF] text-[#111111] ring-2 ring-[#4CC9F0] -translate-y-[0.5px] shadow-[0_3px_0_#111111]'
            : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFF8DF] text-[#111111] -translate-y-[0.5px] shadow-[0_3px_0_#111111] active:bg-[#FFE74C] active:translate-y-[1.5px] active:shadow-[0_1px_0_#111111]'
      } ${className}`}
    >
      <span>{label}</span>
      {badge && (
        <span className="w-[14px] h-[14px] rounded-full bg-[#E63B2E] text-white border border-[#111111] text-[8.5px] font-black flex items-center justify-center leading-none shrink-0">
          {badge}
        </span>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

/**
 * Unified 590px Console Control Deck:
 * Harmonizes the live 144x58 3D Console Controller on the left with height-matched
 * 3D mechanical keycap modules on the right that physically depress and illuminate at 60Hz,
 * plus Stage 11 Rival Input-Diff glow and Stage 14 Practice Save-Pin controls.
 */
export function ConsoleControlDeck({
  consoleSystem = 'nes',
  visualInputMask,
  rivalInputMask = 0,
  isCelesteCourse = true,
  gamepadConnected = false,
  gamepadBrand = null,
  gamepadLabel = null,
  practicePinActive = false,
  onPadInput,
  onRetry,
  onDropPracticePin,
  onWarpPracticePin,
}: {
  consoleSystem?: ConsoleSystemId;
  visualInputMask: number;
  rivalInputMask?: number;
  isCelesteCourse?: boolean;
  gamepadConnected?: boolean;
  gamepadBrand?: string | null;
  gamepadLabel?: string | null;
  practicePinActive?: boolean;
  onPadInput?: (button: string, pressed: boolean) => void;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  onDropPracticePin?: () => void;
  onWarpPracticePin?: () => void;
}) {
  const up = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_UP) !== 0;
  const left = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_LEFT) !== 0;
  const right = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_RIGHT) !== 0;
  const bBtn = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_B) !== 0;
  const aBtn = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_A) !== 0;

  const rivalUp = (rivalInputMask & NES_INPUT_UP) !== 0;
  const rivalLeft = (rivalInputMask & NES_INPUT_LEFT) !== 0;
  const rivalRight = (rivalInputMask & NES_INPUT_RIGHT) !== 0;
  const rivalB = (rivalInputMask & NES_INPUT_B) !== 0;
  const rivalA = (rivalInputMask & NES_INPUT_A) !== 0;

  return (
    <section
      aria-label="Controller and Keyboard Controls Deck"
      className="hidden sm:flex w-full mt-[12px] bg-[#EFE6CE] border-[3.5px] border-[#111111] rounded-2xl px-3 lg:px-4 py-2 shadow-[inset_0_2px_0_#FFFDF7,inset_0_-4px_0_#D8CEB4,4px_5px_0px_#111111] items-center justify-between gap-2.5 lg:gap-3.5"
    >
      {/* Left Dock: Live 60Hz 3D Console Controller */}
      <div className="relative shrink-0">
        <MiniConsoleController
          consoleSystem={consoleSystem}
          visualInputMask={visualInputMask}
          onPadInput={onPadInput}
        />
        {gamepadConnected && (
          <span
            aria-label="Hardware Controller Connected"
            title={
              gamepadLabel
                ? `${gamepadLabel} Connected — Stick/D-Pad: Move • A: Jump • X/B: Dash • LB/RB: Switch Segment • Select: Retry`
                : 'USB / Bluetooth Gamepad Connected'
            }
            className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 bg-[#7FD1AE] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-black uppercase leading-none shadow-[1px_1px_0_#111111] flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <span className="inline-block w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#111111] animate-pulse" />
            <span>{gamepadBrand || 'PAD'}</span>
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Recessed Console Deck Seam */}
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="w-[2px] h-11 bg-[#111111]/15 rounded-full shrink-0" />

      {/* Right Zone: Live-Reactive 3D Mechanical Keycap Modules + Practice Pin */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex items-center justify-around gap-1.5 lg:gap-2">
        {/* 1. RUN / MOVE (Left & Right Arrows) */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <TactileKeycapButton
              label="←"
              active={left}
              rivalActive={rivalLeft}
              ariaLabel="Move Left (Left Arrow)"
              className="w-[28px]"
              onPressChange={onPadInput ? (p) => onPadInput('left', p) : undefined}
            />
            <TactileKeycapButton
              label="→"
              active={right}
              rivalActive={rivalRight}
              ariaLabel="Move Right (Right Arrow)"
              className="w-[28px]"
              onPressChange={onPadInput ? (p) => onPadInput('right', p) : undefined}
            />
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#111111]/85 leading-none">
            {isCelesteCourse ? 'RUN' : 'MOVE'}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* 2. CLIMB / UP (Up Arrow) */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
          <TactileKeycapButton
            label="↑"
            active={up}
            rivalActive={rivalUp}
            ariaLabel={isCelesteCourse ? 'Climb Wall (Up Arrow)' : 'D-Pad Up (Up Arrow)'}
            className="w-[31px]"
            onPressChange={onPadInput ? (p) => onPadInput('up', p) : undefined}
          />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#111111]/85 leading-none">
            {isCelesteCourse ? 'CLIMB' : 'UP'}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* 3. DASH / B ACTION (Z Key -> NES B) */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
          <TactileKeycapButton
            label="Z"
            badge="B"
            active={bBtn}
            rivalActive={rivalB}
            ariaLabel={isCelesteCourse ? 'Air-Dash (Z or B Button)' : 'Action B (Z Key)'}
            className="px-2 min-w-[48px]"
            onPressChange={onPadInput ? (p) => onPadInput('b', p) : undefined}
          />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#111111]/85 leading-none">
            {isCelesteCourse ? 'DASH' : 'ACTION'}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* 4. JUMP / A ACTION (Spacebar -> NES A) */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
          <TactileKeycapButton
            label="SPACE"
            badge="A"
            active={aBtn}
            rivalActive={rivalA}
            ariaLabel="Jump (Spacebar or A Button)"
            className="px-2.5 min-w-[72px] lg:min-w-[80px]"
            onPressChange={onPadInput ? (p) => onPadInput('a', p) : undefined}
          />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#111111]/85 leading-none">
            JUMP
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* 5. RETRY (R Key) */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
          <TactileKeycapButton
            label="R"
            ariaLabel="Instant Retry (R Key)"
            className="w-[31px]"
            onClick={onRetry}
          />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#111111]/85 leading-none">
            RETRY
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* 6. STAGE 14 PRACTICE PIN (P / O Keys) */}
        {onDropPracticePin && (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
            <TactileKeycapButton
              label={practicePinActive ? '📍O' : 'P'}
              active={practicePinActive}
              ariaLabel={
                practicePinActive
                  ? 'Warp to Practice Save-Pin (O Key)'
                  : 'Drop Practice Save-Pin (P Key)'
              }
              title={
                practicePinActive
                  ? 'Practice Pin Active — Click or press [O] to warp to pin, or [P] to move pin'
                  : 'Press [P] anywhere mid-room to drop a Practice Save-Pin & [O] to warp back'
              }
              className="px-1.5 min-w-[33px]"
              onClick={practicePinActive && onWarpPracticePin ? onWarpPracticePin : onDropPracticePin}
            />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#111111]/85 leading-none">
              {practicePinActive ? 'WARP' : 'PIN'}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * Mobile Multi-Touch Thumb-Slide & Chord Pad (< 640px):
 * - Left rocker pad supports continuous 8-way thumb sliding (including diagonal ↖ / ↗ air-dash directions).
 * - Right action pad supports simultaneous multi-touch OR single-thumb roll chording across DASH (B) + JUMP (A).
 */
export function MobileThumbChordControls({
  visualInputMask,
  isCelesteCourse = true,
  onPadInput,
}: {
  visualInputMask: number;
  isCelesteCourse?: boolean;
  onPadInput: (button: string, pressed: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const dpadPointersRef = React.useRef<Map<number, string[]>>(new Map());
  const dpadActiveSetRef = React.useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const actionPointersRef = React.useRef<Map<number, string[]>>(new Map());
  const actionActiveSetRef = React.useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const syncButtonGroup = (
    pointersMap: Map<number, string[]>,
    activeSet: Set<string>,
    candidates: readonly string[]
  ) => {
    const desired = new Set<string>();
    for (const list of pointersMap.values()) {
      for (const b of list) desired.add(b);
    }
    for (const btn of candidates) {
      const hasNow = desired.has(btn);
      const hadBefore = activeSet.has(btn);
      if (hasNow && !hadBefore) {
        activeSet.add(btn);
        onPadInput(btn, true);
      } else if (!hasNow && hadBefore) {
        activeSet.delete(btn);
        onPadInput(btn, false);
      }
    }
  };

  const resolveDpadDirections = (el: HTMLElement, clientX: number, clientY: number): string[] => {
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return [];
    const nx = (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
    const ny = (clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
    const dirs: string[] = [];
    if (nx < 0.37) dirs.push('left');
    else if (nx > 0.63) dirs.push('right');
    if (ny < 0.44) dirs.push('up');
    else if (ny > 0.78) dirs.push('down');
    return dirs;
  };

  const resolveActionButtons = (el: HTMLElement, clientX: number): string[] => {
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width <= 0) return [];
    const nx = (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
    if (nx < 0.43) return ['b'];
    if (nx > 0.57) return ['a'];
    return ['b', 'a'];
  };

  const up = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_UP) !== 0;
  const down = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_DOWN) !== 0;
  const left = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_LEFT) !== 0;
  const right = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_RIGHT) !== 0;
  const select = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_SELECT) !== 0;
  const start = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_START) !== 0;
  const bBtn = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_B) !== 0;
  const aBtn = (visualInputMask & NES_INPUT_A) !== 0;

  return (
    <div
      aria-label="Mobile Multi-Touch Thumb Controls"
      className="mt-2.5 flex sm:hidden items-center justify-between gap-2 w-full select-none"
    >
      {/* Left 8-Way Thumb-Slide Rocker Pad */}
      <div
        role="group"
        aria-label="8-Way Thumb-Slide D-Pad"
        onPointerDown={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          try {
            e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
          } catch {
            // ignore synthetic events without capture support
          }
          dpadPointersRef.current.set(
            e.pointerId,
            resolveDpadDirections(e.currentTarget, e.clientX, e.clientY)
          );
          syncButtonGroup(dpadPointersRef.current, dpadActiveSetRef.current, [
            'left',
            'right',
            'up',
            'down',
          ]);
        }}
        onPointerMove={(e) => {
          if (!dpadPointersRef.current.has(e.pointerId)) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          dpadPointersRef.current.set(
            e.pointerId,
            resolveDpadDirections(e.currentTarget, e.clientX, e.clientY)
          );
          syncButtonGroup(dpadPointersRef.current, dpadActiveSetRef.current, [
            'left',
            'right',
            'up',
            'down',
          ]);
        }}
        onPointerUp={(e) => {
          if (!dpadPointersRef.current.has(e.pointerId)) return;
          dpadPointersRef.current.delete(e.pointerId);
          syncButtonGroup(dpadPointersRef.current, dpadActiveSetRef.current, [
            'left',
            'right',
            'up',
            'down',
          ]);
        }}
        onPointerCancel={(e) => {
          if (!dpadPointersRef.current.has(e.pointerId)) return;
          dpadPointersRef.current.delete(e.pointerId);
          syncButtonGroup(dpadPointersRef.current, dpadActiveSetRef.current, [
            'left',
            'right',
            'up',
            'down',
          ]);
        }}
        className="touch-none h-[46px] flex-1 max-w-[182px] rounded-xl border-[2.5px] border-[#111111] bg-[#EFE6CE] shadow-[0_3px_0_#111111] grid grid-cols-3 grid-rows-2 overflow-hidden text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase"
      >
        <div
          className={`flex items-center justify-center border-r border-b border-[#111111]/20 ${
            left && up ? 'bg-[#FFE74C]' : 'bg-[#FFF9E6]/80'
          }`}
        >
          ↖
        </div>
        <div
          className={`flex items-center justify-center border-r border-b border-[#111111]/20 ${
            up && !left && !right ? 'bg-[#FFE74C]' : 'bg-[#FFF9E6]'
          }`}
        >
          ▲ UP
        </div>
        <div
          className={`flex items-center justify-center border-b border-[#111111]/20 ${
            right && up ? 'bg-[#FFE74C]' : 'bg-[#7FD1AE]/55'
          }`}
        >
          ↗
        </div>
        <div
          className={`flex items-center justify-center border-r border-[#111111]/20 ${
            left && !up ? 'bg-[#FFE74C]' : 'bg-[#FFF9E6]'
          }`}
        >
          ◀ LEFT
        </div>
        <div
          className={`flex items-center justify-center border-r border-[#111111]/20 text-[8.5px] ${
            down ? 'bg-[#FFE74C]' : 'bg-[#EFE6CE]'
          }`}
        >
          ▼
        </div>
        <div
          className={`flex items-center justify-center ${
            right && !up ? 'bg-[#FFE74C]' : 'bg-[#7FD1AE]'
          }`}
        >
          RUN ▶
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Compact Mobile SELECT / START Menu Stack for Custom Dropped ROMs (0px extra vertical height) */}
      {!isCelesteCourse && (
        <div
          role="group"
          aria-label="Mobile Select and Start Controls"
          className="h-[46px] flex flex-col justify-between shrink-0"
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Start Button"
            onPointerDown={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              onPadInput('start', true);
            }}
            onPointerUp={() => onPadInput('start', false)}
            onPointerCancel={() => onPadInput('start', false)}
            onPointerLeave={() => onPadInput('start', false)}
            className={`touch-none h-[21px] px-2 rounded-md border-[2px] border-[#111111] shadow-[0_2px_0_#111111] text-[8px] font-black uppercase leading-none flex items-center justify-center ${
              start ? 'bg-[#7FD1AE] text-[#111111]' : 'bg-[#2B2A32] text-[#FFFDF7]'
            }`}
          >
            START
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Select Button"
            onPointerDown={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              onPadInput('select', true);
            }}
            onPointerUp={() => onPadInput('select', false)}
            onPointerCancel={() => onPadInput('select', false)}
            onPointerLeave={() => onPadInput('select', false)}
            className={`touch-none h-[21px] px-2 rounded-md border-[2px] border-[#111111] shadow-[0_2px_0_#111111] text-[8px] font-black uppercase leading-none flex items-center justify-center ${
              select ? 'bg-[#7FD1AE] text-[#111111]' : 'bg-[#EFE6CE] text-[#111111]'
            }`}
          >
            SEL
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Right Multi-Touch / Thumb-Chord DASH (B) + JUMP (A) Pad */}
      <div
        role="group"
        aria-label="Dash and Jump Chord Pad"
        onPointerDown={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          try {
            e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
          } catch {
            // ignore
          }
          actionPointersRef.current.set(
            e.pointerId,
            resolveActionButtons(e.currentTarget, e.clientX)
          );
          syncButtonGroup(actionPointersRef.current, actionActiveSetRef.current, ['b', 'a']);
        }}
        onPointerMove={(e) => {
          if (!actionPointersRef.current.has(e.pointerId)) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          actionPointersRef.current.set(
            e.pointerId,
            resolveActionButtons(e.currentTarget, e.clientX)
          );
          syncButtonGroup(actionPointersRef.current, actionActiveSetRef.current, ['b', 'a']);
        }}
        onPointerUp={(e) => {
          if (!actionPointersRef.current.has(e.pointerId)) return;
          actionPointersRef.current.delete(e.pointerId);
          syncButtonGroup(actionPointersRef.current, actionActiveSetRef.current, ['b', 'a']);
        }}
        onPointerCancel={(e) => {
          if (!actionPointersRef.current.has(e.pointerId)) return;
          actionPointersRef.current.delete(e.pointerId);
          syncButtonGroup(actionPointersRef.current, actionActiveSetRef.current, ['b', 'a']);
        }}
        className="touch-none h-[46px] flex-1 max-w-[172px] rounded-xl border-[2.5px] border-[#111111] shadow-[0_3px_0_#111111] grid grid-cols-[1fr_24px_1fr] overflow-hidden text-[10px] font-black uppercase"
      >
        <div
          className={`flex items-center justify-center transition-colors ${
            bBtn ? 'bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111]' : 'bg-[#EC6553] text-white'
          }`}
        >
          DASH ●
        </div>
        <div
          title="Slide or tap center seam to chord Dash + Jump"
          className={`flex items-center justify-center border-x border-[#111111]/35 text-[8.5px] ${
            bBtn && aBtn ? 'bg-[#7FD1AE] text-[#111111]' : 'bg-[#25242B] text-[#FFE74C]'
          }`}
        >
          B+A
        </div>
        <div
          className={`flex items-center justify-center transition-colors ${
            aBtn ? 'bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111]' : 'bg-[#F5C342] text-[#111111]'
          }`}
        >
          JUMP ▲
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

`components/LeaderboardDrawer.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { sanitizeArcadeTag } from '@/lib/ghostShare';
import { ArcadeIdentityInfo, GhostRun, MountainStandingEntry } from '@/lib/types';

export type RivalSelectionMode = 'top' | 'pb' | 'custom';

interface LeaderboardDrawerProps {
  stageLabel: string;
  leaderboard: GhostRun[];
  mountainStandings?: readonly MountainStandingEntry[];
  totalRuns: number;
  activeTargetGhost: GhostRun | null;
  localPbGhost: GhostRun | null;
  localPbMs: number | null;
  rivalMode: RivalSelectionMode;
  playerTag: string;
  identityInfo?: ArcadeIdentityInfo | null;
  layout?: 'vertical' | 'horizontal';
  collapsed?: boolean;
  expandedSolo?: boolean;
  onToggleCollapse?: () => void;
  swarmEnabled?: boolean;
  onToggleSwarm?: () => void;
  onSelectTopRecord: () => void;
  onSelectMyPb: () => void;
  onSelectCustomRival: (ghost: GhostRun) => void;
  onWatchGhostReplay?: (ghost: GhostRun) => void;
  onRestoreClaimKey?: (claimKey: string) => Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }>;
}

export default function LeaderboardDrawer({
  stageLabel,
  leaderboard,
  mountainStandings = [],
  totalRuns,
  activeTargetGhost,
  localPbGhost,
  localPbMs,
  rivalMode,
  playerTag,
  identityInfo,
  layout = 'vertical',
  collapsed = false,
  expandedSolo = false,
  onToggleCollapse,
  swarmEnabled = false,
  onToggleSwarm,
  onSelectTopRecord,
  onSelectMyPb,
  onSelectCustomRival,
  onWatchGhostReplay,
  onRestoreClaimKey,
}: LeaderboardDrawerProps) {
  const [boardView, setBoardView] = useState<'room' | 'mountain'>('room');
  const [showKeyTools, setShowKeyTools] = useState(false);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState(false);
  const [restoreInput, setRestoreInput] = useState('');
  const [restoreStatus, setRestoreStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const cleanPlayerTag = sanitizeArcadeTag(playerTag);
  const effectivePbMs = localPbGhost?.timeMs ?? localPbMs;
  const topTimeMs = leaderboard[0]?.timeMs ?? activeTargetGhost?.timeMs ?? null;

  let playerRank: number | null = null;
  if (typeof effectivePbMs === 'number') {
    const fasterCount = leaderboard.filter(
      (r) => sanitizeArcadeTag(r.tag) !== cleanPlayerTag && r.timeMs < effectivePbMs
    ).length;
    playerRank = fasterCount + 1;
  }
  const effectiveTotal = Math.max(
    totalRuns,
    leaderboard.length,
    playerRank !== null ? playerRank : 1
  );

  const slots = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, idx) => leaderboard[idx] ?? null);
  const mountainSlots = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, idx) => mountainStandings[idx] ?? null);
  const hasMountainStandings = mountainStandings.length > 0;

  const handleCopyClaimKey = async () => {
    if (!identityInfo?.claimKey) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(identityInfo.claimKey);
      setCopiedKey(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(false), 1600);
    } catch {
      // ignore clipboard errors
    }
  };

  const handleRestoreSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!onRestoreClaimKey || !restoreInput.trim()) return;
    setRestoreStatus('VERIFYING...');
    const res = await onRestoreClaimKey(restoreInput.trim());
    if (res.ok) {
      setRestoreStatus('✓ TAG RESTORED!');
      setRestoreInput('');
    } else {
      setRestoreStatus(res.error || 'INVALID KEY');
    }
  };

  const renderHeaderControls = () => (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
      {hasMountainStandings && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setBoardView((v) => (v === 'room' ? 'mountain' : 'room'))}
          aria-pressed={boardView === 'mountain'}
          aria-label="Toggle 6-Room Mountain Standings"
          title={
            boardView === 'mountain'
              ? 'Viewing Overall 6-Room Mountain King Standings (Click for Single Room Top 10)'
              : 'View Overall 6-Room Mountain King Standings (Crowns & Total Time)'
          }
          className={`px-1.5 h-[22px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] font-black text-[8.5px] uppercase leading-none flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none transition-all duration-75 ${
            boardView === 'mountain'
              ? 'bg-[#E2A4FF] text-[#111111] shadow-[1.5px_1.5px_0_#111111]'
              : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#E2A4FF] text-[#111111]/90 shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none'
          }`}
        >
          {boardView === 'mountain' ? '⛰️ 6RM' : '⛰️ ALL'}
        </button>
      )}

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          setBoardView('room');
          onSelectTopRecord();
        }}
        aria-pressed={rivalMode === 'top' && !swarmEnabled}
        aria-label="Race #1 Record"
        title="Race #1 Record Ghost"
        className={`px-1.5 h-[22px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] font-black text-[9px] uppercase leading-none flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none transition-all duration-75 ${
          rivalMode === 'top' && !swarmEnabled
            ? 'bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111] shadow-[1.5px_1.5px_0_#111111]'
            : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111]/90 shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none'
        }`}
      >
        👑 #1
      </button>

      {onToggleSwarm && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onToggleSwarm}
          aria-pressed={swarmEnabled}
          aria-label="Toggle 10-Ghost Swarm"
          title={
            swarmEnabled
              ? '10-Ghost Swarm Active: Racing all Top 10 ghosts simultaneously (Click for 1v1)'
              : 'Race all Top 10 leaderboard ghosts simultaneously on screen'
          }
          className={`px-1.5 h-[22px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] font-black text-[9px] uppercase leading-none flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none transition-all duration-75 ${
            swarmEnabled
              ? 'bg-[#7DD3FC] text-[#111111] shadow-[1.5px_1.5px_0_#111111]'
              : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#7DD3FC] text-[#111111]/90 shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none'
          }`}
        >
          ALL 10
        </button>
      )}

      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={!localPbGhost}
        onClick={() => {
          if (localPbGhost) onSelectMyPb();
        }}
        aria-pressed={rivalMode === 'pb'}
        aria-label="Race My PB"
        title={
          localPbGhost
            ? `Race your own ${(localPbGhost.timeMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s Personal Best ghost`
            : 'Finish a run on this segment first to unlock Race My PB'
        }
        className={`px-1.5 h-[22px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] font-black text-[8.5px] uppercase leading-none flex items-center justify-center select-none transition-all duration-75 ${
          !localPbGhost
            ? 'bg-[#EAE2C8]/75 text-[#111111]/40 cursor-not-allowed'
            : rivalMode === 'pb'
              ? 'bg-[#7FD1AE] text-[#111111] shadow-[1.5px_1.5px_0_#111111] cursor-pointer'
              : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#7FD1AE] text-[#111111]/90 shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none cursor-pointer'
        }`}
      >
        MY PB
      </button>

      {(identityInfo?.claimKey || onRestoreClaimKey) && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            setShowKeyTools((v) => !v);
            setRestoreStatus(null);
          }}
          aria-expanded={showKeyTools}
          aria-label="Backup or Restore Arcade Tag"
          title={`@${cleanPlayerTag}${
            playerRank !== null ? ` • #${playerRank} of ${effectiveTotal}` : ''
          } — Backup or restore claimed Arcade Tag`}
          className={`w-[22px] h-[22px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] font-black text-[9.5px] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none transition-all duration-75 ${
            showKeyTools
              ? 'bg-[#FFE74C] shadow-[1.5px_1.5px_0_#111111]'
              : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none'
          }`}
        >
          🔑
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  const renderKeyPopover = () => {
    if (!showKeyTools) return null;
    return (
      <div
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            e.stopPropagation();
            setShowKeyTools(false);
          }
        }}
        className="absolute inset-x-2 top-[36px] z-30 bg-[#FFFDF7] border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-xl p-2.5 shadow-[3px_3px_0px_#111111] space-y-1.5 text-[10px]"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0">
            <span className="bg-[#111111] text-[#FFE74C] rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-black uppercase leading-none truncate">
              @{cleanPlayerTag}
            </span>
            {identityInfo?.ownedBySession && (
              <span className="bg-[#7FD1AE] border border-[#111111] rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[8.5px] font-black uppercase leading-none shrink-0">
                🔒
              </span>
            )}
            {playerRank !== null && (
              <span className="font-black uppercase tabular-nums text-[#111111]/75 shrink-0">
                #{playerRank}/{effectiveTotal}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowKeyTools(false)}
            aria-label="Close Tag Sync"
            className="w-5 h-5 rounded border border-[#111111] bg-[#EAE2C8] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] font-black flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer shrink-0 leading-none"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        {identityInfo?.claimKey && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <code className="flex-1 min-w-0 bg-[#EFE6CE] border border-[#111111] rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-black truncate">
              {identityInfo.claimKey}
            </code>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void handleCopyClaimKey()}
              className="bg-[#7FD1AE] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] border border-[#111111] rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-black uppercase cursor-pointer shrink-0"
            >
              {copiedKey ? '✓' : 'COPY'}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {onRestoreClaimKey && (
          <form onSubmit={(e) => void handleRestoreSubmit(e)} className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={restoreInput}
              onChange={(e) => setRestoreInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="PASTE TAG KEY"
              className="flex-1 min-w-0 bg-white border border-[#111111] rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase focus:outline-none"
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="bg-[#F5C342] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] border border-[#111111] rounded px-2 py-0.5 font-black uppercase cursor-pointer shrink-0"
            >
              SYNC
            </button>
          </form>
        )}

        {restoreStatus && (
          <div className="font-black uppercase text-[#0B5D3B] leading-tight">{restoreStatus}</div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  if (layout === 'vertical') {
    return (
      <aside
        aria-label="Top 10 Speedrun Leaderboard"
        title={`${stageLabel} — Top 10 Leaderboard (Click any runner to race 1v1)`}
        className={`${
          collapsed ? 'shrink-0' : expandedSolo ? 'flex-1' : 'flex-[55]'
        } min-h-0 relative w-full bg-[#EFE6CE] border-[3px] border-[#111111] rounded-2xl p-2.5 shadow-[inset_0_2px_0_#FFFDF7,inset_0_-3px_0_#D8CEB4,4px_5px_0px_#111111] flex flex-col gap-1.5`}
      >
        {/* Top Rack Header: Collapsible Trigger + Harmonized 26px Bar Matching PICK A SEGMENT */}
        <div
          className={`shrink-0 h-[26px] flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 ${
            collapsed ? '' : 'pb-1.5 border-b-2 border-[#111111]/15'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
            {onToggleCollapse && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onToggleCollapse}
                aria-expanded={!collapsed}
                aria-label={collapsed ? 'Expand Top 10 Leaderboard' : 'Collapse Top 10 Leaderboard'}
                title={collapsed ? 'Expand Top 10 Leaderboard' : 'Collapse Top 10 Leaderboard'}
                className="w-[22px] h-[22px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111] font-black text-[10px] leading-none flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none shrink-0"
              >
                {collapsed ? '▸' : '▾'}
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onToggleCollapse}
              className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#111111] leading-none whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer text-left focus:outline-none"
            >
              TOP 10
            </button>
            {identityInfo && identityInfo.streakCount > 0 && (
              <span
                title={`${identityInfo.streakCount}-day Daily Sprint streak`}
                className="bg-[#EC6553] text-white border border-[#111111] rounded px-1 py-[1px] text-[8px] font-black uppercase leading-none shrink-0"
              >
                🔥{identityInfo.streakCount}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {renderHeaderControls()}
        </div>

        {renderKeyPopover()}

        {/* 10 High-Legibility Tactile Runner Rows Stacked Directly Below PICK A SEGMENT */}
        {!collapsed && boardView === 'mountain' && (
          <div
            aria-label="6-Room Mountain King Standings"
            className="flex-1 min-h-0 grid gap-[3.5px]"
            style={{ gridTemplateRows: 'repeat(10, minmax(0, 1fr))' }}
          >
            {mountainSlots.map((entry, idx) => {
              const rank = idx + 1;
              if (!entry) {
                return (
                  <div
                    key={`mtn-empty-${rank}`}
                    className="h-full min-h-0 w-full rounded-xl border-[1.5px] border-dashed border-[#111111]/35 bg-[#FFFDF7]/55 px-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 text-[10.5px] font-black uppercase text-[#111111]/45"
                  >
                    <span className="tabular-nums">#{rank} ---</span>
                    <span className="tabular-nums">--.--s</span>
                  </div>
                );
              }

              const totalSec = (entry.totalTimeMs / 1000).toFixed(2);
              const isYou = sanitizeArcadeTag(entry.tag) === cleanPlayerTag;

              return (
                <button
                  key={`mtn-${entry.tag}`}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setBoardView('room')}
                  title={`#${rank} @${entry.tag} • ${entry.crowns} Room Crowns • ${entry.roomsCleared}/6 Rooms • ${totalSec}s Total`}
                  className={`h-full min-h-0 w-full rounded-xl border-2 border-[#111111] px-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 text-left cursor-pointer select-none focus:outline-none transition-all duration-100 ${
                    rank === 1
                      ? 'bg-[#FFE74C] shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#111111]'
                      : isYou
                        ? 'bg-[#E7F8EE]'
                        : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFF7DC]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                    <span
                      className={`${
                        expandedSolo ? 'w-[25px] h-[25px] text-[11.5px]' : 'w-[21px] h-[20px] text-[10px]'
                      } rounded-[5px] border border-[#111111] font-black tabular-nums leading-none flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                        rank === 1
                          ? 'bg-[#F5C342]'
                          : rank === 2
                            ? 'bg-[#7FD1AE]'
                            : rank === 3
                              ? 'bg-[#FFAD87]'
                              : 'bg-[#EFE6CE]'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {rank}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`${
                        expandedSolo ? 'text-[12.5px]' : 'text-[11px]'
                      } font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#111111] truncate leading-none`}
                    >
                      @{entry.tag}
                    </span>
                    {entry.crowns > 0 && (
                      <span className="bg-[#FFE74C] border border-[#111111] rounded px-1 py-[1px] text-[8.5px] font-black leading-none shrink-0">
                        👑{entry.crowns}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                    <span className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase text-[#111111]/65 leading-none">
                      {entry.roomsCleared}/6
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`${
                        expandedSolo ? 'text-[12px]' : 'text-[10.5px]'
                      } font-black tabular-nums tracking-tight text-[#111111] leading-none`}
                    >
                      {totalSec}s
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}

        {!collapsed && boardView === 'room' && (
          <div
            className="flex-1 min-h-0 grid gap-[3.5px]"
            style={{ gridTemplateRows: 'repeat(10, minmax(0, 1fr))' }}
          >
            {slots.map((run, idx) => {
              const rank = idx + 1;
              if (!run) {
                return (
                  <div
                    key={`empty-rank-${rank}`}
                    className="h-full min-h-0 w-full rounded-xl border-[1.5px] border-dashed border-[#111111]/35 bg-[#FFFDF7]/55 px-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 text-[10.5px] font-black uppercase text-[#111111]/45"
                  >
                    <span className="tabular-nums">#{rank} ---</span>
                    <span className="tabular-nums">--.--s</span>
                  </div>
                );
              }

              const secs = (run.timeMs / 1000).toFixed(2).padStart(5, '0');
              const deltaSec =
                topTimeMs !== null && rank > 1 ? (run.timeMs - topTimeMs) / 1000 : 0;
              const isYou =
                sanitizeArcadeTag(run.tag) === cleanPlayerTag && !run.id.startsWith('seed');
              const isActiveRival =
                activeTargetGhost?.id === run.id &&
                (rivalMode === 'custom' || (rivalMode === 'top' && rank === 1));
              const hasReplay = Boolean(run.inputLog && onWatchGhostReplay);

              return (
                <div key={run.id} className="relative h-full min-h-0 w-full group">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-pressed={isActiveRival}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (rank === 1) {
                        onSelectTopRecord();
                      } else {
                        onSelectCustomRival(run);
                      }
                    }}
                    title={`#${rank} @${run.tag} • ${secs}s${
                      rank > 1 ? ` (+${deltaSec.toFixed(2)}s)` : ''
                    } — Click to race 1v1`}
                    className={`h-full min-h-0 w-full rounded-xl border-2 border-[#111111] pl-2 ${
                      hasReplay ? (expandedSolo ? 'pr-[32px]' : 'pr-[28px]') : 'pr-2'
                    } flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 text-left cursor-pointer select-none focus:outline-none transition-all duration-100 ${
                      isActiveRival
                        ? 'bg-[#FFE74C] shadow-[2.5px_2.5px_0px_#111111] -translate-x-[0.5px] -translate-y-[0.5px]'
                        : isYou
                          ? 'bg-[#E7F8EE] hover:bg-[#FFF7DC] shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111]'
                          : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFF7DC] shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] hover:-translate-y-[0.5px] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                      <span
                        className={`${
                          expandedSolo ? 'w-[25px] h-[25px] text-[11.5px]' : 'w-[21px] h-[20px] text-[10px]'
                        } rounded-[5px] border border-[#111111] font-black tabular-nums leading-none flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                          rank === 1
                            ? 'bg-[#F5C342]'
                            : rank === 2
                              ? 'bg-[#7FD1AE]'
                              : rank === 3
                                ? 'bg-[#FFAD87]'
                                : 'bg-[#EFE6CE]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {rank}
                      </span>

                      <span
                        className={`${
                          expandedSolo ? 'text-[12.5px]' : 'text-[11px]'
                        } font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#111111] truncate leading-none`}
                      >
                        @{run.tag}
                      </span>

                      {isYou && (
                        <span className="bg-[#111111] text-[#FFE74C] rounded px-1 py-[1px] text-[8px] font-black uppercase leading-none shrink-0">
                          YOU
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                      {expandedSolo && rank > 1 && deltaSec > 0 && (
                        <span className="text-[9.5px] font-black tabular-nums text-[#111111]/60 leading-none">
                          +{deltaSec.toFixed(2)}s
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span
                        className={`${
                          expandedSolo ? 'text-[12px]' : 'text-[10.5px]'
                        } font-black tabular-nums tracking-tight text-[#111111] leading-none`}
                      >
                        {secs}s
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  {hasReplay && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onWatchGhostReplay?.(run)}
                      title={`Watch @${run.tag}'s ${secs}s input replay on the CRT`}
                      aria-label={`Watch @${run.tag} replay`}
                      className={`absolute right-1.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 ${
                        expandedSolo ? 'w-[22px] h-[22px] text-[9.5px]' : 'w-[19px] h-[19px] text-[8.5px]'
                      } rounded-[5px] border border-[#111111] bg-[#EFE6CE] hover:bg-[#7FD1AE] text-[#111111] font-black leading-none flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition-colors`}
                    >
                      ▶
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </aside>
    );
  }

  // Narrow-Viewport / Mobile Layout: Harmonized Horizontal Console Strip Matching PICK A SEGMENT
  return (
    <aside
      aria-label="Top 10 Speedrun Leaderboard"
      className="relative w-full mb-2 bg-[#EFE6CE] border-[3.5px] border-[#111111] rounded-2xl px-3 py-1.5 shadow-[inset_0_2px_0_#FFFDF7,inset_0_-3px_0_#D8CEB4,4px_4px_0px_#111111] flex flex-col gap-1"
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          {onToggleCollapse && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onToggleCollapse}
              aria-expanded={!collapsed}
              aria-label={collapsed ? 'Expand Top 10 Leaderboard' : 'Collapse Top 10 Leaderboard'}
              className="w-[22px] h-[20px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111] font-black text-[9.5px] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111]"
            >
              {collapsed ? '▸' : '▾'}
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onToggleCollapse}
            className="text-[10.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#111111] leading-none whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer"
          >
            TOP 10
          </button>
          {playerRank !== null && (
            <span className="bg-[#FFFDF7] border border-[#111111] rounded px-1 py-[0.5px] text-[8.5px] font-black uppercase tabular-nums leading-none shrink-0">
              #{playerRank}/{effectiveTotal}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {renderHeaderControls()}
      </div>

      {renderKeyPopover()}

      {!collapsed && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-0.5">
          {slots.map((run, idx) => {
            const rank = idx + 1;
            if (!run) {
              return (
                <div
                  key={`h-empty-${rank}`}
                  className="shrink-0 h-[28px] rounded-[9px] border-[1.5px] border-dashed border-[#111111]/35 bg-[#FFFDF7]/55 px-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase text-[#111111]/45"
                >
                  <span>#{rank}</span>
                  <span>--.--s</span>
                </div>
              );
            }

            const secs = (run.timeMs / 1000).toFixed(2).padStart(5, '0');
            const isYou =
              sanitizeArcadeTag(run.tag) === cleanPlayerTag && !run.id.startsWith('seed');
            const isActiveRival =
              activeTargetGhost?.id === run.id &&
              (rivalMode === 'custom' || (rivalMode === 'top' && rank === 1));
            const hasReplay = Boolean(run.inputLog && onWatchGhostReplay);

            return (
              <div key={run.id} className="relative shrink-0 flex items-center">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-pressed={isActiveRival}

                    if (rank === 1) {

                    } else {
                      onSelectCustomRival(run);
                    }
                  }}

                    isActiveRival
                      ? 'bg-[#FFE74C] shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#111111]'
                      : isYou
                        ? 'bg-[#E7F8EE]'
                        : 'bg-[#FFFDF7]'

                  <span
                    className={`px-1 py-[0.5px] rounded border border-[#111111] text-[9px] leading-none ${

                        ? 'bg-[#F5C342]'
```

`components/RomVaultModal.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { findBuiltinCartridgeByRomId } from '@/lib/homebrewCatalog';
import { CONSOLE_SYSTEM_LABELS, SUPPORTED_ROM_EXTENSIONS } from '@/lib/romVault';
import { RomProfile, StoredRomEntry } from '@/lib/types';

interface RomVaultModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  activeProfile: RomProfile;
  vaultRoms: StoredRomEntry[];
  missingDareCartTitle?: string | null;
  externalError?: string | null;
  onSelectBuiltinCeleste?: () => void;
  onSelectVaultRom: (entry: StoredRomEntry) => void;
  onDeleteVaultRom?: (entry: StoredRomEntry) => void;
  onDropNewRomFile: (file: File) => Promise<void>;
  onStartSegmentCreator?: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const SUPPORTED_CONSOLES = ['NES', 'SNES', 'GENESIS', 'GAME BOY', 'GBA'];

export default function RomVaultModal({
  isOpen,
  activeProfile,
  vaultRoms,
  missingDareCartTitle,
  externalError,
  onSelectBuiltinCeleste,
  onSelectVaultRom,
  onDeleteVaultRom,
  onDropNewRomFile,
  onStartSegmentCreator,
  onClose,
}: RomVaultModalProps) {
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const displayError = errorMsg || externalError || null;
  const isBuiltinCartridge = Boolean(findBuiltinCartridgeByRomId(activeProfile.romId));

  const handleFileInput = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    e.target.value = '';
    if (!file) return;
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      await onDropNewRomFile(file);
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMsg(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unsupported ROM file');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Play Your Own ROM"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
      className="modal-backdrop-fade fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[#111111]/70 flex items-center justify-center p-4 overflow-y-auto font-mono"
    >
      <div className="modal-card-pop bg-[#FFF9E6] border-4 border-[#111111] rounded-2xl shadow-[9px_9px_0px_#111111] max-w-sm w-full overflow-hidden my-auto text-[#111111]">
        <div className="bg-[#7FD1AE] border-b-4 border-[#111111] px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="font-black text-sm uppercase">📼 PLAY YOUR OWN ROM</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="retro-btn bg-white px-2.5 py-0.5 text-sm"
            aria-label="Close Play Any ROM"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 space-y-3.5">
          {missingDareCartTitle && (
            <div className="bg-[#FFE74C] border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-black">
              ⚔️ Drop <span className="underline">{missingDareCartTitle}</span> to race this
              friend&apos;s dare!
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Single Hero Action: Choose or Drop Any ROM File or .IPS/.BPS Patch */}
          <label className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2.5 bg-[#FFFDF7] border-[3px] border-dashed border-[#111111] rounded-2xl py-6 px-4 cursor-pointer hover:bg-[#F7EED7] transition text-center">
            <span className="retro-btn bg-[#F5C342] px-4 py-2 text-xs uppercase pointer-events-none">
              CHOOSE .NES / .ZIP / .IPS / .BPS
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase">or drag &amp; drop ROM or patch anywhere</span>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-1 pt-0.5">
              {SUPPORTED_CONSOLES.map((sys) => (
                <span
                  key={sys}
                  className="bg-[#EAE2C8] border border-[#111111] rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black"
                >
                  {sys}
                </span>
              ))}
              <span className="bg-[#7FD1AE] border border-[#111111] rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black">
                .IPS / .BPS PATCH
              </span>
            </div>

            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#111111]/70">
              100% local in your browser • Your ROMs are never uploaded
            </span>

            <input
              type="file"
              accept={SUPPORTED_ROM_EXTENSIONS}
              className="hidden"
              onChange={(e) => void handleFileInput(e)}
            />
          </label>

          {displayError && (
            <div className="bg-[#EC6553] text-white border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-black">
              {displayError}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Recent Games (Only shown once the user has dropped at least 1 ROM) */}
          {vaultRoms.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase opacity-75">RECENT GAMES</div>
              <div className="max-h-36 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 pr-0.5">
                {vaultRoms.map((entry) => {
                  const isActive = activeProfile.romId === entry.romId;
                  const sysLabel = CONSOLE_SYSTEM_LABELS[entry.consoleSystem ?? 'nes'] || 'NES';
                  return (
                    <div key={entry.romId} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          onSelectVaultRom(entry);
                          onClose();
                        }}
                        className={`flex-1 min-w-0 text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#111111] font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-2 transition cursor-pointer ${
                          isActive
                            ? 'bg-[#F5C342] shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#111111]'
                            : 'bg-white hover:bg-[#F7EED7]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <span className="truncate">{entry.title}</span>
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-[#111111] bg-[#EAE2C8] text-[10px]">
                            {sysLabel}
                          </span>
                          <span className="uppercase">{isActive ? 'PLAYING' : 'PLAY ▶'}</span>
                        </span>
                      </button>

                      {onDeleteVaultRom && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onDeleteVaultRom(entry)}
                          title={`Remove ${entry.title}`}
                          aria-label={`Remove ${entry.title}`}
                          className="w-8 h-8 shrink-0 rounded-lg border-2 border-[#111111] bg-white hover:bg-[#EC6553] hover:text-white font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                        >
                          ✕
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Custom Vault ROM Actions: Mark Custom Sprint or Return to Celeste */}
          {!isBuiltinCartridge && (
            <div className="pt-0.5 space-y-2">
              {onStartSegmentCreator && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    onClose();
                    onStartSegmentCreator();
                  }}
                  className="w-full retro-btn bg-[#FFE74C] py-2 px-3 text-xs uppercase"
                >
                  ✂️ MARK CUSTOM SPRINT (START → FINISH)
                </button>
              )}
              {onSelectBuiltinCeleste && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    onClose();
                    onSelectBuiltinCeleste();
                  }}
                  className="w-full retro-btn bg-[#F2545B] text-white py-2 px-3 text-xs uppercase"
                >
                  ← RETURN TO CELESTE
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export type SegmentCreatorStep = 'idle' | 'mark-start' | 'mark-finish';

export interface CelesteCarouselSlot {
```
