```tsx
  shortName: string;
  fullTitle: string;
  badgeBg: string;
  previewSrc: string;
  defaultTopMs: number;
  customSegment?: CustomRomSegment;
}

const COURSE_PREVIEW_BY_INDEX: Readonly<Record<number, string>> = {
  0: '/previews/celeste-1a.png',
  1: '/previews/celeste-1b.png',
  2: '/previews/celeste-1c.png',
  3: '/previews/celeste-2a.png',
  4: '/previews/celeste-2b.png',
  5: '/previews/celeste-01.png',
};

const CUSTOM_FALLBACK_PREVIEW_SVG =
  "data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='64' height='60' viewBox='0 0 64 60'><rect width='64' height='60' fill='%23181722'/><rect x='6' y='44' width='52' height='10' fill='%237FD1AE'/><rect x='14' y='30' width='10' height='14' fill='%23FFE74C'/><rect x='42' y='20' width='4' height='24' fill='%23EC6553'/><rect x='46' y='20' width='10' height='8' fill='%23FFFDF7'/></svg>";

function getCourseBadgeBg(worldIndex: number): string {
  if (worldIndex === 2) return '#E2A4FF';
  if (worldIndex === 0) return '#FFE74C';
  return '#7DD3FC';
}

export function buildCelesteCarouselSlots(
  todayDaily: DailySprintChallenge = getDailySprintForDate()
): CelesteCarouselSlot[] {
  return CELESTE_SPRINT_COURSES.map((course) => {
    const courseSprintId =
      course.courseIndex === 0 ? CELESTE_ROM_ID : `${CELESTE_ROM_ID}:c${course.courseIndex}`;
    const isTodayDaily =
      todayDaily.romId === CELESTE_ROM_ID && course.courseIndex === todayDaily.course.courseIndex;
    const defaultTopMs = CELESTE_CHAMPION_REPLAYS[course.courseIndex]?.timeMs ?? 18000;

    return {
      id: `segment-${course.courseIndex}`,
      kind: isTodayDaily ? 'daily' : 'course',
      sprintId: isTodayDaily ? todayDaily.sprintId : courseSprintId,
      courseSprintId,
      courseIndex: course.courseIndex,
      dailyNumber: isTodayDaily ? todayDaily.dailyNumber : undefined,
      dailyBadgeText: isTodayDaily ? todayDaily.badgeText : undefined,
      code: course.code,
      shortName: course.name,
      fullTitle: isTodayDaily
        ? `Today's Daily ${todayDaily.badgeText} • Celeste ${course.code} (${course.name})`
        : `Celeste ${course.code} • ${course.name}`,
      badgeBg: getCourseBadgeBg(course.worldIndex),
      previewSrc: COURSE_PREVIEW_BY_INDEX[course.courseIndex] ?? '/previews/celeste-1a.png',
      defaultTopMs,
    };
  });
}

export function buildCartridgeCarouselSlots(
  activeProfile: Pick<RomProfile, 'romId' | 'title' | 'sprintId' | 'startWorldX' | 'goalWorldX'>,
  customSegments: readonly CustomRomSegment[] = [],
  todayDaily: DailySprintChallenge = getDailySprintForDate()
): CelesteCarouselSlot[] {
  if (activeProfile.romId === CELESTE_ROM_ID) {
    return buildCelesteCarouselSlots(todayDaily);
  }

  // Custom BYO Vault ROM: render user-created segments (or default base sprint if none saved yet)
  if (customSegments.length > 0) {
    const customBadges = ['#7FD1AE', '#FFE74C', '#7DD3FC', '#E2A4FF', '#FFAD87'];
    return customSegments.map((seg, idx) => ({
      id: seg.id,
      kind: 'custom',
      sprintId: seg.sprintId,
      courseSprintId: seg.sprintId,
      courseIndex: idx,
      code: seg.code,
      shortName: seg.name,
      fullTitle: `${activeProfile.title} • ${seg.code} ${seg.name}`,
      badgeBg: customBadges[idx % customBadges.length],
      previewSrc: seg.previewDataUrl || CUSTOM_FALLBACK_PREVIEW_SVG,
      defaultTopMs: 14800,
      customSegment: seg,
    }));
  }

  return [
    {
      id: `custom-base-${activeProfile.romId}`,
      kind: 'custom',
      sprintId: activeProfile.sprintId || activeProfile.romId,
      courseSprintId: activeProfile.sprintId || activeProfile.romId,
      courseIndex: 0,
      code: 'S1',
      shortName: 'OPEN SPRINT',
      fullTitle: `${activeProfile.title} • Open Sprint`,
      badgeBg: '#7FD1AE',
      previewSrc: CUSTOM_FALLBACK_PREVIEW_SVG,
      defaultTopMs: 14800,
    },
  ];
}

export function findActiveCelesteSlotIndex(
  slots: readonly CelesteCarouselSlot[],
  activeProfile: Pick<RomProfile, 'sprintId' | 'courseIndex'>
): number {
  const sprintMatch = slots.findIndex(
    (s) => s.sprintId === activeProfile.sprintId || s.courseSprintId === activeProfile.sprintId
  );
  if (sprintMatch >= 0) return sprintMatch;
  const cIdx = activeProfile.courseIndex ?? 0;
  const courseMatch = slots.findIndex((s) => s.courseIndex === cIdx);
  return courseMatch >= 0 ? courseMatch : 0;
}

function subscribeLocalPbStorage(onStoreChange: () => void): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};
  window.addEventListener('storage', onStoreChange);
  return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', onStoreChange);
}

interface SprintLevelCarouselProps {
  activeProfile: RomProfile;
  isAttractMode: boolean;
  topTimesBySprintId: Readonly<Record<string, number>>;
  pbRevision: number;
  customSegments?: readonly CustomRomSegment[];
  segmentCreatorStep?: SegmentCreatorStep;
  segmentDraftDistancePx?: number;
  layout?: 'vertical' | 'horizontal';
  collapsed?: boolean;
  expandedSolo?: boolean;
  onToggleCollapse?: () => void;
  relayModeEnabled?: boolean;
  relayLegIndex?: number;
  onToggleRelayMode?: () => void;
  activeMutator?: ArcadeMutator;
  onCycleMutator?: () => void;
  onSelectDaily: () => void;
  onSelectCourse: (courseIndex: number) => void;
  onSelectCustomSegment?: (segment: CustomRomSegment | null) => void;
  onDeleteCustomSegment?: (segment: CustomRomSegment) => void;
  onStartSegmentCreator?: () => void;
  onConfirmSegmentStart?: () => void;
  onConfirmSegmentFinish?: () => void;
  onCancelSegmentCreator?: () => void;
  onStepLevel: (direction: -1 | 1) => void;
}

export default function SprintLevelCarousel({
  activeProfile,
  isAttractMode,
  topTimesBySprintId,
  pbRevision,
  customSegments = [],
  segmentCreatorStep = 'idle',
  segmentDraftDistancePx = 0,
  layout = 'vertical',
  collapsed = false,
  expandedSolo = false,
  onToggleCollapse,
  relayModeEnabled = false,
  relayLegIndex = 0,
  onToggleRelayMode,
  activeMutator = 'none',
  onCycleMutator,
  onSelectDaily,
  onSelectCourse,
  onSelectCustomSegment,
  onDeleteCustomSegment,
  onStartSegmentCreator,
  onConfirmSegmentStart,
  onConfirmSegmentFinish,
  onCancelSegmentCreator,
  onStepLevel,
}: SprintLevelCarouselProps) {
  const [hoveredSlotId, setHoveredSlotId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const isBuiltin = Boolean(findBuiltinCartridgeByRomId(activeProfile.romId));

  const slots = useMemo(
    () => buildCartridgeCarouselSlots(activeProfile, customSegments, getDailySprintForDate()),
    [activeProfile, customSegments]
  );
  const activeIdx = findActiveCelesteSlotIndex(slots, activeProfile);
  const activeSlot = slots[activeIdx] ?? slots[0];

  // Hydration-safe subscription to localStorage Personal Bests + in-tab pbRevision updates
  const pbStorageSnapshot = useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribeLocalPbStorage,
    () => {
      try {
        const d = localStorage.getItem('bitgeist_daily_pb_celeste_v1') || '';
        const s = localStorage.getItem('bitgeist_sprint_pb_v1') || '';
        return `${pbRevision}|${d}|${s}`;
      } catch {
        return String(pbRevision);
      }
    },
    () => ''
  );

  const canReadLocalPb = pbStorageSnapshot.length > 0;

  const getSlotStats = (slot: CelesteCarouselSlot) => {
    const liveDailyTop = topTimesBySprintId[slot.sprintId];
    const liveCourseTop = topTimesBySprintId[slot.courseSprintId];
    const bestLiveTop =
      typeof liveDailyTop === 'number' && liveDailyTop >= 1000
        ? liveDailyTop
        : typeof liveCourseTop === 'number' && liveCourseTop >= 1000
          ? liveCourseTop
          : undefined;

    const topMs =
      typeof bestLiveTop === 'number'
        ? slot.kind === 'custom'
          ? bestLiveTop
          : Math.min(bestLiveTop, slot.defaultTopMs)
        : slot.defaultTopMs;

    let pbMs: number | null = null;
    if (canReadLocalPb) {
      const dailyPb =
        slot.kind === 'daily' && typeof slot.dailyNumber === 'number'
          ? getLocalDailyPbMs(slot.dailyNumber)
          : null;
      const coursePb = getLocalSprintPbMs(slot.courseSprintId);
      const sprintPb = getLocalSprintPbMs(slot.sprintId);
      const bestSprintPb =
        coursePb !== null && sprintPb !== null
          ? Math.min(coursePb, sprintPb)
          : (coursePb ?? sprintPb);
      if (dailyPb !== null && bestSprintPb !== null) {
        pbMs = Math.min(dailyPb, bestSprintPb);
      } else {
        pbMs = dailyPb ?? bestSprintPb;
      }
    }
    const beatTop = pbMs !== null && pbMs <= topMs;
    const medal = pbMs !== null ? evaluateRoomMedal(pbMs, topMs) : null;
    return { topMs, pbMs, beatTop, medal };
  };

  const hoveredSlot = hoveredSlotId ? slots.find((s) => s.id === hoveredSlotId) ?? null : null;
  const displaySlot = hoveredSlot ?? activeSlot;
  const isDisplayingActive = displaySlot.id === activeSlot.id;
  const displayStats = getSlotStats(displaySlot);
  const activeStats = getSlotStats(activeSlot);

  const handleSelectSlot = (slot: CelesteCarouselSlot, isActive: boolean) => {
    if (slot.kind === 'custom') {
      if (slot.customSegment && onSelectCustomSegment) {
        onSelectCustomSegment(slot.customSegment);
      } else if (!slot.customSegment && onSelectCustomSegment) {
        onSelectCustomSegment(null);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (isActive) {
      if (
        slot.kind === 'daily' &&
        typeof slot.dailyNumber === 'number' &&
        activeProfile.dailyNumber !== slot.dailyNumber
      ) {
        onSelectDaily();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (slot.kind === 'daily') {
      onSelectDaily();
    } else {
      onSelectCourse(slot.courseIndex);
    }
  };

  const showCreatorSlot =
    !isBuiltin &&
    Boolean(onStartSegmentCreator) &&
    (customSegments.length < 5 || segmentCreatorStep !== 'idle');
  const totalVerticalRows = Math.max(1, slots.length + (showCreatorSlot ? 1 : 0));

  const renderCreatorCardVertical = () => {
    if (!showCreatorSlot) return null;
    if (segmentCreatorStep === 'mark-start') {
      return (
        <div className="h-full min-h-0 w-full rounded-xl border-2 border-[#111111] bg-[#FFE74C] shadow-[2.5px_2.5px_0px_#111111] px-2 py-1 flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onConfirmSegmentStart}
            className="flex-1 min-w-0 text-left cursor-pointer focus:outline-none"
          >
            <div className="text-[10.5px] font-black uppercase leading-none text-[#111111]">
              📍 [1] SET START HERE
            </div>
            <div className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase text-[#111111]/75 truncate mt-0.5 leading-none">
              Play to spot &amp; click
            </div>
          </button>
          {onCancelSegmentCreator && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onCancelSegmentCreator}
              aria-label="Cancel Segment Creator"
              className="w-6 h-6 rounded border border-[#111111] bg-white hover:bg-[#EC6553] hover:text-white text-[10px] font-black flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer shrink-0"
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (segmentCreatorStep === 'mark-finish') {
      const distLabel = Math.max(240, Math.round(segmentDraftDistancePx));
      return (
        <div className="h-full min-h-0 w-full rounded-xl border-2 border-[#111111] bg-[#7FD1AE] shadow-[2.5px_2.5px_0px_#111111] px-2 py-1 flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onConfirmSegmentFinish}
            className="flex-1 min-w-0 text-left cursor-pointer focus:outline-none"
          >
            <div className="text-[10.5px] font-black uppercase leading-none text-[#111111]">
              🏁 [2] SET FINISH HERE
            </div>
            <div className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase text-[#111111]/80 truncate mt-0.5 leading-none">
              +{distLabel}PX • Save segment
            </div>
          </button>
          {onCancelSegmentCreator && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onCancelSegmentCreator}
              aria-label="Cancel Segment Creator"
              className="w-6 h-6 rounded border border-[#111111] bg-white hover:bg-[#EC6553] hover:text-white text-[10px] font-black flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer shrink-0"
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onStartSegmentCreator}
        className="h-full min-h-0 w-full rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-[#111111] bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] px-2.5 py-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-center cursor-pointer select-none transition-colors"
      >
        <span className="text-[13px] leading-none">✂️</span>
        <div className="min-w-0 text-left">
          <div className="text-[10.5px] font-black uppercase leading-none text-[#111111]">
            + NEW SEGMENT
          </div>
          <div className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase text-[#111111]/70 truncate mt-0.5 leading-none">
            Mark Start → Finish
          </div>
        </div>
      </button>
    );
  };

  if (layout === 'vertical') {
    return (
      <nav
        aria-label="Speedrun Segment Selector"
        onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredSlotId(null)}
        className={`${
          collapsed ? 'shrink-0' : expandedSolo ? 'flex-1' : 'flex-[45]'
        } min-h-0 w-full bg-[#EFE6CE] border-[3px] border-[#111111] rounded-2xl p-2.5 shadow-[inset_0_2px_0_#FFFDF7,inset_0_-3px_0_#D8CEB4,4px_5px_0px_#111111] flex flex-col gap-1.5`}
      >
        {/* Top Rack Header: Collapsible Trigger + 3-Room Trifecta Relay Toggle + Tactile ◀ / ▶ Stepper Buttons */}
        <div
          className={`shrink-0 h-[26px] flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 ${
            collapsed ? '' : 'pb-1.5 border-b-2 border-[#111111]/15'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
            {onToggleCollapse && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onToggleCollapse}
                aria-expanded={!collapsed}
                aria-label={collapsed ? 'Expand Pick a Segment' : 'Collapse Pick a Segment'}
                title={collapsed ? 'Expand Pick a Segment' : 'Collapse Pick a Segment'}
                className="w-[22px] h-[22px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111] font-black text-[10px] leading-none flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none shrink-0"
              >
                {collapsed ? '▸' : '▾'}
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onToggleCollapse}
              className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#111111] leading-none whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer text-left focus:outline-none"
            >
              PICK A SEGMENT
            </button>
            {collapsed && (
              <span
                style={{ backgroundColor: activeSlot.badgeBg }}
                className="px-1.5 py-[2px] rounded border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] text-[10px] font-black uppercase leading-none text-[#111111] truncate"
                title={`${activeSlot.fullTitle} • 👑 ${(activeStats.topMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s`}
              >
                {activeSlot.code}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
            {onCycleMutator && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onCycleMutator}
                aria-pressed={activeMutator !== 'none'}
                aria-label="Cycle Arcade Mutator (Standard, Mirror, Turbo)"
                title={
                  activeMutator === 'mirror'
                    ? 'Mirror Mode Active (Flipped Screen + Inverted Left/Right) — Click for Turbo'
                    : activeMutator === 'turbo'
                      ? 'Turbo Overclock Active (1.25x Emulation Speed) — Click for Standard'
                      : 'Standard 1x Speed — Click for Mirror or 1.25x Turbo Mutator'
                }
                className={`px-1.5 h-[22px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] font-black text-[8.5px] uppercase leading-none flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none transition-all duration-75 ${
                  activeMutator === 'mirror'
                    ? 'bg-[#7DD3FC] text-[#111111] shadow-[1.5px_1.5px_0_#111111]'
                    : activeMutator === 'turbo'
                      ? 'bg-[#FFAD87] text-[#111111] shadow-[1.5px_1.5px_0_#111111]'
                      : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#7DD3FC] text-[#111111]/90 shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none'
                }`}
              >
                {activeMutator === 'mirror'
                  ? '🪞 MIR'
                  : activeMutator === 'turbo'
                    ? '⚡1.25X'
                    : '1X'}
              </button>
            )}
            {isBuiltin && onToggleRelayMode && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onToggleRelayMode}
                aria-pressed={relayModeEnabled}
                aria-label="Toggle 3-Room Trifecta Relay"
                title={
                  relayModeEnabled
                    ? `Daily Trifecta 3-Room Relay Active (Leg ${relayLegIndex + 1}/3) — Click for Single Room`
                    : 'Daily Trifecta: Chain 3 Celeste segments back-to-back with a continuous relay clock'
                }
                className={`px-1.5 h-[22px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] font-black text-[9px] uppercase leading-none flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none transition-all duration-75 ${
                  relayModeEnabled
                    ? 'bg-[#E2A4FF] text-[#111111] shadow-[1.5px_1.5px_0_#111111]'
                    : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#E2A4FF] text-[#111111]/90 shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none'
                }`}
              >
                {relayModeEnabled ? `3X L${relayLegIndex + 1}/3` : '3X RELAY'}
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onStepLevel(-1)}
              aria-label="Previous Level"
              title="Previous Segment (Shortcut: [ or Controller LB)"
              className="w-[22px] h-[22px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111] font-black text-[9.5px] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none transition-all duration-75"
            >
              ◀
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onStepLevel(1)}
              aria-label="Next Level"
              title="Next Segment (Shortcut: ] or Controller RB)"
              className="w-[22px] h-[22px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111] font-black text-[9.5px] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none transition-all duration-75"
            >
              ▶
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* High-Legibility Segment Cards With Crisp Pixel-Art Preview Squares + Room Details */}
        {!collapsed && (
          <div
            className="flex-1 min-h-0 grid gap-[4px]"
            style={{ gridTemplateRows: `repeat(${totalVerticalRows}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }}
          >
            {slots.map((slot, idx) => {
              const isActive = idx === activeIdx;
              const { topMs, pbMs, beatTop, medal } = getSlotStats(slot);

              return (
                <div key={slot.id} className="relative h-full min-h-0 w-full group">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-current={isActive ? 'true' : undefined}
                    aria-label={`Select ${slot.fullTitle} (#1 Time ${(topMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s)`}
                    title={`${slot.fullTitle} — #1 Time: ${(topMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s${
                      pbMs !== null && medal
                        ? ` • Your PB: ${(pbMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s (${medal.emoji} ${medal.label} MEDAL)`
                        : ''
                    }`}
                    onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredSlotId(slot.id)}
                    onFocus={() => setHoveredSlotId(slot.id)}
                    onBlur={() => setHoveredSlotId(null)}
                    onClick={() => handleSelectSlot(slot, isActive)}
                    className={`h-full min-h-0 w-full rounded-xl border-2 border-[#111111] px-2 py-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-left cursor-pointer select-none focus:outline-none transition-all duration-100 ${
                      isActive
                        ? 'bg-[#FFE74C] shadow-[2.5px_2.5px_0px_#111111] -translate-x-[0.5px] -translate-y-[0.5px]'
                        : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFF7DC] shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] hover:-translate-y-[0.5px] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Framed Mini-CRT Pixel-Art Preview Square */}
                    <div
                      className={`${
                        expandedSolo ? 'h-[44px] w-[52px]' : 'h-[28px] w-[34px]'
                      } shrink-0 rounded-[6px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] p-[1px] transition-colors ${
                        isActive
                          ? 'bg-[#111111]'
                          : 'bg-[#EFE6CE] group-hover:bg-[#7FD1AE]'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="relative w-full h-full rounded-[4px] bg-[#000000] overflow-hidden">
                        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                        <img
                          src={slot.previewSrc}
                          alt={`${slot.code} ${slot.shortName} room preview`}
                          draggable={false}
                          className="w-full h-full block object-cover"
                          style={{ imageRendering: 'pixelated' }}
                        />
                        {beatTop && (
                          <span
                            title="You Beat the #1 Time!"
                            className="absolute top-[1px] right-[1px] bg-[#7FD1AE] text-[#111111] border border-[#111111] rounded-[2px] px-[2px] text-[7px] font-black leading-none"
                          >
                            ✓
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Right Room Metadata: Stage Code + Daily Tag + Room Title & #1 Time / PB */}
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex flex-col justify-center gap-[3px]">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 leading-none">
                        <span
                          style={{ backgroundColor: slot.badgeBg }}
                          className={`px-1.5 py-[1.5px] rounded border border-[#111111] ${
                            expandedSolo ? 'text-[11px]' : 'text-[9.5px]'
                          } font-black uppercase leading-none text-[#111111] shrink-0`}
                        >
                          {slot.code}
                        </span>
                        {slot.kind === 'daily' && (
                          <span className="bg-[#EC6553] text-white border border-[#111111] rounded px-1 py-[1.5px] text-[8px] font-black uppercase leading-none shrink-0">
                            DAILY
                          </span>
                        )}
                        <span
                          className={`${
                            expandedSolo ? 'text-[12.5px]' : 'text-[11px]'
                          } font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#111111] truncate leading-none`}
                        >
                          {slot.shortName}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <div
                        className={`flex items-center gap-2 ${
                          expandedSolo ? 'text-[11px]' : 'text-[9.5px]'
                        } font-black uppercase tabular-nums leading-none`}
                      >
                        <span className={isActive ? 'text-[#111111]' : 'text-[#111111]/85'}>
                          👑 {(topMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s
                        </span>
                        {pbMs !== null && (
                          <span
                            className={`truncate ${
                              beatTop ? 'text-[#0B5D3B]' : 'text-[#111111]/70'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {medal ? medal.emoji : beatTop ? '★' : 'PB'}{' '}
                            {(pbMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  {slot.customSegment && onDeleteCustomSegment && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        if (slot.customSegment) onDeleteCustomSegment(slot.customSegment);
                      }}
                      title={`Delete segment ${slot.code}`}
                      aria-label={`Delete segment ${slot.code}`}
                      className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-4 h-4 rounded-full border border-[#111111] bg-white hover:bg-[#EC6553] hover:text-white text-[8px] font-black flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition-opacity"
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}

            {renderCreatorCardVertical()}
          </div>
        )}
      </nav>
    );
  }

  return (
    <nav
      aria-label="Speedrun Segment Selector"
      onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredSlotId(null)}
      className="@container w-full mb-2 bg-[#EFE6CE] border-[3.5px] border-[#111111] rounded-2xl px-3 @[620px]:px-4 py-1.5 shadow-[inset_0_2px_0_#FFFDF7,inset_0_-3px_0_#D8CEB4,4px_4px_0px_#111111] flex flex-col min-[540px]:flex-row min-[540px]:items-center justify-between gap-1.5 min-[540px]:gap-2.5 @[620px]:gap-4"
    >
      {/* Left Dock: Collapsible Header + Active/Hovered Segment Details + Prev/Next Steppers */}
      <div
        className={`${
          collapsed ? 'w-full flex-row' : 'min-[540px]:w-[168px] flex-row min-[540px]:flex-col'
        } shrink-0 flex items-center min-[540px]:items-stretch justify-between gap-2`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            {onToggleCollapse && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onToggleCollapse}
                aria-expanded={!collapsed}
                aria-label={collapsed ? 'Expand Pick a Segment' : 'Collapse Pick a Segment'}
                className="w-[22px] h-[20px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111] font-black text-[9.5px] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111]"
              >
                {collapsed ? '▸' : '▾'}
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onToggleCollapse}
              className="text-[10.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#111111] leading-none whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer"
            >
              PICK A SEGMENT
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="hidden min-[540px]:flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onStepLevel(-1)}
              aria-label="Previous Level"
              title="Previous Segment (Shortcut: [ or Controller LB)"
              className="w-[22px] h-[20px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111] font-black text-[9px] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none transition-all duration-75"
            >
              ◀
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onStepLevel(1)}
              aria-label="Next Level"
              title="Next Segment (Shortcut: ] or Controller RB)"
              className="w-[22px] h-[20px] rounded-[5px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111] font-black text-[9px] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none shadow-[0_1.5px_0_#111111] active:translate-y-[1px] active:shadow-none transition-all duration-75"
            >
              ▶
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 leading-none min-[540px]:mt-1">
          <span
            style={{ backgroundColor: displaySlot.badgeBg }}
            className="px-1.5 py-[2px] rounded border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase leading-none text-[#111111] shrink-0"
          >
            {displaySlot.code}
          </span>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#111111] truncate leading-none">
            {displaySlot.shortName}
          </span>
          {isBuiltin && onToggleRelayMode && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onToggleRelayMode}
              aria-pressed={relayModeEnabled}
              aria-label="Toggle 3-Room Trifecta Relay"
              className={`px-1.5 h-[19px] rounded-[4px] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] font-black text-[8.5px] uppercase leading-none flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer select-none shrink-0 ${
                relayModeEnabled ? 'bg-[#E2A4FF] text-[#111111]' : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] text-[#111111]'
              }`}
            >
              {relayModeEnabled ? `3X L${relayLegIndex + 1}/3` : '3X RELAY'}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {!collapsed && (
          <div className="hidden min-[540px]:flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tabular-nums leading-none mt-1.5">
            {displaySlot.kind === 'daily' && (
              <span className="bg-[#EC6553] text-white border border-[#111111] rounded px-1 py-[1px] text-[8px] leading-none shrink-0">
                DAILY
              </span>
            )}
            <span className="text-[#111111]/85 whitespace-nowrap">
              👑 {(displayStats.topMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s
            </span>
            {displayStats.pbMs !== null ? (
              <span
                className={`whitespace-nowrap truncate ${
                  displayStats.beatTop ? 'text-[#0B5D3B]' : 'text-[#111111]/65'
                }`}
              >
                {displayStats.beatTop ? '★' : 'PB'} {(displayStats.pbMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s
              </span>
            ) : !isDisplayingActive ? (
              <span className="text-[#0B5D3B] whitespace-nowrap">PLAY ▶</span>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-[#111111]/55 whitespace-nowrap">
                {isAttractMode ? 'DEMO' : 'LIVE'}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Recessed Console Deck Seam */}
      {!collapsed && (
        <div
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="hidden min-[540px]:block w-[2px] h-12 bg-[#111111]/15 rounded-full shrink-0"
        />
      )}

      {/* Right Zone: Tactile Squares With Crisp Pixel-Art Room Previews */}
      {!collapsed && (
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex items-center justify-between min-[660px]:justify-around gap-1.5">
          {slots.map((slot, idx) => {
            const isActive = idx === activeIdx;
            const { topMs, pbMs, beatTop } = getSlotStats(slot);

            return (
              <button
                key={slot.id}
                type="button"
                aria-current={isActive ? 'true' : undefined}
                aria-label={`Select ${slot.fullTitle} (#1 Time ${(topMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s)`}
                title={`${slot.fullTitle} — #1 Time: ${(topMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s${
                  pbMs !== null ? ` • Your PB: ${(pbMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s` : ''
                }`}
                onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredSlotId(slot.id)}
                onFocus={() => setHoveredSlotId(slot.id)}
                onBlur={() => setHoveredSlotId(null)}
                onClick={() => handleSelectSlot(slot, isActive)}
                className="group flex-1 max-w-[56px] flex flex-col items-center gap-[3px] cursor-pointer select-none focus:outline-none"
              >
                <div
                  className={`w-full rounded-[9px] border-2 border-[#111111] p-[2px] transition-all duration-100 ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-[#FFE74C] shadow-[2.5px_2.5px_0px_#111111] -translate-y-[1.5px]'
                      : 'bg-[#FFFDF7] group-hover:bg-[#7FD1AE] shadow-[0_2px_0_#111111] group-hover:-translate-y-[1px] group-active:translate-y-[1px] group-active:shadow-none'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="relative w-full aspect-[16/15] rounded-[5.5px] bg-[#000000] border border-[#111111]/80 overflow-hidden">
                    {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                    <img
                      src={slot.previewSrc}
                      alt={`${slot.code} ${slot.shortName} room preview`}
                      draggable={false}
                      className="w-full h-full block object-cover"
                      style={{ imageRendering: 'pixelated' }}
                    />
                    {slot.kind === 'daily' && (
                      <span
                        title="Today's Daily Segment"
                        className="absolute top-[2px] right-[2px] bg-[#EC6553] text-white border border-[#111111] rounded-[3px] px-[2.5px] py-[0.5px] text-[7px] font-black leading-none shadow-[0_1px_0_#111111]"
                      >
                        ★
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {beatTop && slot.kind !== 'daily' && (
                      <span
                        title="You Beat the #1 Time!"
                        className="absolute top-[2px] right-[2px] bg-[#7FD1AE] text-[#111111] border border-[#111111] rounded-[3px] px-[2.5px] py-[0.5px] text-[7px] font-black leading-none"
                      >
                        ✓
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <span
                  className={`px-1 py-[1.5px] rounded text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase leading-none tracking-tight whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111] border-[1.5px] border-[#111111] shadow-[1px_1px_0_#111111]'
                      : 'text-[#111111]/85 group-hover:text-[#111111] group-hover:bg-[#FFFDF7]'
                  }`}
                >
                  {slot.code}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}

          {showCreatorSlot && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={
                segmentCreatorStep === 'mark-start'
                  ? onConfirmSegmentStart
                  : segmentCreatorStep === 'mark-finish'
                    ? onConfirmSegmentFinish
                    : onStartSegmentCreator
              }
              className="flex-1 max-w-[56px] flex flex-col items-center gap-[3px] cursor-pointer select-none focus:outline-none"
            >
              <div
                className={`w-full aspect-[16/15] rounded-[9px] border-2 border-[#111111] flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-black ${
                  segmentCreatorStep === 'mark-start'
                    ? 'bg-[#FFE74C]'
                    : segmentCreatorStep === 'mark-finish'
                      ? 'bg-[#7FD1AE]'
                      : 'border-dashed bg-[#FFFDF7] hover:bg-[#FFE74C]'
                }`}
              >
                {segmentCreatorStep === 'mark-start'
                  ? '📍'
                  : segmentCreatorStep === 'mark-finish'
                    ? '🏁'
                    : '✂️'}
              </div>
              <span className="px-1 py-[1.5px] rounded text-[9px] font-black uppercase leading-none">
                {segmentCreatorStep === 'mark-start'
                  ? 'START'
                  : segmentCreatorStep === 'mark-finish'
                    ? 'GOAL'
                    : '+NEW'}
              </span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </nav>
  );
}

```

`components/VictoryShareModal.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { evaluateRoomMedal, formatDailyNumber } from '@/lib/dailySprints';
import {
  downloadBlockyBragCardPng,
  encodeStatelessGhostToken,
  formatViralDareMessage,
  sanitizeArcadeTag,
  tagToSlug,
} from '@/lib/ghostShare';
import { computeRunSplitEntries } from '@/lib/splitTracker';
import {
  ArcadeIdentityInfo,
  ConsoleSystemId,
  GhostKeyframe,
  GhostRun,
  RivalrySeriesSummary,
} from '@/lib/types';
import { FinalizedVideoClip } from '@/lib/videoClipRecorder';

interface VictoryShareModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  clientRunId: string;
  savedSlug?: string;
  initialSavedTag: string;
  timeMs: number;
  beatenCount: number;
  totalGhosts: number;
  emojiStrip: string;
  romId: string;
  consoleSystem?: ConsoleSystemId;
  sprintId?: string;
  romTitle: string;
  dailyNumber?: number;
  courseIndex?: number;
  startWorldX?: number;
  goalWorldX?: number;
  frames: GhostKeyframe[];
  inputLog?: string;
  verified?: boolean;
  isDare?: boolean;
  parentSlug?: string | null;
  rivalrySeries?: RivalrySeriesSummary | null;
  relayLegTimesMs?: readonly number[] | null;
  pbGhost?: GhostRun | null;
  targetGhost: GhostRun | null;
  playerTag: string;
  replayClip?: FinalizedVideoClip | null;
  identityInfo?: ArcadeIdentityInfo | null;
  tagConflictMessage?: string | null;
  onChangeTag: (newTag: string) => void;
  onIdentityUpdated?: (identity: ArcadeIdentityInfo, conflictMsg?: string | null) => void;
  onRunSaved: () => void;
  onWatchInputReplay?: () => void;
  onRaceAgain: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

async function copyTextToClipboard(text: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      return true;
    } catch {
      // Fall back to execCommand below
    }
  }
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    const ok = document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    return ok;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export default function VictoryShareModal({
  isOpen,
  clientRunId,
  savedSlug,
  initialSavedTag,
  timeMs,
  beatenCount,
  totalGhosts,
  emojiStrip,
  romId,
  consoleSystem,
  sprintId,
  romTitle,
  dailyNumber,
  courseIndex,
  startWorldX,
  goalWorldX,
  frames,
  inputLog,
  verified,
  isDare,
  parentSlug,
  rivalrySeries,
  relayLegTimesMs,
  pbGhost,
  targetGhost,
  playerTag,
  replayClip,
  identityInfo,
  tagConflictMessage,
  onChangeTag,
  onIdentityUpdated,
  onRunSaved,
  onWatchInputReplay,
  onRaceAgain,
  onClose,
}: VictoryShareModalProps) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [renamedSlugState, setRenamedSlugState] = useState<{
    runId: string;
    tag: string;
    slug: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const copiedTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const lastSavedRunIdRef = useRef<string>('');
  const lastSavedTagRef = useRef<string>('');

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (copiedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copiedTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const cleanTag = sanitizeArcadeTag(playerTag);
  const plainTagSlug = tagToSlug(cleanTag);
  const savedSuffix = savedSlug && savedSlug.includes('-') ? savedSlug.split('-')[1] : '';
  const slug =
    renamedSlugState &&
    renamedSlugState.runId === clientRunId &&
    renamedSlugState.tag === cleanTag
      ? renamedSlugState.slug
      : savedSlug && cleanTag === sanitizeArcadeTag(initialSavedTag)
        ? savedSlug
        : savedSuffix
          ? `${plainTagSlug}-${savedSuffix}`
          : plainTagSlug;
  const secs = (timeMs / 1000).toFixed(2).padStart(5, '0');
  const dailyBadge = typeof dailyNumber === 'number' ? ` ${formatDailyNumber(dailyNumber)}` : '';

  const deltaTargetSec = targetGhost ? (timeMs - targetGhost.timeMs) / 1000 : null;
  const beatTarget = deltaTargetSec !== null && deltaTargetSec <= 0;

  const statelessToken = encodeStatelessGhostToken({
    tag: cleanTag,
    romId,
    consoleSystem,
    sprintId,
    romTitle,
    timeMs,
    beatenCount,
    totalGhosts,
    emojiReceipt: emojiStrip,
    frames,
    dailyNumber,
    courseIndex,
    startWorldX,
    goalWorldX,
    verified,
  });

  const origin = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : 'https://bitgeist.gg';
  const fullShareUrl = statelessToken
    ? `${origin}/vs/${slug}?g=${statelessToken}`
    : `${origin}/vs/${slug}`;
  const displayShareUrl =
    typeof window !== 'undefined'
      ? `${window.location.host}/vs/${slug}`
      : `bitgeist.gg/vs/${slug}`;

  const shareMessage = formatViralDareMessage({
    tag: cleanTag,
    timeMs,
    emojiStrip,
    beatenCount,
    totalGhosts,
    targetTag: targetGhost?.tag,
    deltaTargetSec,
    isDare,
    shareUrl: fullShareUrl,
    dailyNumber,
    verified,
  });

  const persistRenamedTagIfNeeded = async () => {
    const previouslySavedTag =
      lastSavedRunIdRef.current === clientRunId
        ? lastSavedTagRef.current
        : sanitizeArcadeTag(initialSavedTag);
    if (!clientRunId || previouslySavedTag === cleanTag) return;
    lastSavedRunIdRef.current = clientRunId;
    lastSavedTagRef.current = cleanTag;
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/ghosts', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          clientRunId,
          tag: cleanTag,
          romId,
          consoleSystem,
          sprintId,
          romTitle,
          timeMs,
          beatenCount,
          totalGhosts,
          emojiReceipt: emojiStrip,
          frames,
          dailyNumber,
          courseIndex,
          startWorldX,
          goalWorldX,
          inputLog,
          parentSlug: parentSlug || undefined,
          rivalTag: targetGhost?.tag,
        }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = (await res.json()) as {
          run?: { slug?: string; tag?: string };
          identity?: ArcadeIdentityInfo;
          tagConflict?: { requestedTag: string; assignedTag: string; message?: string } | null;
        };
        if (data?.run?.slug) {
          const effectiveTag = data.run.tag ? sanitizeArcadeTag(data.run.tag) : cleanTag;
          if (effectiveTag !== cleanTag) {
            onChangeTag(effectiveTag);
          }
          setRenamedSlugState({
            runId: clientRunId,
            tag: effectiveTag,
            slug: data.run.slug,
          });
        }
        if (data?.identity && onIdentityUpdated) {
          const msg = data.tagConflict
            ? data.tagConflict.message ||
              `@${data.tagConflict.requestedTag} is claimed — saved as @${data.tagConflict.assignedTag}`
            : null;
          onIdentityUpdated(data.identity, msg);
        }
        onRunSaved();
      }
    } catch {
      // Stateless URL fallback still works
    }
  };

  const handlePostToX = () => {
    void persistRenamedTagIfNeeded();
    const intentUrl = `https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=${encodeURIComponent(shareMessage)}`;
    window.open(intentUrl, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  };

  const handleCopyOrNativeShare = async () => {
    void persistRenamedTagIfNeeded();
    if (
      typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
      'share' in navigator &&
      /Mobi|Android|iPhone/i.test(navigator.userAgent)
    ) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({
          title: `Beat @${cleanTag}'s ${secs}s Ghost on Bitgeist!`,
          text: shareMessage,
          url: fullShareUrl,
        });
        return;
      } catch {
        // Fall through to clipboard copy
      }
    }
    const ok = await copyTextToClipboard(shareMessage);
    if (ok) {
      setCopied(true);
      if (copiedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copiedTimerRef.current);
      copiedTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1600);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadCard = () => {
    void persistRenamedTagIfNeeded();
    downloadBlockyBragCardPng({
      tag: cleanTag,
      timeMs,
      beatenCount,
      totalGhosts,
      targetTag: targetGhost?.tag,
      deltaTargetSec,
      romTitle,
      shareUrlDisplay: displayShareUrl,
      dailyNumber,
      verified,
    });
  };

  const handleDownloadVideoClip = () => {
    if (!replayClip) return;
    void persistRenamedTagIfNeeded();
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = replayClip.url;
    a.download = `bitgeist-${plainTagSlug}-${secs}s.${replayClip.ext}`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
  };

  const secondaryButtonsCount =
    2 + (replayClip ? 1 : 0) + (Boolean(inputLog) && onWatchInputReplay ? 1 : 0);

  const splitEntries = computeRunSplitEntries({
    runnerFrames: frames,
    runnerTimeMs: timeMs,
    startWorldX,
    goalWorldX,
    targetGhost,
    pbGhost,
    relayLegTimesMs,
  });

  const medalInfo = evaluateRoomMedal(timeMs, targetGhost?.timeMs ?? 17500);

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Race Victory Summary"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
      className="modal-backdrop-fade fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[#111111]/70 flex items-center justify-center p-4 overflow-y-auto font-mono"
    >
      <div className="modal-card-pop bg-[#FFF9E6] border-4 border-[#111111] rounded-2xl shadow-[9px_9px_0px_#111111] max-w-sm w-full overflow-hidden my-auto">
        {/* Top Golden Finish Banner */}
        <div className="bg-[#F5C342] border-b-4 border-[#111111] px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-base md:text-lg font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#111111]">
            🏁 FINISHED IN {secs}s!
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="retro-btn bg-white px-2.5 py-0.5 text-sm text-[#111111]"
            aria-label="Close Victory Modal"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 space-y-3.5 text-[#111111]">
          {/* Clear 1v1 #1 / Dare Comparison */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-[#F7EED7] border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-xl px-3 py-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase">
              {targetGhost
                ? beatTarget
                  ? isDare
                    ? '⚔️ DARE CONQUERED!'
                    : '👑 NEW #1 RECORD!'
                  : `CHASING #1 @${targetGhost.tag}`
                : '👑 NEW #1 RECORD!'}
            </span>
            {targetGhost && deltaTargetSec !== null && (
              <span
                className={`${
                  beatTarget ? 'bg-[#7FD1AE]' : 'bg-[#FFE74C]'
                } border border-[#111111] rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-black uppercase`}
              >
                {beatTarget
                  ? `${deltaTargetSec.toFixed(2)}s VS @${targetGhost.tag}`
                  : `+${deltaTargetSec.toFixed(2)}s VS @${targetGhost.tag}`}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Stage 12: Trackmania-Style 4-Tier Room Medal & Next-Tier Target Strip */}
          <div
            aria-label="Room Medal Tier"
            className="bg-[#EFE6CE] border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10.5px] font-black uppercase"
          >
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-sm leading-none">{medalInfo.emoji}</span>
              <span>{medalInfo.label}</span>
            </span>
            {medalInfo.nextTier && typeof medalInfo.msToNext === 'number' ? (
              <span className="bg-[#FFFDF7] border border-[#111111] rounded px-2 py-0.5 tabular-nums text-[9.5px] text-[#111111]/85">
                NEXT {medalInfo.nextEmoji} {medalInfo.nextLabel}: -
                {(medalInfo.msToNext / 1000).toFixed(2)}s
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="bg-[#7FD1AE] border border-[#111111] rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[9.5px] text-[#111111]">
                ✨ MAX TIER UNLOCKED
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Stage 6: Gold / Mint / Coral 3-Sector Micro-Split Strip */}
          {splitEntries.length > 0 && (
            <div
              aria-label="Run Sector Splits"
              className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5"
            >
              {splitEntries.map((sp) => {
                const bgClass =
                  sp.status === 'gold'
                    ? 'bg-[#FFE74C]'
                    : sp.status === 'mint'
                      ? 'bg-[#7FD1AE]'
                      : 'bg-[#FFAD87]';
                const deltaSec =
                  sp.deltaVsRivalMs !== null ? sp.deltaVsRivalMs / 1000 : null;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={sp.label}
                    className={`${bgClass} border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-xl px-2 py-1 text-center shadow-[1.5px_1.5px_0_#111111]`}
                  >
                    <div className="text-[8.5px] font-black uppercase leading-none text-[#111111]/75">
                      {sp.label}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-black tabular-nums leading-tight text-[#111111] mt-0.5">
                      {(sp.runnerMs / 1000).toFixed(2)}s
                    </div>
                    {deltaSec !== null && (
                      <div className="text-[8px] font-black tabular-nums leading-none text-[#111111]/85">
                        {deltaSec <= 0 ? `${deltaSec.toFixed(2)}s` : `+${deltaSec.toFixed(2)}s`}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Stage 7: Head-to-Head Rivalry Series Scoreboard */}
          {rivalrySeries && rivalrySeries.totalBouts > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-[#EFE6CE] border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10px] font-black uppercase">
              <span>⚔️ RIVALRY SERIES</span>
              <span className="bg-[#111111] text-[#FFE74C] rounded px-2 py-0.5 tabular-nums">
                @{cleanTag} {rivalrySeries.playerWins} – {rivalrySeries.rivalWins} @{rivalrySeries.rivalTag}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Player Name + Zero-Signup Identity / Streak + Dare Card Preview */}
          <div className="bg-white border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-xl p-3 space-y-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-2 border-b-2 border-dashed border-[#111111]/15">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                <label htmlFor="arcade-tag-input" className="text-xs font-black uppercase">
                  YOUR NAME:
                </label>
                {identityInfo?.ownedBySession && (
                  <span
                    title="Claimed & protected on your device"
                    className="bg-[#7FD1AE] border border-[#111111] rounded px-1 py-px text-[8.5px] font-black uppercase leading-none"
                  >
                    🔒
                  </span>
                )}
                {identityInfo && identityInfo.streakCount > 0 && (
                  <span
                    title={`${identityInfo.streakCount}-day Daily Sprint streak`}
                    className="bg-[#EC6553] text-white border border-[#111111] rounded px-1 py-px text-[8.5px] font-black uppercase leading-none"
                  >
                    🔥{identityInfo.streakCount}D
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <input
                id="arcade-tag-input"
                type="text"
                maxLength={9}
                value={playerTag}
                onChange={(e) => onChangeTag(e.target.value.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9_]/g, ''))}
                onBlur={() => void persistRenamedTagIfNeeded()}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.currentTarget.blur();
                    void persistRenamedTagIfNeeded();
                  } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    e.currentTarget.blur();
                    void persistRenamedTagIfNeeded();
                    onClose();
                  }
                }}
                placeholder="PLAYER"
                className="w-28 bg-[#FFF9E6] border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-md px-2 py-1 font-black text-center uppercase text-xs focus:outline-none focus:bg-[#F5C342]/30"
              />
            </div>

            {tagConflictMessage && (
              <div className="bg-[#FFE74C] border border-[#111111] rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-black uppercase">
                {tagConflictMessage}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="space-y-1 text-left">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-black uppercase text-[#111111]/75">
                <span>BITGEIST{dailyBadge}</span>
                <span>{targetGhost ? `1V1 VS @${targetGhost.tag}` : 'TOP SPEEDRUN'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-base tracking-widest leading-snug">{emojiStrip}</div>
              <div className="text-xs font-black text-[#2b50ec] truncate">{displayShareUrl}</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Primary Actions: Challenge Friends + Race Again */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void handleCopyOrNativeShare()}
              className="w-full retro-btn bg-[#7FD1AE] text-[#111111] py-2.5 px-3 text-xs uppercase"
            >
              {copied ? '✓ DARE LINK COPIED!' : '🔗 COPY DARE LINK FOR FRIENDS'}
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                void persistRenamedTagIfNeeded();
                onRaceAgain();
              }}
              className="w-full retro-btn bg-[#F5C342] text-[#111111] py-2.5 px-3 text-xs uppercase"
            >
              ↺ RACE AGAIN
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Compact Secondary Share / 15s Video Clip / Replay Pills */}
          <div
            className={`grid ${
              secondaryButtonsCount >= 4
                ? 'grid-cols-4'
                : secondaryButtonsCount === 3
                  ? 'grid-cols-3'
                  : 'grid-cols-2'
            } gap-1.5`}
          >
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePostToX}
              className="retro-btn bg-[#FFFDF7] text-[#111111] py-1.5 px-1.5 text-[10.5px] uppercase whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              𝕏 POST
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleDownloadCard}
              className="retro-btn bg-[#FFFDF7] text-[#111111] py-1.5 px-1.5 text-[10.5px] uppercase whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              📸 CARD
            </button>

            {replayClip && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleDownloadVideoClip}
                title={`Download 15s ${replayClip.ext.toUpperCase()} gameplay + ghost clip`}
                className="retro-btn bg-[#FFE74C] text-[#111111] py-1.5 px-1.5 text-[10.5px] uppercase whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                🎬 CLIP
              </button>
            )}

            {Boolean(inputLog) && onWatchInputReplay && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  void persistRenamedTagIfNeeded();
                  onWatchInputReplay();
                }}
                className="retro-btn bg-[#FFFDF7] text-[#111111] py-1.5 px-1.5 text-[10.5px] uppercase whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                ▶ REPLAY
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
// Epoch: 2026-09-20T00:00:00Z -> rotates deterministically across all 6 CelesteNES courses at 00:00 UTC
const DAILY_EPOCH_UTC_MS = Date.UTC(2026, 8, 20);
const MS_PER_DAY = 86_400_000;
const DAILY_PB_STORAGE_KEY = 'bitgeist_daily_pb_celeste_v1';
const SPRINT_PB_STORAGE_KEY = 'bitgeist_sprint_pb_v1';

export interface DailySprintChallenge {
  dailyNumber: number;
  badgeText: string;
  sprintId: string;
  course: SprintCourse;
  headerStageLabel: string;
  cartridgeKey: BuiltinCartridgeKey;
  romId: string;
  consoleSystem: ConsoleSystemId;
  romUrl: string;
  fileName: string;
}

export function formatDailyNumber(dailyNumber: number): string {
  return `#${String(Math.max(1, Math.round(dailyNumber))).padStart(3, '0')}`;
}

export function getCourseByIndex(courseIndex?: number): SprintCourse {
  if (typeof courseIndex === 'number') {
    const found = CELESTE_SPRINT_COURSES.find((c) => c.courseIndex === courseIndex);
    if (found) return found;
  }
  return CELESTE_SPRINT_COURSES[0];
}

export function getDailySprintByNumber(dailyNumber: number): DailySprintChallenge {
  const safeNum = Math.max(1, Math.round(dailyNumber));
  const badgeText = formatDailyNumber(safeNum);
  const course = CELESTE_SPRINT_COURSES[(safeNum - 1) % CELESTE_SPRINT_COURSES.length];
  return {
    dailyNumber: safeNum,
    badgeText,
    sprintId: `daily-${safeNum}`,
    course,
    headerStageLabel: `${badgeText} • CELESTE ${course.code}`,
    cartridgeKey: 'celeste-nes',
    romId: CELESTE_NES_ROM_ID,
    consoleSystem: 'nes',
    romUrl: '/roms/celeste.nes',
    fileName: 'celeste.nes',
  };
}

export function getDailySprintForDate(now: Date = new Date()): DailySprintChallenge {
  const utcMidnightMs = Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), now.getUTCDate());
  const daysSinceEpoch = Math.floor((utcMidnightMs - DAILY_EPOCH_UTC_MS) / MS_PER_DAY);
  const dailyNumber = Math.max(1, daysSinceEpoch + 1);
  return getDailySprintByNumber(dailyNumber);
}

export function getLocalDailyPbMs(dailyNumber: number): number | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(DAILY_PB_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const map = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, number>;
    const val = map[String(dailyNumber)];
    return typeof val === 'number' && Number.isFinite(val) && val >= 1000 ? val : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function recordLocalDailyPbMs(dailyNumber: number, timeMs: number): number {
  const rounded = Math.max(1000, Math.round(timeMs));
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return rounded;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(DAILY_PB_STORAGE_KEY);
    const map = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, number>) : {};
    const key = String(dailyNumber);
    const prev = map[key];
    const best = typeof prev === 'number' && prev >= 1000 ? Math.min(prev, rounded) : rounded;
    map[key] = best;

    // Prune older entries beyond the most recent 45 dailies to keep localStorage tiny
    const keys = Object.keys(map)
      .map(Number)
      .filter(Number.isFinite)
      .sort((a, b) => b - a);
    const trimmed: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const k of keys.slice(0, 45)) {
      trimmed[String(k)] = map[String(k)];
    }
    localStorage.setItem(DAILY_PB_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(trimmed));
    recordLocalSprintPbMs(`daily-${dailyNumber}`, best);
    return best;
  } catch {
    return rounded;
  }
}

export function getLocalSprintPbMs(sprintId: string): number | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !sprintId) return null;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(SPRINT_PB_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const map = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, { pbMs: number; updatedAt: number } | number>;
    const entry = map[sprintId];
    const val = typeof entry === 'number' ? entry : entry?.pbMs;
    return typeof val === 'number' && Number.isFinite(val) && val >= 1000 ? val : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function recordLocalSprintPbMs(sprintId: string, timeMs: number): number {
  const rounded = Math.max(1000, Math.round(timeMs));
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !sprintId) return rounded;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(SPRINT_PB_STORAGE_KEY);
    const parsed = raw
      ? (JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, { pbMs: number; updatedAt: number } | number>)
      : {};
    const prevEntry = parsed[sprintId];
    const prevVal = typeof prevEntry === 'number' ? prevEntry : prevEntry?.pbMs;
    const best =
      typeof prevVal === 'number' && Number.isFinite(prevVal) && prevVal >= 1000
        ? Math.min(prevVal, rounded)
        : rounded;

    const normalized: Array<[string, { pbMs: number; updatedAt: number }]> = [];
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(parsed)) {
      if (k === sprintId) continue;
      const pb = typeof v === 'number' ? v : v?.pbMs;
      const ts = typeof v === 'object' && v && typeof v.updatedAt === 'number' ? v.updatedAt : 0;
      if (typeof pb === 'number' && Number.isFinite(pb) && pb >= 1000) {
        normalized.push([k, { pbMs: pb, updatedAt: ts }]);
      }
    }
    normalized.push([sprintId, { pbMs: best, updatedAt: now }]);
    normalized.sort((a, b) => b[1].updatedAt - a[1].updatedAt);

    const trimmed: Record<string, { pbMs: number; updatedAt: number }> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of normalized.slice(0, 80)) {
      trimmed[k] = v;
    }
    localStorage.setItem(SPRINT_PB_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(trimmed));
    return best;
  } catch {
    return rounded;
  }
}

/**
 * Evaluates a Trackmania-style 4-tier speedrun medal (`💎 DEV`, `🥇 GOLD`, `🥈 SILVER`, `🥉 BRONZE`)
 * relative to a segment's #1 benchmark time (`topBenchmarkMs`).
 */
export function evaluateRoomMedal(
  timeMs: number | null | undefined,
  topBenchmarkMs: number
): RoomMedalInfo {
  const devMs = Math.max(1000, Math.round(topBenchmarkMs));
  const goldMs = Math.round(devMs * 1.07);
  const silverMs = Math.round(devMs * 1.18);

  if (typeof timeMs !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(timeMs) || timeMs < 1000) {
    return {
      tier: 'none',
      emoji: '⚪',
      label: 'UNRANKED',
      nextTier: 'bronze',
      nextEmoji: '🥉',
      nextLabel: 'BRONZE',
      nextTargetMs: silverMs,
    };
  }

  const rounded = Math.round(timeMs);
  if (rounded <= devMs) {
    return {
      tier: 'dev',
      emoji: '💎',
      label: 'DEV MEDAL',
    };
  }
  if (rounded <= goldMs) {
    return {
      tier: 'gold',
      emoji: '🥇',
      label: 'GOLD MEDAL',
      nextTier: 'dev',
      nextEmoji: '💎',
      nextLabel: 'DEV',
      nextTargetMs: devMs,
      msToNext: rounded - devMs,
    };
  }
  if (rounded <= silverMs) {
    return {
      tier: 'silver',
      emoji: '🥈',
      label: 'SILVER MEDAL',
      nextTier: 'gold',
      nextEmoji: '🥇',
      nextLabel: 'GOLD',
      nextTargetMs: goldMs,
      msToNext: rounded - goldMs,
    };
  }
  return {
    tier: 'bronze',
    emoji: '🥉',
    label: 'BRONZE MEDAL',
    nextTier: 'silver',
    nextEmoji: '🥈',
    nextLabel: 'SILVER',
    nextTargetMs: silverMs,
    msToNext: rounded - silverMs,
  };
}
```

```ts
import {

  NES_INPUT_DOWN,

  NES_INPUT_RIGHT,
  NES_INPUT_SELECT,
  NES_INPUT_START,
  NES_INPUT_UP,
} from './inputReplay';
import type { ConsoleSystemId } from './types';

export interface GamepadPollSnapshot {
  connected: boolean;
  controllerLabel: string | null;
  shortBrandLabel: string | null;
  buttonsMask: number;
  virtualButtons: string[];
  anyActionOrDirPressed: boolean;
  aJustPressed: boolean;
  bJustPressed: boolean;
  startJustPressed: boolean;
  selectJustPressed: boolean;
  prevSegmentJustPressed: boolean;
  nextSegmentJustPressed: boolean;
}

export type GamepadRumblePreset = 'start' | 'overtake' | 'death' | 'victory' | 'step';

const RADIAL_DEADZONE = 0.32;
// sin(22.5 deg) = 0.38268 -> divides 360 deg into 8 equal 45-degree octants for crisp diagonal dashes
const OCTANT_SIN_THRESHOLD = 0.3827;
const TRIGGER_THRESHOLD = 0.35;

interface GamepadHapticActuatorLike {
  playEffect?: (
    type: string,
    params: {
      startDelay?: number;
      duration: number;
      weakMagnitude: number;
      strongMagnitude: number;
    }
  ) => Promise<unknown>;
  pulse?: (value: number, duration: number) => Promise<unknown>;
}

type ExtendedGamepad = Gamepad & {
  vibrationActuator?: GamepadHapticActuatorLike | null;
};

function isBtnPressed(btn: GamepadButton | undefined, threshold = TRIGGER_THRESHOLD): boolean {
  if (!btn) return false;
  return Boolean(btn.pressed) || (typeof btn.value === 'number' && btn.value > threshold);
}

function hasAnyPadActivity(pad: Gamepad): boolean {
  for (let i = 0; i < pad.buttons.length; i++) {
    if (isBtnPressed(pad.buttons[i])) return true;
  }
  const ax = pad.axes[0] ?? 0;
  const ay = pad.axes[1] ?? 0;
  return Math.hypot(ax, ay) > RADIAL_DEADZONE;
}

export function detectControllerShortBrand(rawId: string): string {
  const s = rawId.toLowerCase();
  if (s.includes('dualsense') || s.includes('054c') && s.includes('0ce6')) return 'PS5 PAD';
  if (s.includes('dualshock') || s.includes('playstation') || s.includes('054c')) return 'PS4 PAD';
  if (s.includes('xbox') || s.includes('xinput') || s.includes('045e')) return 'XBOX PAD';
  if (s.includes('8bitdo') || s.includes('2dc8')) return '8BITDO';
  if (s.includes('switch') || s.includes('joy-con') || s.includes('pro controller') || s.includes('057e')) {
    return 'SWITCH';
  }
  return 'PAD';
}

const DISCONNECTED_SNAPSHOT: GamepadPollSnapshot = {
  connected: false,
  controllerLabel: null,
  shortBrandLabel: null,
  buttonsMask: 0,
  virtualButtons: [],
  anyActionOrDirPressed: false,
  aJustPressed: false,
  bJustPressed: false,
  startJustPressed: false,
  selectJustPressed: false,
  prevSegmentJustPressed: false,
  nextSegmentJustPressed: false,
};

export class GamepadPoller {
  private lastActivePadIndex: number = -1;
  private usedInSession = false;
  private prevAPressed = false;
  private prevBPressed = false;
  private prevStartPressed = false;
  private prevSelectPressed = false;
  private prevL1Pressed = false;
  private prevR1Pressed = false;

  private resetEdges(): void {
    this.prevAPressed = false;
    this.prevBPressed = false;
    this.prevStartPressed = false;
    this.prevSelectPressed = false;
    this.prevL1Pressed = false;
    this.prevR1Pressed = false;
  }

  poll(
    consoleSystem: ConsoleSystemId = 'nes',
    isCelesteSprint: boolean = true
  ): GamepadPollSnapshot {
    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || typeof navigator.getGamepads !== 'function') {
      this.resetEdges();
      return DISCONNECTED_SNAPSHOT;
    }

    let pads: (Gamepad | null)[];
    try {
      pads = navigator.getGamepads();
    } catch {
      this.resetEdges();
      return DISCONNECTED_SNAPSHOT;
    }

    // 1. Dynamically lock onto whichever connected gamepad most recently saw live input,
    // avoiding dummy virtual HID devices (keyboards/pedals) occupying slot 0.
    let activePad: Gamepad | null = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < pads.length; i++) {
      const p = pads[i];
      if (p && p.connected && hasAnyPadActivity(p)) {
        this.lastActivePadIndex = p.index;
        this.usedInSession = true;
        activePad = p;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!activePad && this.lastActivePadIndex >= 0) {
      const remembered = pads[this.lastActivePadIndex];
      if (remembered && remembered.connected) {
        activePad = remembered;
      }
    }

    if (!activePad) {
      // Prefer W3C 'standard' mapped gamepads over unmapped auxiliary HID devices
      for (let i = 0; i < pads.length; i++) {
        const p = pads[i];
        if (p && p.connected && p.mapping === 'standard') {
          activePad = p;
          this.lastActivePadIndex = p.index;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (!activePad) {
      for (let i = 0; i < pads.length; i++) {
        const p = pads[i];
        if (p && p.connected) {
          activePad = p;
          this.lastActivePadIndex = p.index;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (!activePad) {
      this.lastActivePadIndex = -1;
      this.resetEdges();
      return DISCONNECTED_SNAPSHOT;
    }

    const btns = activePad.buttons;
    const axes = activePad.axes;

    // 2. Crisp 8-Way Radial Octant Analog Stick + Hardware D-Pad Merging
    const ax = axes.length > 0 ? axes[0] : 0;
    const ay = axes.length > 1 ? axes[1] : 0;
    const stickMag = Math.hypot(ax, ay);
    let stickUp = false;
    let stickDown = false;
    let stickLeft = false;
    let stickRight = false;
    if (stickMag > RADIAL_DEADZONE) {
      const nx = ax / stickMag;
      const ny = ay / stickMag;
      stickRight = nx > OCTANT_SIN_THRESHOLD;
      stickLeft = nx < -OCTANT_SIN_THRESHOLD;
      stickDown = ny > OCTANT_SIN_THRESHOLD;
      stickUp = ny < -OCTANT_SIN_THRESHOLD;
    }

    const up = isBtnPressed(btns[12]) || stickUp;
    const down = isBtnPressed(btns[13]) || stickDown;
    const left = isBtnPressed(btns[14]) || stickLeft;
    const right = isBtnPressed(btns[15]) || stickRight;

    const south0 = isBtnPressed(btns[0]);
    const east1 = isBtnPressed(btns[1]);
    const west2 = isBtnPressed(btns[2]);
    const north3 = isBtnPressed(btns[3]);
    const l1 = isBtnPressed(btns[4]);
    const r1 = isBtnPressed(btns[5]);
    const l2 = isBtnPressed(btns[6]);
    const r2 = isBtnPressed(btns[7]);
    const selectPressed = isBtnPressed(btns[8]);
    const startPressed = isBtnPressed(btns[9]);

    const isMultiButtonConsole =
      consoleSystem === 'snes' || consoleSystem === 'gba' || consoleSystem === 'genesis';

    let jumpA: boolean;
    let actionB: boolean;
    let btnX = false;
    let btnY = false;
    let shoulderL = false;
    let shoulderR = false;

    if (isMultiButtonConsole) {
      // Authentic SNES / GBA / Genesis 4-face + L/R shoulder layout
      actionB = south0;
      jumpA = east1;
      btnY = west2;
      btnX = north3;
      shoulderL = l1 || l2;
      shoulderR = r1 || r2;
    } else if (isCelesteSprint) {
      // Ergonomic modern platformer mapping for CelesteNES:
      // - Jump (NES A): South (Xbox A / PS Cross), North (Y / Triangle), or R2/RT trigger
      // - Dash (NES B): West (Xbox X / PS Square), East (Xbox B / PS Circle), or L2/LT trigger
      // - L1/LB & R1/RB bumpers step cleanly across the 6 Celeste speedrun segments!
      jumpA = south0 || north3 || r2;
      actionB = west2 || east1 || l2;
    } else {
      // Custom 2-button NES / Game Boy ROMs
      jumpA = south0 || north3 || r1 || r2;
      actionB = west2 || east1 || l1 || l2;
    }

    const aJustPressed = jumpA && !this.prevAPressed;
    const bJustPressed = actionB && !this.prevBPressed;
    const startJustPressed = startPressed && !this.prevStartPressed;
    const selectJustPressed = selectPressed && !this.prevSelectPressed;
    const prevSegmentJustPressed = isCelesteSprint && !isMultiButtonConsole && l1 && !this.prevL1Pressed;
    const nextSegmentJustPressed = isCelesteSprint && !isMultiButtonConsole && r1 && !this.prevR1Pressed;

    this.prevAPressed = jumpA;
    this.prevBPressed = actionB;
    this.prevStartPressed = startPressed;
    this.prevSelectPressed = selectPressed;
    this.prevL1Pressed = l1;
    this.prevR1Pressed = r1;

    let mask = 0;
    const virtualButtons: string[] = [];

    if (right) {
      mask |= NES_INPUT_RIGHT;
      virtualButtons.push('right');
    }
    if (left) {
      mask |= NES_INPUT_LEFT;
      virtualButtons.push('left');
    }
    if (down) {
      mask |= NES_INPUT_DOWN;
      virtualButtons.push('down');
    }
    if (up) {
      mask |= NES_INPUT_UP;
      virtualButtons.push('up');
    }
    if (jumpA) {
      mask |= NES_INPUT_A;
      virtualButtons.push('a');
    }
    if (actionB) {
      mask |= NES_INPUT_B;
      virtualButtons.push('b');
    }
    if (btnX) {
      mask |= NES_INPUT_A;
      virtualButtons.push('x');
    }
    if (btnY) {
      mask |= NES_INPUT_B;
      virtualButtons.push('y');
    }
    if (shoulderL) {
      virtualButtons.push('l');
    }
    if (shoulderR) {
      virtualButtons.push('r');
    }
    if (selectPressed) {
      mask |= NES_INPUT_SELECT;
      if (!isCelesteSprint) {
        virtualButtons.push('select');
      }
    }
    if (startPressed) {
      mask |= NES_INPUT_START;
      if (!isCelesteSprint) {
        virtualButtons.push('start');
      }
    }

    const rawId = activePad.id || 'Gamepad';
    const cleanLabel = rawId.replace(/\s*\([^)]*(?:standard gamepad|vendor:)[^)]*\)/gi, '').trim();
    return {
      connected: true,
      controllerLabel: (cleanLabel || rawId).slice(0, 48),
      shortBrandLabel: detectControllerShortBrand(rawId),
      buttonsMask: mask,
      virtualButtons,
      anyActionOrDirPressed:
        right || left || down || up || jumpA || actionB || btnX || btnY || shoulderL || shoulderR,
      aJustPressed,
      bJustPressed,
      startJustPressed,
      selectJustPressed,
      prevSegmentJustPressed,
      nextSegmentJustPressed,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Triggers non-blocking W3C dual-rumble haptic feedback on the active hardware controller
   * (only if the player has actively used the controller during this session).
   */
  pulseRumble(preset: GamepadRumblePreset): void {
    if (!this.usedInSession || this.lastActivePadIndex < 0) return;
    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || typeof navigator.getGamepads !== 'function') return;

    try {
      const pad = navigator.getGamepads()[this.lastActivePadIndex] as ExtendedGamepad | null;
      const actuator = pad?.vibrationActuator;
      if (!pad || !pad.connected || !actuator) return;

      const specs: Record<
        GamepadRumblePreset,
        { duration: number; strongMagnitude: number; weakMagnitude: number }
      > = {
        step: { duration: 24, strongMagnitude: 0, weakMagnitude: 0.2 },
        start: { duration: 36, strongMagnitude: 0.1, weakMagnitude: 0.28 },
        overtake: { duration: 68, strongMagnitude: 0.22, weakMagnitude: 0.5 },
        death: { duration: 95, strongMagnitude: 0.65, weakMagnitude: 0.35 },
        victory: { duration: 145, strongMagnitude: 0.55, weakMagnitude: 0.8 },
      };

      const spec = specs[preset];
      if (typeof actuator.playEffect === 'function') {
        void actuator.playEffect('dual-rumble', spec).catch(() => {});
      } else if (typeof actuator.pulse === 'function') {
        void actuator.pulse(Math.max(spec.strongMagnitude, spec.weakMagnitude), spec.duration).catch(
          () => {}
        );
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore browsers/controllers without haptic actuator support
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
import { formatDailyNumber } from './dailySprints';
import {
  getHologramRunnerSprites,
  getPixelCrownSprite,
  getRunnerArchetypeForTag,
  type RunnerArchetypeId,
  type RunnerPoseId,
} from './hologramRunners';
import {
  CELESTE_ROM_ID,
  DEFAULT_ROM_ID,
  NOVA_ROM_ID,
  TWIN_DRAGONS_ROM_ID,
} from './romProfiles';
import type { ConsoleSystemId, GhostKeyframe, GhostRun } from './types';

const VALID_SHARE_CONSOLES = new Set<ConsoleSystemId>(['nes', 'snes', 'genesis', 'gb', 'gba']);

export const GHOST_PALETTE = [
  '#FF70A6', // Bubblegum Pink
  '#9B5DE5', // Electric Violet
  '#70E000', // Slime Lime
  '#FF9F1C', // Arcade Tangerine
  '#4CC9F0', // Sky Cyan
  '#F15BB5', // Hot Magenta
```
