```ts
export function sanitizeArcadeTag(input: string): string {
  const cleaned = input.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9_]/g, '').slice(0, 9);
  return cleaned || 'PLAYER';
}

export function tagToSlug(tag: string): string {
  return sanitizeArcadeTag(tag).toLowerCase();
}

export function buildEmojiRaceReceipt(params: {
  deadGhostsCount: number;
  beatTarget: boolean;
}): string {
  if (params.beatTarget) {
    return '⚡⚡⚡👑🏃💨🏁';
  }
  if (params.deadGhostsCount > 0) {
    return '⚡💀⚡👑🏃💨🏁';
  }
  return '⚡⚡👻👑🏃💨🏁';
}

export function formatViralDareMessage(params: {
  tag: string;
  timeMs: number;
  emojiStrip: string;
  beatenCount: number;
  totalGhosts: number;
  targetTag?: string;
  deltaTargetSec?: number | null;
  isDare?: boolean;
  shareUrl: string;
  dailyNumber?: number;
  verified?: boolean;
}): string {
  const secs = (params.timeMs / 1000).toFixed(2).padStart(5, '0');
  const dailyPart =
    typeof params.dailyNumber === 'number' && params.dailyNumber >= 1
      ? ` ${formatDailyNumber(params.dailyNumber)}`
      : '';
  const verifiedMark = params.verified ? ' ✓' : '';

  let duelLine: string;
  if (params.targetTag && typeof params.deltaTargetSec === 'number') {
    const cleanTarget = sanitizeArcadeTag(params.targetTag);
    if (params.deltaTargetSec <= 0) {
      duelLine = params.isDare
        ? `⚔️ Beat @${cleanTarget}'s Dare (${params.deltaTargetSec.toFixed(2)}s!)`
        : `👑 Beat #1 @${cleanTarget} (${params.deltaTargetSec.toFixed(2)}s!)`;
    } else {
      duelLine = `Chased #1 @${cleanTarget} (+${params.deltaTargetSec.toFixed(2)}s)`;
    }
  } else {
    duelLine = params.beatenCount > 0 ? '👑 New #1 Speedrun Record!' : '15-Second Retro Speedrun';
  }

  return [
    `BITGEIST${dailyPart} 🏁 ${secs}s${verifiedMark}`,
    params.emojiStrip,
    duelLine,
    `Try to beat my ghost → ${params.shareUrl}`,
  ].join('\n');
}

/**
 * Encodes a runner's ghost run into a compact Base64URL stateless token (?g=...)
 * using downsampled delta coordinates so shared dare links work even across separate servers.
 */
export function encodeStatelessGhostToken(
  run: Pick<GhostRun, 'tag' | 'romId' | 'romTitle' | 'timeMs' | 'frames'> &
    Partial<
      Pick<
        GhostRun,
        | 'consoleSystem'
        | 'beatenCount'
        | 'totalGhosts'
        | 'emojiReceipt'
        | 'sprintId'
        | 'dailyNumber'
        | 'courseIndex'
        | 'startWorldX'
        | 'goalWorldX'
        | 'verified'
      >
    >
): string {
  try {
    if (!run.frames.length) return '';
    // Sample up to 36 keyframes along the run for compact URL size
    const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(run.frames.length / 36));
    const sampled: GhostKeyframe[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < run.frames.length; i += step) {
      sampled.push(run.frames[i]);
    }
    const last = run.frames[run.frames.length - 1];
    if (last && sampled[sampled.length - 1]?.[0] !== last[0]) {
      sampled.push(last);
    }

    let prevF = 0;
    let prevX = 0;
    let prevY = 0;
    const deltas = sampled.map(([f, x, y]) => {
      const rf = Math.round(f);
      const rx = Math.round(x);
      const ry = Math.round(y);
      const df = rf - prevF;
      const dx = rx - prevX;
      const dy = ry - prevY;
      prevF = rf;
      prevX = rx;
      prevY = ry;
      return `${df},${dx},${dy}`;
    });

    const compactRomId =
      run.romId === CELESTE_ROM_ID
        ? 'cel'
        : run.romId === TWIN_DRAGONS_ROM_ID
          ? 'td'
          : run.romId === NOVA_ROM_ID
            ? 'nova'
            : run.romId;

    const payload = JSON.stringify({
      u: sanitizeArcadeTag(run.tag),
      r: compactRomId,
      ...(run.consoleSystem && run.consoleSystem !== 'nes' ? { cs: run.consoleSystem } : {}),
      n: run.romTitle,
      t: Math.round(run.timeMs),
      ...(typeof run.beatenCount === 'number' ? { b: run.beatenCount } : {}),
      ...(typeof run.totalGhosts === 'number' ? { g: run.totalGhosts } : {}),
      ...(run.emojiReceipt ? { e: run.emojiReceipt } : {}),
      ...(run.sprintId && run.sprintId !== run.romId ? { s: run.sprintId } : {}),
      ...(typeof run.dailyNumber === 'number' && run.dailyNumber >= 1
        ? { dn: Math.round(run.dailyNumber) }
        : {}),
      ...(typeof run.courseIndex === 'number' && run.courseIndex >= 0
        ? { lv: Math.round(run.courseIndex) }
        : {}),
      ...(typeof run.startWorldX === 'number' ? { sx: Math.round(run.startWorldX) } : {}),
      ...(typeof run.goalWorldX === 'number' ? { gx: Math.round(run.goalWorldX) } : {}),
      ...(run.verified ? { v: 1 } : {}),
      d: deltas.join(';'),
    });

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      return btoa(encodeURIComponent(payload))
        .replace(/\+/g, '-')
        .replace(/\//g, '_')
        .replace(/=+$/, '');
    }
    return Buffer.from(encodeURIComponent(payload), 'utf8').toString('base64url');
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

export function decodeStatelessGhostToken(
  token: string,
  fullRomIdFallback = DEFAULT_ROM_ID
): GhostRun | null {
  try {
    const b64 = token.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const decodedJson =
      typeof window !== 'undefined'
        ? decodeURIComponent(atob(b64))
        : decodeURIComponent(Buffer.from(b64, 'base64').toString('utf8'));
    const parsed = JSON.parse(decodedJson) as {
      u?: string;
      r?: string;
      cs?: string;
      n?: string;
      t?: number;
      b?: number;
      g?: number;
      e?: string;
      s?: string;
      dn?: number;
      lv?: number;
      sx?: number;
      gx?: number;
      v?: number;
      d?: string;
    };

    if (typeof parsed.d !== 'string' || !parsed.d) return null;

    let f = 0;
    let x = 0;
    let y = 0;
    const frames: GhostKeyframe[] = [];
    for (const seg of parsed.d.split(';')) {
      const parts = seg.split(',').map(Number);
      if (parts.length !== 3 || !parts.every(Number.isFinite)) continue;
      f += parts[0];
      x += parts[1];
      y += parts[2];
      frames.push([Math.max(0, f), x, y]);
    }

    if (frames.length < 2) return null;

    const tag = sanitizeArcadeTag(parsed.u || 'PLAYER');
    const resolvedRomId =
      parsed.r === 'cel'
        ? CELESTE_ROM_ID
        : parsed.r === 'td'
          ? TWIN_DRAGONS_ROM_ID
          : parsed.r === 'nova'
            ? NOVA_ROM_ID
            : typeof parsed.r === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{16,64}$/i.test(parsed.r)
              ? parsed.r.toLowerCase()
              : fullRomIdFallback;

    const rawTime = Number(parsed.t);
    const timeMs = Number.isFinite(rawTime) && rawTime >= 1000 ? Math.round(rawTime) : 14200;
    const rawTotal = Number(parsed.g);
    const totalGhosts = Number.isFinite(rawTotal) && rawTotal >= 1 ? Math.round(rawTotal) : 1;
    const rawBeaten = Number(parsed.b);
    const beatenCount =
      Number.isFinite(rawBeaten) && rawBeaten >= 0
        ? Math.min(totalGhosts, Math.round(rawBeaten))
        : totalGhosts;

    const rawDn = Number(parsed.dn);
    const dailyNumber =
      Number.isFinite(rawDn) && rawDn >= 1 && rawDn <= 99_999 ? Math.round(rawDn) : undefined;

    const rawLv = Number(parsed.lv);
    const courseIndex =
      Number.isFinite(rawLv) && rawLv >= 0 && rawLv <= 99 ? Math.round(rawLv) : undefined;

    const rawSx = Number(parsed.sx);
    const startWorldX =
      Number.isFinite(rawSx) && rawSx >= 0 && rawSx <= 65_535 ? Math.round(rawSx) : undefined;

    const rawGx = Number(parsed.gx);
    const goalWorldX =
      Number.isFinite(rawGx) && rawGx >= 240 && rawGx <= 65_535 ? Math.round(rawGx) : undefined;

    const sprintId =
      typeof parsed.s === 'string' && /^[a-zA-Z0-9:_-]{3,96}$/.test(parsed.s)
        ? parsed.s
        : dailyNumber
          ? `daily-${dailyNumber}`
          : resolvedRomId;

    const consoleSystem: ConsoleSystemId =
      typeof parsed.cs === 'string' && VALID_SHARE_CONSOLES.has(parsed.cs as ConsoleSystemId)
        ? (parsed.cs as ConsoleSystemId)
        : 'nes';

    return {
      id: `token-${tag.toLowerCase()}`,
      slug: tagToSlug(tag),
      tag,
      romId: resolvedRomId,
      consoleSystem,
      sprintId,
      romTitle: (parsed.n || 'CELESTE 1-A • FIRST STEPS').slice(0, 32),
      timeMs,
      beatenCount,
      totalGhosts,
      emojiReceipt: parsed.e || '⚡⚡⚡👑🏃💨🏁',
      frames,
      color: '#FFE74C',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      dailyNumber,
      courseIndex,
      startWorldX,
      goalWorldX,
      verified: parsed.v === 1,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Generates a crisp, 100% DMCA-safe 1200x630 Blocky 8-Bit Trophy Card PNG directly on <canvas>.
 */
export function downloadBlockyBragCardPng(params: {
  tag: string;
  timeMs: number;
  beatenCount: number;
  totalGhosts: number;
  targetTag?: string;
  deltaTargetSec?: number | null;
  romTitle: string;
  shareUrlDisplay: string;
  dailyNumber?: number;
  verified?: boolean;
}) {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = 1200;
  c.height = 630;
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  if (!g) return;

  // Warm Famicom Cream Backdrop + Dot Grid
  g.fillStyle = '#F4ECD8';
  g.fillRect(0, 0, 1200, 630);
  g.fillStyle = '#DFD2B4';
  for (let x = 16; x < 1200; x += 24) {
    for (let y = 16; y < 630; y += 24) {
      g.fillRect(x, y, 4, 4);
    }
  }

  // Hard 3D Offset Black Shadow
  g.fillStyle = '#111111';
  g.fillRect(68, 66, 1084, 514);

  // Coral + Gold Double CRT Outer Frame
  g.fillStyle = '#EC6553';
  g.fillRect(54, 52, 1084, 514);
  g.strokeStyle = '#111111';
  g.lineWidth = 8;
  g.strokeRect(54, 52, 1084, 514);

  g.fillStyle = '#F5C342';
  g.fillRect(68, 66, 1056, 486);
  g.strokeRect(68, 66, 1056, 486);

  // Dark Charcoal CRT Inner Screen
  g.fillStyle = '#25242B';
  g.fillRect(84, 82, 1024, 454);
  g.strokeRect(84, 82, 1024, 454);

  // Rainbow 3D BITGEIST Blocks
  const letters = ['B', 'I', 'T', 'G', 'E', 'I', 'S', 'T'];
  const colors = ['#F2545B', '#F7882F', '#F7C331', '#6BCB77', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#9B5DE5', '#F15BB5'];
  letters.forEach((ch, idx) => {
    const bx = 126 + idx * 54;
    const by = 118;
    g.fillStyle = '#111111';
    g.fillRect(bx + 5, by + 5, 46, 52);
    g.fillStyle = colors[idx];
    g.fillRect(bx, by, 46, 52);
    g.strokeStyle = '#111111';
    g.lineWidth = 4;
    g.strokeRect(bx, by, 46, 52);
    g.fillStyle = '#111111';
    g.font = '900 30px monospace';
    g.fillText(ch, bx + 13, by + 37);
  });

  // Cartridge Badge
  const badgeLabel =
    typeof params.dailyNumber === 'number' && !params.romTitle.startsWith('#')
      ? `${formatDailyNumber(params.dailyNumber)} • ${params.romTitle}`
      : params.romTitle;
  g.fillStyle = '#7FD1AE';
  g.fillRect(680, 122, 386, 46);
  g.strokeStyle = '#111111';
  g.lineWidth = 4;
  g.strokeRect(680, 122, 386, 46);
  g.fillStyle = '#111111';
  g.font = '900 20px monospace';
  g.fillText(badgeLabel.slice(0, 24), 700, 152);

  // Giant Finish Time & Verified Badge
  const secs = (params.timeMs / 1000).toFixed(2).padStart(5, '0');
  const timeLabel = `${secs}s`;
  g.fillStyle = '#FFE74C';
  g.font = '900 84px monospace';
  g.fillText(timeLabel, 126, 286);

  if (params.verified) {
    const tw = g.measureText(timeLabel).width;
    const vx = 126 + tw + 22;
    const vy = 236;
    g.fillStyle = '#111111';
    g.fillRect(vx + 4, vy + 4, 184, 42);
    g.fillStyle = '#7FD1AE';
    g.fillRect(vx, vy, 184, 42);
    g.strokeStyle = '#111111';
    g.lineWidth = 4;
    g.strokeRect(vx, vy, 184, 42);
    g.fillStyle = '#111111';
    g.font = '900 20px monospace';
    g.fillText('✓ VERIFIED', vx + 22, vy + 28);
  }

  const cleanPlayerTag = sanitizeArcadeTag(params.tag);
  let bragSubline: string;
  if (params.targetTag && typeof params.deltaTargetSec === 'number') {
    const cleanTarget = sanitizeArcadeTag(params.targetTag);
    bragSubline =
      params.deltaTargetSec <= 0
        ? `@${cleanPlayerTag} BEAT #1 @${cleanTarget} (${params.deltaTargetSec.toFixed(2)}s)`
        : `@${cleanPlayerTag} VS #1 @${cleanTarget} (+${params.deltaTargetSec.toFixed(2)}s)`;
  } else {
    bragSubline =
      params.beatenCount > 0
        ? `@${cleanPlayerTag} • NEW #1 TOP RECORD!`
        : `@${cleanPlayerTag} • 1V1 SPEEDRUN CHALLENGE`;
  }

  g.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  g.font = '900 36px monospace';
  g.fillText(bragSubline, 126, 352);

  // 8-Bit 1v1 Hologram Duel on the Right (Crowned Champion vs Rival)
  g.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  const heroArch = getRunnerArchetypeForTag(params.tag);
  const rivalArch = params.targetTag
    ? getRunnerArchetypeForTag(params.targetTag)
    : (((heroArch + 1) % 5) as RunnerArchetypeId);
  const beatRival =
    typeof params.deltaTargetSec === 'number' ? params.deltaTargetSec <= 0 : params.beatenCount > 0;
  const runnerSpecs: Array<{
    gx: number;
    gy: number;
    col: string;
    arch: RunnerArchetypeId;
    pose: RunnerPoseId;
    crown: boolean;
  }> = [
    {
      gx: 956,
      gy: 252,
      col: '#4CC9F0',
      arch: rivalArch,
      pose: 'run2',
      crown: !beatRival,
    },
    {
      gx: 850,
      gy: 234,
      col: '#FFE74C',
      arch: heroArch,
      pose: 'jump',
      crown: beatRival,
    },
  ];
  const crownCanvas = getPixelCrownSprite();
  runnerSpecs.forEach((sp) => {
    const sprites = getHologramRunnerSprites(sp.arch, sp.col, sp.pose, false);
    if (sprites) {
      g.globalAlpha = 0.28;
      g.drawImage(sprites.echo, sp.gx - 18, sp.gy + 4, 72, 80);
      g.globalAlpha = 1;
      g.drawImage(sprites.main, sp.gx, sp.gy, 72, 80);
    }
    if (sp.crown && crownCanvas) {
      g.drawImage(crownCanvas, sp.gx + 10, sp.gy - 30, 52, 32);
    }
  });

  // Bottom Dare CTA Bar
  g.fillStyle = '#7FD1AE';
  g.fillRect(126, 420, 940, 74);
  g.strokeStyle = '#111111';
  g.lineWidth = 5;
  g.strokeRect(126, 420, 940, 74);
  g.fillStyle = '#111111';
  g.font = '900 30px monospace';
  g.fillText(`RACE MY GHOST → ${params.shareUrlDisplay}`, 154, 467);

  const dailySuffix =
    typeof params.dailyNumber === 'number' ? `-d${params.dailyNumber}` : '';
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.download = `bitgeist-${tagToSlug(params.tag)}${dailySuffix}-${secs}s.png`;
  link.href = c.toDataURL('image/png');
  link.click();
}

```

`lib/ghostStore.ts`:

```ts
import fsSync from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
import { CELESTE_CHAMPION_REPLAYS } from './celesteDemoReplays';
import { getCourseByIndex, getDailySprintByNumber } from './dailySprints';
import { GHOST_PALETTE, sanitizeArcadeTag, tagToSlug } from './ghostShare';
import { computeFnv1aHex } from './inputReplay';
import {
  CELESTE_GBA_ROM_ID,
  CELESTE_ROM_ID,
  DEFAULT_PROFILE,
  DEFAULT_ROM_ID,
  NOVA_ROM_ID,
} from './romProfiles';
import type {
  ConsoleSystemId,
  CustomRomSegment,
  GhostKeyframe,
  GhostRun,
  MountainStandingEntry,
  RivalrySeriesSummary,
} from './types';

const DATA_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data');
const DEFAULT_SQLITE_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'bitgeist.sqlite');
const LEGACY_GHOSTS_JSON = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'ghosts.json');
const MAX_STORED_RUNS_PER_SPRINT = 500;

export const DEFAULT_GHOST_PACK_SIZE = 1;

const SEED_NAMES = [
  'ALEX', 'MADELINE', 'THEO', 'BADELINE', 'KAI',
  'MIRA', 'ZED', 'PIXEL', 'RINA', 'LUMA',
];

const VALID_CONSOLE_SYSTEMS = new Set<ConsoleSystemId>(['nes', 'snes', 'genesis', 'gb', 'gba']);

interface GlobalSqliteHolder {
  __bitgeistSqliteStore?: {
    db: DatabaseSync;
    path: string;
  };
}

const globalForSqlite = globalThis as unknown as GlobalSqliteHolder;

function resolveDbPath(): string {
  return process.env.BITGEIST_DB_PATH?.trim() || DEFAULT_SQLITE_FILE;
}

function normalizeDareSlug(raw: string): string {
  return raw.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/g, '').slice(0, 32);
}

function hashFnv1a32(text: string): number {
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    h ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
    h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
  }
  return h >>> 0;
}

function hashSprintOffset(sprintId: string): number {
  if (!sprintId || sprintId === DEFAULT_ROM_ID) return 0;
  return hashFnv1a32(sprintId) % 9973;
}

function buildShortRunCode(runId: string, salt = 0): string {
  const input = salt === 0 ? runId : `${runId}:${salt}`;
  const base36 = hashFnv1a32(input).toString(36).padStart(4, '0');
  return base36.slice(-4);
}

function buildUniqueDareSlug(tag: string, runId: string, salt = 0): string {
  const tagBase = tagToSlug(tag);
  return `${tagBase}-${buildShortRunCode(runId, salt)}`;
}

function allocateCollisionFreeSlug(db: DatabaseSync, tag: string, runId: string): string {
  const checkStmt = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM ghost_runs WHERE slug = ? LIMIT 1');
  for (let salt = 0; salt < 64; salt++) {
    const candidate = buildUniqueDareSlug(tag, runId, salt);
    const existing = checkStmt.get(candidate) as { id?: string } | undefined;
    if (!existing || existing.id === runId) {
      return candidate;
    }
  }
  return `${tagToSlug(tag)}-${Date.now().toString(36).slice(-5)}`;
}

function parseConsoleSystem(raw: unknown): ConsoleSystemId {
  if (typeof raw === 'string' && VALID_CONSOLE_SYSTEMS.has(raw as ConsoleSystemId)) {
    return raw as ConsoleSystemId;
  }
  return 'nes';
}

function parseFramesJson(raw: unknown): GhostKeyframe[] {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !raw) return [];
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
    const out: GhostKeyframe[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < parsed.length && out.length < 900; i++) {
      const item = parsed[i];
      if (!Array.isArray(item) || item.length < 3) continue;
      const f = Number(item[0]);
      const x = Number(item[1]);
      const y = Number(item[2]);
      if (Number.isFinite(f) && Number.isFinite(x) && Number.isFinite(y)) {
        out.push([Math.round(f), Math.round(x), Math.round(y)]);
      }
    }
    return out;
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function rowToGhostRun(row: Record<string, unknown>): GhostRun | null {
  const frames = parseFramesJson(row.frames_json);
  if (frames.length < 2) return null;

  const consoleSystem = parseConsoleSystem(row.console_system);
  const run: GhostRun = {
    id: String(row.id || ''),
    slug: String(row.slug || ''),
    tag: sanitizeArcadeTag(String(row.tag || 'PLAYER')),
    romId: String(row.rom_id || DEFAULT_ROM_ID),
    consoleSystem,
    sprintId: String(row.sprint_id || row.rom_id || DEFAULT_ROM_ID),
    romTitle: String(row.rom_title || DEFAULT_PROFILE.stageLabel),
    timeMs: Math.max(1000, Number(row.time_ms) || 14800),
    beatenCount: Math.max(0, Number(row.beaten_count) || 0),
    totalGhosts: Math.max(1, Number(row.total_ghosts) || DEFAULT_GHOST_PACK_SIZE),
    emojiReceipt: String(row.emoji_receipt || '⚡⚡⚡👑🏃💨🏁'),
    frames,
    color: String(row.color || '#4CC9F0'),
    createdAt: String(row.created_at || new Date().toISOString()),
  };

  if (typeof row.died_at_frame === 'number' && Number.isFinite(row.died_at_frame)) {
    run.diedAtFrame = Math.round(row.died_at_frame);
  }
  if (typeof row.daily_number === 'number' && Number.isFinite(row.daily_number)) {
    run.dailyNumber = Math.round(row.daily_number);
  }
  if (typeof row.course_index === 'number' && Number.isFinite(row.course_index)) {
    run.courseIndex = Math.round(row.course_index);
  }
  if (typeof row.start_world_x === 'number' && Number.isFinite(row.start_world_x)) {
    run.startWorldX = Math.round(row.start_world_x);
  }
  if (typeof row.goal_world_x === 'number' && Number.isFinite(row.goal_world_x)) {
    run.goalWorldX = Math.round(row.goal_world_x);
  }
  if (typeof row.input_log === 'string' && row.input_log) {
    run.inputLog = row.input_log;
  }
  if (typeof row.verified === 'number') {
    run.verified = row.verified === 1;
  }
  if (typeof row.input_digest === 'string' && row.input_digest) {
    run.inputDigest = row.input_digest;
  }
  if (typeof row.parent_slug === 'string' && row.parent_slug) {
    run.parentSlug = row.parent_slug;
  }

  return run;
}

function migrateLegacyJsonIfEmpty(db: DatabaseSync): void {
  const countRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ghost_runs').get() as
    | { cnt?: number | bigint }
    | undefined;
  const count = Number(countRow?.cnt ?? 0);
  if (count > 0 || !fsSync.existsSync(LEGACY_GHOSTS_JSON)) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    const raw = fsSync.readFileSync(LEGACY_GHOSTS_JSON, 'utf8');
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return;

    const realRuns = (parsed as GhostRun[]).filter(
      (r) =>
        r &&
        typeof r.id === 'string' &&
        !r.id.startsWith('seed-') &&
        Array.isArray(r.frames) &&
        r.frames.length >= 2
    );
    if (realRuns.length === 0) return;

    const insertStmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO ghost_runs (
        id, slug, tag, tag_slug, rom_id, console_system, sprint_id, rom_title,
        time_ms, beaten_count, total_ghosts, emoji_receipt, frames_json, died_at_frame,
        color, created_at, daily_number, course_index, start_world_x, goal_world_x,
        input_log, verified, input_digest
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?
      )
    `);

    db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE;');
    try {
      for (const r of realRuns) {
        const tag = sanitizeArcadeTag(r.tag || 'PLAYER');
        const tagSlug = tagToSlug(tag);
        const runId = r.id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '').slice(0, 64) || `legacy-${Date.now()}`;
        const uniqueSlug = allocateCollisionFreeSlug(db, tag, runId);
        const romId = r.romId || DEFAULT_ROM_ID;
        const sprintId = r.sprintId || romId;
        insertStmt.run(
          runId,
          uniqueSlug,
          tag,
          tagSlug,
          romId,
          parseConsoleSystem(r.consoleSystem),
          sprintId,
          r.romTitle || DEFAULT_PROFILE.stageLabel,
          Math.max(1000, Math.min(600_000, Math.round(r.timeMs || 14800))),
          Math.max(0, Math.round(r.beatenCount || 0)),
          Math.max(1, Math.round(r.totalGhosts || DEFAULT_GHOST_PACK_SIZE)),
          r.emojiReceipt || '⚡⚡⚡👑🏃💨🏁',
          JSON.stringify(r.frames.slice(0, 900)),
          typeof r.diedAtFrame === 'number' ? Math.round(r.diedAtFrame) : null,
          r.color || '#4CC9F0',
          r.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
          typeof r.dailyNumber === 'number' ? Math.round(r.dailyNumber) : null,
          typeof r.courseIndex === 'number' ? Math.round(r.courseIndex) : null,
          typeof r.startWorldX === 'number' ? Math.round(r.startWorldX) : null,
          typeof r.goalWorldX === 'number' ? Math.round(r.goalWorldX) : null,
          r.inputLog || null,
          r.verified ? 1 : 0,
          r.inputDigest || null
        );
      }
      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      throw err;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[ghostStore] Skipping legacy ghosts.json migration:', err);
  }
}

function resetCachedDb(): void {
  const existing = globalForSqlite.__bitgeistSqliteStore;
  globalForSqlite.__bitgeistSqliteStore = undefined;
  if (existing) {
    try {
      existing.db.close();
    } catch {
      // Ignore close error on stale handle reset
    }
  }
}

function getDb(): DatabaseSync {
  const targetPath = resolveDbPath();
  const cached = globalForSqlite.__bitgeistSqliteStore;
  if (cached && cached.path === targetPath) {
    return cached.db;
  }
  resetCachedDb();

  fsSync.mkdirSync(path.dirname(targetPath), { recursive: true });
  const db = new DatabaseSync(targetPath);

  db.exec(`
    PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;
    PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;
    PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL;
    PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ghost_runs (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      tag TEXT NOT NULL,
      tag_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
      rom_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      console_system TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'nes',
      sprint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      rom_title TEXT NOT NULL,
      time_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
      beaten_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
      total_ghosts INTEGER NOT NULL,
      emoji_receipt TEXT NOT NULL,
      frames_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      died_at_frame INTEGER,
      color TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      daily_number INTEGER,
      course_index INTEGER,
      start_world_x INTEGER,
      goal_world_x INTEGER,
      input_log TEXT,
      verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      input_digest TEXT,
      parent_slug TEXT
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS community_segments (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      rom_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      sprint_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      code TEXT NOT NULL,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      start_world_x INTEGER NOT NULL,
      goal_world_x INTEGER NOT NULL,
      preview_data_url TEXT,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_community_segments_rom
      ON community_segments (rom_id, created_at ASC);

    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ghost_runs_sprint_time
      ON ghost_runs (sprint_id, time_ms ASC);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ghost_runs_slug
      ON ghost_runs (slug);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ghost_runs_tag_sprint
      ON ghost_runs (tag_slug, sprint_id, time_ms ASC);
  `);

  // Safe schema migration for existing SQLite databases created prior to Stage 7
  try {
    const cols = db.prepare('PRAGMA table_info(ghost_runs)').all() as Array<{ name?: string }>;
    if (!cols.some((c) => c.name === 'parent_slug')) {
      db.exec('ALTER TABLE ghost_runs ADD COLUMN parent_slug TEXT;');
    }
  } catch {
    // Column already present
  }

  migrateLegacyJsonIfEmpty(db);

  globalForSqlite.__bitgeistSqliteStore = { db, path: targetPath };
  return db;
}

function withSqliteRetry<T>(operation: (db: DatabaseSync) => T): T {
  try {
    return operation(getDb());
  } catch {
    resetCachedDb();
    return operation(getDb());
  }
}

export function withGhostSqliteDb<T>(operation: (db: DatabaseSync) => T): T {
  return withSqliteRetry(operation);
}

export function getGhostStoreHealth(): {
  ok: boolean;
  driver: 'sqlite-wal';
  storedRuns: number;
} {
  const row = withSqliteRetry(
    (db) =>
      db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ghost_runs').get() as
        | { cnt?: number | bigint }
        | undefined
  );
  return {
    ok: true,
    driver: 'sqlite-wal',
    storedRuns: Number(row?.cnt ?? 0),
  };
}

/**
 * Generates a realistic 60Hz-compatible 2D keyframe trajectory across multi-room CelesteNES
 * dash/climb courses (or horizontal multi-console sprints), with @ALEX at ~14.80s by default
 * and optional pace-scaling for high-skill speedrun matchmaking brackets.
 */
function buildSeedGhostRun(
  index: number,
  opts?: {
    romId?: string;
    consoleSystem?: ConsoleSystemId;
    sprintId?: string;
    romTitle?: string;
    startWorldX?: number;
    goalWorldX?: number;
    dailyNumber?: number;
    courseIndex?: number;
  }
): GhostRun {
  const romId = opts?.romId || DEFAULT_ROM_ID;
  const consoleSystem = opts?.consoleSystem || 'nes';
  const sprintId = opts?.sprintId || romId;
  const celesteCourse =
    romId === CELESTE_ROM_ID
      ? typeof opts?.dailyNumber === 'number'
        ? getDailySprintByNumber(opts.dailyNumber).course
        : getCourseByIndex(opts?.courseIndex)
      : null;

  const startX =
    typeof opts?.startWorldX === 'number'
      ? opts.startWorldX
      : celesteCourse?.startWorldX ?? DEFAULT_PROFILE.startWorldX;
  const goalWorldX =
    typeof opts?.goalWorldX === 'number'
      ? opts.goalWorldX
      : celesteCourse?.goalWorldX ?? DEFAULT_PROFILE.goalWorldX;
  const finishDeltaY =
    romId === CELESTE_GBA_ROM_ID ? -720 : celesteCourse?.finishDeltaY ?? 0;
  const romTitle = opts?.romTitle || celesteCourse?.stageLabel || DEFAULT_PROFILE.stageLabel;

  const tag = SEED_NAMES[index % SEED_NAMES.length];
  const isAlex = tag === 'ALEX';
  const idPrefix =
    sprintId === DEFAULT_ROM_ID
      ? 'seed'
      : `seed-${sprintId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '-').slice(0, 32)}`;

  // Use deterministic bundled 60Hz inputLog champion replay for built-in CelesteNES courses when available
  const bundledChampion =
    romId === CELESTE_ROM_ID && isAlex
      ? CELESTE_CHAMPION_REPLAYS[celesteCourse?.courseIndex ?? 0]
      : undefined;

  if (bundledChampion) {
    const clonedFrames: GhostKeyframe[] = bundledChampion.frames.map(([f, x, y]) => [f, x, y]);
    return {
      id: `${idPrefix}-${tag.toLowerCase()}-${index}`,
      slug: tagToSlug(tag),
      tag,
      romId,
      consoleSystem,
      sprintId,
      romTitle,
      timeMs: bundledChampion.timeMs,
      beatenCount: 1,
      totalGhosts: 1,
      emojiReceipt: '⚡⚡⚡👑🏃💨🏁',
      frames: clonedFrames,
      color: '#FFE74C',
      createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - index * 120_000).toISOString(),
      dailyNumber: opts?.dailyNumber,
      courseIndex: celesteCourse?.courseIndex ?? opts?.courseIndex,
      startWorldX: startX,
      goalWorldX,
      inputLog: bundledChampion.inputLog,
      verified: true,
      inputDigest: computeFnv1aHex(
        `${romId}|${Math.round(bundledChampion.timeMs)}|${bundledChampion.inputLog}`
      ),
    };
  }

  const sprintSalt = hashSprintOffset(sprintId);
  let seed = (index + 1) * 7919 + sprintSalt * 31;
  const rand = () => {
    seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647;
    return (seed - 1) / 2147483646;
  };

  const baseSpan = Math.max(400, DEFAULT_PROFILE.goalWorldX - DEFAULT_PROFILE.startWorldX);
  const actualSpan = Math.max(240, goalWorldX - startX);
  const rawScale = actualSpan / baseSpan;
  const distScale = Math.abs(rawScale - 1) < 0.08 ? 1 : Math.max(0.55, Math.min(2.6, rawScale));

  // ALEX runs an exciting, beatable ~14.80s multi-room sprint (or exact bundled champion time);
  // seed rivals #2..#10 pace cleanly behind ALEX so #1 is always authoritative until beaten by a player.
  const NOVA_SEED_TOP_MS: Readonly<Record<number, number>> = {
    0: 13650,
    1: 14420,
    2: 15180,
    3: 14950,
  };
  const GBA_SEED_TOP_MS: Readonly<Record<number, number>> = {
    0: 13850,
    1: 15240,
    2: 16480,
    3: 17150,
  };
  const courseIdxForSeed = celesteCourse?.courseIndex ?? opts?.courseIndex ?? 0;
  const alexChampionTimeMs =
    romId === CELESTE_ROM_ID
      ? CELESTE_CHAMPION_REPLAYS[courseIdxForSeed]?.timeMs
      : romId === NOVA_ROM_ID
        ? NOVA_SEED_TOP_MS[courseIdxForSeed]
        : romId === CELESTE_GBA_ROM_ID
          ? GBA_SEED_TOP_MS[courseIdxForSeed]
          : undefined;
  const alexBaselineMs = alexChampionTimeMs ?? Math.round(14800 * distScale);
  const targetTimeMs = isAlex
    ? alexBaselineMs
    : Math.round(alexBaselineMs + index * 480 + rand() * 520);
  const totalFrames = Math.max(180, Math.round((targetTimeMs / 1000) * 60));
  const baseScreenY = romId === CELESTE_ROM_ID || romId === CELESTE_GBA_ROM_ID ? 180 : 192;

  const roomClimbSteps =
    Math.abs(finishDeltaY) >= 180 ? Math.max(1, Math.round(Math.abs(finishDeltaY) / 240)) : 0;

  const computeRoomRelY = (p: number): number => {
    if (finishDeltaY === 0) return 0;
    if (roomClimbSteps <= 0) {
      return finishDeltaY * p;
    }
    const perStep = finishDeltaY / roomClimbSteps;
    let accY = 0;
    for (let s = 1; s <= roomClimbSteps; s++) {
      const center = s / (roomClimbSteps + 0.35);
      const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (p - (center - 0.055)) / 0.11));
      const smooth = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
      accY += perStep * smooth;
    }
    return accY;
  };

  const frames: GhostKeyframe[] = [];
  const dashZones = [0.16, 0.34, 0.54, 0.72, 0.88];

  if (romId === CELESTE_GBA_ROM_ID) {
    // 3-room vertical PICO-8 playfield climb centered inside GBA's 240x160 frame (screenX 72..180 per room)
    for (let f = 0; f <= totalFrames; f += 3) {
      const progress = Math.min(1, f / totalFrames);
      const scaled = progress * 3;
      const roomsClimbed = progress >= 1 ? 3 : Math.min(2, Math.floor(scaled));
      const roomProg = progress >= 1 ? 0 : scaled - roomsClimbed;
      const localX = Math.round(
        126 + Math.sin(roomProg * Math.PI * 1.6 + index * 0.9) * 44
      );
      const worldX = progress >= 1 ? goalWorldX : roomsClimbed * 256 + localX;
      const localY = progress >= 1 ? 180 : Math.round(186 - roomProg * 156);
      const worldY = -roomsClimbed * 240 + localY;
      frames.push([f, worldX, worldY]);
    }
  } else {
    for (let f = 0; f <= totalFrames; f += 3) {
      const progress = Math.min(1, f / totalFrames);
      const wobble = isAlex ? 0 : Math.sin(progress * Math.PI * 3 + index) * 12;
      const worldX = Math.round(
        Math.max(startX, Math.min(goalWorldX, startX + (goalWorldX - startX) * progress + wobble))
      );

      const roomY = computeRoomRelY(progress);
      let localY = baseScreenY;
      for (const dz of dashZones) {
        const dist = Math.abs(progress - dz);
        if (dist < 0.055) {
          const norm = 1 - dist / 0.055;
          localY = baseScreenY - Math.sin(norm * Math.PI) * (42 + (index % 3) * 9);
        }
      }

      frames.push([f, worldX, Math.round(roomY + localY)]);
    }
  }

  const finalY = Math.round(finishDeltaY + baseScreenY);
  const last = frames[frames.length - 1];
  if (last && last[0] === totalFrames) {
    frames[frames.length - 1] = [totalFrames, goalWorldX, finalY];
  } else {
    frames.push([totalFrames, goalWorldX, finalY]);
  }

  return {
    id: `${idPrefix}-${tag.toLowerCase()}-${index}`,
    slug: tagToSlug(tag),
    tag,
    romId,
    consoleSystem,
    sprintId,
    romTitle,
    timeMs: targetTimeMs,
    beatenCount: 1,
    totalGhosts: 1,
    emojiReceipt: '⚡⚡⚡👑🏃💨🏁',
    frames,
    color: isAlex ? '#FFE74C' : GHOST_PALETTE[index % GHOST_PALETTE.length],
    createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - index * 120_000).toISOString(),
    dailyNumber: opts?.dailyNumber,
    courseIndex: celesteCourse?.courseIndex ?? opts?.courseIndex,
    startWorldX: startX,
    goalWorldX,
  };
}

interface GetGhostsQueryOptions {
  sprintId?: string;
  startWorldX?: number;
  goalWorldX?: number;
  romTitle?: string;
  dailyNumber?: number;
  courseIndex?: number;
  consoleSystem?: ConsoleSystemId;
}

function queryUniqueStoredRunsForSprint(
  db: DatabaseSync,
  sprintId: string
): { uniqueRuns: GhostRun[]; totalUniqueRunners: number } {
  const countRow = db
    .prepare(
      `SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tag_slug) AS cnt
       FROM ghost_runs
       WHERE sprint_id = ? AND died_at_frame IS NULL`
    )
    .get(sprintId) as { cnt?: number | bigint } | undefined;

  const rows = db
    .prepare(
      `SELECT * FROM ghost_runs
       WHERE sprint_id = ? AND died_at_frame IS NULL
       ORDER BY time_ms ASC, verified DESC, created_at ASC
       LIMIT 60`
    )
    .all(sprintId);

  const seenTags = new Set<string>();
  const uniqueRuns: GhostRun[] = [];
  for (const r of rows) {
    const parsed = rowToGhostRun(r);
    if (!parsed) continue;
    const tSlug = tagToSlug(parsed.tag);
    if (seenTags.has(tSlug)) continue;
    seenTags.add(tSlug);
    uniqueRuns.push(parsed);
    if (uniqueRuns.length >= 15) break;
  }

  return {
    uniqueRuns,
    totalUniqueRunners: Math.max(uniqueRuns.length, Number(countRow?.cnt ?? 0)),
  };
}

function buildMergedLeaderboard(
  storedUniqueRuns: GhostRun[],
  storedTotalUniqueRunners: number,
  seedOpts: {
    romId: string;
    consoleSystem: ConsoleSystemId;
    sprintId: string;
    romTitle: string;
    startWorldX: number;
    goalWorldX: number;
    dailyNumber?: number;
    courseIndex?: number;
  }
): { leaderboard: GhostRun[]; totalRuns: number } {
  const byTag = new Map<string, GhostRun>();
  for (const run of storedUniqueRuns) {
    const key = tagToSlug(run.tag);
    const existing = byTag.get(key);
    if (!existing || run.timeMs < existing.timeMs) {
      byTag.set(key, run);
    }
  }

  let unreplacedSeeds = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < SEED_NAMES.length; i++) {
    const seedRun = buildSeedGhostRun(i, seedOpts);
    const key = tagToSlug(seedRun.tag);
    const existing = byTag.get(key);
    if (!existing) {
      byTag.set(key, seedRun);
      unreplacedSeeds++;
    } else if (seedRun.timeMs < existing.timeMs && seedRun.verified && !existing.verified) {
      byTag.set(key, seedRun);
    }
  }

  const sorted = Array.from(byTag.values()).sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.timeMs !== b.timeMs) return a.timeMs - b.timeMs;
    if (Boolean(a.verified) !== Boolean(b.verified)) return a.verified ? -1 : 1;
    return 0;
  });

  return {
    leaderboard: sorted.slice(0, 10),
    totalRuns: Math.max(sorted.length, storedTotalUniqueRunners + unreplacedSeeds),
  };
}

export function getTop10CutoffTimeMs(
  romId: string,
  opts?: GetGhostsQueryOptions
): number {
  const effectiveSprintId = opts?.sprintId || romId;
  const consoleSystem = opts?.consoleSystem || 'nes';
  const startWorldX =
    typeof opts?.startWorldX === 'number'
      ? opts.startWorldX
      : romId === DEFAULT_ROM_ID
        ? DEFAULT_PROFILE.startWorldX
        : 48;
  const goalWorldX =
    typeof opts?.goalWorldX === 'number'
      ? opts.goalWorldX
      : romId === DEFAULT_ROM_ID
        ? DEFAULT_PROFILE.goalWorldX
        : 1280;
  const romTitle = opts?.romTitle || DEFAULT_PROFILE.stageLabel;

  let storedUniqueRuns: GhostRun[] = [];
  let totalUniqueRunners = 0;
  try {
    const queried = withSqliteRetry((db) => queryUniqueStoredRunsForSprint(db, effectiveSprintId));
    storedUniqueRuns = queried.uniqueRuns;
    totalUniqueRunners = queried.totalUniqueRunners;
  } catch {
    storedUniqueRuns = [];
  }

  const { leaderboard } = buildMergedLeaderboard(storedUniqueRuns, totalUniqueRunners, {
    romId,
    consoleSystem,
    sprintId: effectiveSprintId,
    romTitle,
    startWorldX,
    goalWorldX,
    dailyNumber: opts?.dailyNumber,
    courseIndex: opts?.courseIndex,
  });

  if (leaderboard.length < 10) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  return leaderboard[leaderboard.length - 1]?.timeMs ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
}

function findStoredRunBySlugOrTag(
  db: DatabaseSync,
  cleanSlug: string,
  sprintId?: string,
  romId?: string
): GhostRun | null {
  if (!cleanSlug) return null;

  // 1. Exact unique slug lookup (e.g. "ali-7x2k")
  if (sprintId) {
    const exactInSprint = db
      .prepare('SELECT * FROM ghost_runs WHERE slug = ? AND sprint_id = ? LIMIT 1')
      .get(cleanSlug, sprintId);
    if (exactInSprint) {
      const parsed = rowToGhostRun(exactInSprint);
      if (parsed) return parsed;
    }
  }

  const exactAny = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM ghost_runs WHERE slug = ? LIMIT 1').get(cleanSlug);
  if (exactAny) {
    const parsed = rowToGhostRun(exactAny);
    if (parsed) return parsed;
  }

  // 2. Backwards-compatible plain-tag lookup (e.g. "/vs/alex" or "/vs/ali" -> fastest PB for that tag)
  if (!cleanSlug.includes('-')) {
    if (sprintId) {
      const tagInSprint = db
        .prepare(
          `SELECT * FROM ghost_runs
           WHERE tag_slug = ? AND sprint_id = ?
           ORDER BY time_ms ASC
           LIMIT 1`
        )
        .get(cleanSlug, sprintId);
      if (tagInSprint) {
        const parsed = rowToGhostRun(tagInSprint);
        if (parsed) return parsed;
      }
    }

    if (romId) {
      const tagInRom = db
        .prepare(
          `SELECT * FROM ghost_runs
           WHERE tag_slug = ? AND rom_id = ?
           ORDER BY time_ms ASC
           LIMIT 1`
        )
        .get(cleanSlug, romId);
      if (tagInRom) {
        const parsed = rowToGhostRun(tagInRom);
        if (parsed) return parsed;
      }
    }

    const tagAny = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT * FROM ghost_runs
         WHERE tag_slug = ?
         ORDER BY time_ms ASC
         LIMIT 1`
      )
      .get(cleanSlug);
    if (tagAny) {
      const parsed = rowToGhostRun(tagAny);
      if (parsed) return parsed;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

export async function getGhostsForRom(
  romId: string,
  dareSlug?: string,
  opts?: GetGhostsQueryOptions
): Promise<{
  ghosts: GhostRun[];
  targetGhost: GhostRun | null;
  leaderboard: GhostRun[];
  totalRuns: number;
}> {
  const effectiveSprintId = opts?.sprintId || romId;
  const consoleSystem = opts?.consoleSystem || 'nes';
  const normalizedSlug = dareSlug ? normalizeDareSlug(dareSlug) : '';

  const startWorldX =
    typeof opts?.startWorldX === 'number'
      ? opts.startWorldX
      : romId === DEFAULT_ROM_ID
        ? DEFAULT_PROFILE.startWorldX
        : 48;
  const goalWorldX =
    typeof opts?.goalWorldX === 'number'
      ? opts.goalWorldX
      : romId === DEFAULT_ROM_ID
        ? DEFAULT_PROFILE.goalWorldX
        : 1280;
  const romTitle =
    opts?.romTitle ||
    (romId === DEFAULT_ROM_ID
      ? DEFAULT_PROFILE.stageLabel
      : `CUSTOM ${consoleSystem.toUpperCase()} SPRINT`);

  const seedOpts = {
    romId,
    consoleSystem,
    sprintId: effectiveSprintId,
    romTitle,
    startWorldX,
    goalWorldX,
    dailyNumber: opts?.dailyNumber,
    courseIndex: opts?.courseIndex,
  };

  let storedUniqueRuns: GhostRun[] = [];
  let totalUniqueRunners = 0;
  try {
    const queried = withSqliteRetry((db) => queryUniqueStoredRunsForSprint(db, effectiveSprintId));
    storedUniqueRuns = queried.uniqueRuns;
    totalUniqueRunners = queried.totalUniqueRunners;
  } catch {
    storedUniqueRuns = [];
  }

  const { leaderboard, totalRuns } = buildMergedLeaderboard(
    storedUniqueRuns,
    totalUniqueRunners,
    seedOpts
  );

  const alexSeed =
    leaderboard.find((r) => tagToSlug(r.tag) === 'alex') || buildSeedGhostRun(0, seedOpts);

  // 1. Incoming /vs/[slug] Dare Link -> race 1v1 against the Dare Challenger's Ghost
  let targetGhost: GhostRun | null = null;
  if (normalizedSlug) {
    try {
      targetGhost = withSqliteRetry((db) =>
        findStoredRunBySlugOrTag(db, normalizedSlug, effectiveSprintId, romId)
      );
    } catch {
      targetGhost = null;
    }
    if (!targetGhost) {
      const baseSlug = normalizedSlug.split('-')[0];
      const seedIdx = SEED_NAMES.findIndex((name) => tagToSlug(name) === baseSlug);
      if (seedIdx >= 0) {
        targetGhost = buildSeedGhostRun(seedIdx, seedOpts);
      }
    }
  }

  // 2. Standard Sprint -> race 1v1 against the #1 Top Score Ghost on the Leaderboard
  if (!targetGhost) {
    const topStored = storedUniqueRuns[0] ?? null;
    if (romId !== DEFAULT_ROM_ID && topStored) {
      targetGhost = topStored.timeMs <= (leaderboard[0]?.timeMs ?? topStored.timeMs)
        ? topStored
        : leaderboard[0] ?? topStored;
    } else {
      targetGhost = leaderboard[0] ?? alexSeed;
    }
  }

  const crownedTarget = targetGhost ? { ...targetGhost, color: '#FFE74C' } : null;
  return {
    ghosts: crownedTarget ? [crownedTarget] : [],
    targetGhost: crownedTarget,
    leaderboard,
    totalRuns,
  };
}

export async function findGhostBySlug(slug: string, sprintId?: string): Promise<GhostRun | null> {
  const clean = normalizeDareSlug(slug);
  if (!clean) return null;

  try {
    const stored = withSqliteRetry((db) => findStoredRunBySlugOrTag(db, clean, sprintId));
    if (stored) return stored;
  } catch {
    // Fall back to deterministic seed or stateless token
  }

  // Fallback to deterministic seed rival when querying "/vs/alex", "/vs/madeline", etc.
  const seedIdx = SEED_NAMES.findIndex((name) => tagToSlug(name) === clean);
  if (seedIdx >= 0) {
    let dailyNumber: number | undefined;
    let courseIndex: number | undefined;
    if (sprintId && /^daily-\d+$/.test(sprintId)) {
      dailyNumber = Number(sprintId.slice(6));
    } else if (sprintId) {
      const courseMatch = /:c(\d+)$/.exec(sprintId);
      if (courseMatch) {
        courseIndex = Number(courseMatch[1]);
      }
    }
    return buildSeedGhostRun(seedIdx, {
      romId: DEFAULT_ROM_ID,
      sprintId: sprintId || DEFAULT_ROM_ID,
      dailyNumber,
      courseIndex,
    });
  }

  return null;
}

export async function saveGhostRun(input: {
  clientRunId?: string;
  tag: string;
  romId: string;
  consoleSystem?: ConsoleSystemId;
  sprintId?: string;
  romTitle: string;
  timeMs: number;
  beatenCount: number;
  totalGhosts: number;
  emojiReceipt: string;
  frames: GhostKeyframe[];
  dailyNumber?: number;
  courseIndex?: number;
  startWorldX?: number;
  goalWorldX?: number;
  inputLog?: string;
  verified?: boolean;
  inputDigest?: string;
  parentSlug?: string;
}): Promise<GhostRun> {
  return withSqliteRetry((db) => {
    const tag = sanitizeArcadeTag(input.tag);
  const tagSlug = tagToSlug(tag);
  const consoleSystem = parseConsoleSystem(input.consoleSystem);
  const effectiveSprintId = input.sprintId || input.romId;
  const clampedTimeMs = Math.max(1000, Math.min(600_000, Math.round(input.timeMs)));
  const clampedBeaten = Math.max(0, Math.round(input.beatenCount));
  const clampedTotal = Math.max(1, Math.round(input.totalGhosts));
  const boundedFrames = input.frames.slice(0, 900);
  const cleanParentSlug = input.parentSlug ? normalizeDareSlug(input.parentSlug) : undefined;

  const cleanClientRunId = input.clientRunId
    ? input.clientRunId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '').slice(0, 48)
    : '';

  const existingRaw = cleanClientRunId
    ? db.prepare('SELECT * FROM ghost_runs WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1').get(cleanClientRunId)
    : undefined;
  const existingRun = existingRaw ? rowToGhostRun(existingRaw) : null;

  // Anti-hijack check: only allow updating an existing clientRunId row (when renaming Arcade Tag in
  // VictoryShareModal) if romId and timeMs match the originally recorded run!
  const canUpdateExisting =
    Boolean(existingRun) &&
    existingRun?.romId === input.romId &&
    existingRun?.timeMs === clampedTimeMs;

  const runId =
    cleanClientRunId && (!existingRun || canUpdateExisting)
      ? cleanClientRunId
      : `run-${tagSlug}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;

  const uniqueSlug = allocateCollisionFreeSlug(db, tag, runId);

  if (canUpdateExisting && existingRun) {
    db.prepare(
      `UPDATE ghost_runs
       SET slug = ?, tag = ?, tag_slug = ?
       WHERE id = ?`
    ).run(uniqueSlug, tag, tagSlug, runId);

    return {
      ...existingRun,
      slug: uniqueSlug,
      tag,
    };
  }

  const color = GHOST_PALETTE[Math.floor(Math.random() * GHOST_PALETTE.length)];
  const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();

  const run: GhostRun = {
    id: runId,
    slug: uniqueSlug,
    tag,
    romId: input.romId,
    consoleSystem,
    sprintId: effectiveSprintId,
    romTitle: input.romTitle,
    timeMs: clampedTimeMs,
    beatenCount: clampedBeaten,
    totalGhosts: clampedTotal,
    emojiReceipt: input.emojiReceipt,
    frames: boundedFrames,
    color,
    createdAt,
    ...(typeof input.dailyNumber === 'number' ? { dailyNumber: input.dailyNumber } : {}),
    ...(typeof input.courseIndex === 'number' ? { courseIndex: input.courseIndex } : {}),
    ...(typeof input.startWorldX === 'number' ? { startWorldX: input.startWorldX } : {}),
    ...(typeof input.goalWorldX === 'number' ? { goalWorldX: input.goalWorldX } : {}),
    ...(input.inputLog ? { inputLog: input.inputLog } : {}),
    ...(typeof input.verified === 'boolean' ? { verified: input.verified } : {}),
    ...(input.inputDigest ? { inputDigest: input.inputDigest } : {}),
    ...(cleanParentSlug ? { parentSlug: cleanParentSlug } : {}),
  };

  db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE;');
  try {
    db.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO ghost_runs (
        id, slug, tag, tag_slug, rom_id, console_system, sprint_id, rom_title,
        time_ms, beaten_count, total_ghosts, emoji_receipt, frames_json, died_at_frame,
        color, created_at, daily_number, course_index, start_world_x, goal_world_x,
        input_log, verified, input_digest, parent_slug
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?
      )`
    ).run(
      run.id,
      run.slug,
      run.tag,
      tagSlug,
      run.romId,
      consoleSystem,
      effectiveSprintId,
      run.romTitle,
      run.timeMs,
      run.beatenCount,
      run.totalGhosts,
      run.emojiReceipt,
      JSON.stringify(run.frames),
      null,
      run.color,
      run.createdAt,
      typeof run.dailyNumber === 'number' ? run.dailyNumber : null,
      typeof run.courseIndex === 'number' ? run.courseIndex : null,
      typeof run.startWorldX === 'number' ? run.startWorldX : null,
      typeof run.goalWorldX === 'number' ? run.goalWorldX : null,
      run.inputLog ?? null,
      run.verified ? 1 : 0,
      run.inputDigest ?? null,
      run.parentSlug ?? null
    );

    // Per-sprint bounded retention: keep top/recent 500 runs per sprint so disk stays compact
    db.prepare(
      `DELETE FROM ghost_runs
       WHERE sprint_id = ?
         AND id NOT IN (
           SELECT id FROM ghost_runs
           WHERE sprint_id = ?
           ORDER BY verified DESC, time_ms ASC, created_at DESC
           LIMIT ?
         )`
    ).run(effectiveSprintId, effectiveSprintId, MAX_STORED_RUNS_PER_SPRINT);

    db.exec('COMMIT;');
  } catch (err) {
    db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
    throw err;
  }

    return run;
  });
}

export function getRivalrySeriesSummary(
  sprintId: string,
  playerTag: string,
  rivalTag: string,
  parentSlug?: string | null
): RivalrySeriesSummary {
  const cleanPlayer = sanitizeArcadeTag(playerTag);
  const cleanRival = sanitizeArcadeTag(rivalTag);
  const playerSlug = tagToSlug(cleanPlayer);
  const rivalSlug = tagToSlug(cleanRival);

  if (!sprintId || playerSlug === rivalSlug) {
    return {
      playerTag: cleanPlayer,
      rivalTag: cleanRival,
      playerWins: 0,
      rivalWins: 0,
      totalBouts: 0,
      parentSlug: parentSlug || null,
    };
  }

  return withSqliteRetry((db) => {
    const rows = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT tag_slug, time_ms, created_at
         FROM ghost_runs
         WHERE sprint_id = ? AND tag_slug IN (?, ?) AND died_at_frame IS NULL
         ORDER BY created_at ASC
         LIMIT 60`
      )
      .all(sprintId, playerSlug, rivalSlug) as Array<{
      tag_slug?: string;
      time_ms?: number;
      created_at?: string;
    }>;

    let bestPlayerMs = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    let bestRivalMs = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    let playerWins = 0;
    let rivalWins = 0;

    for (const r of rows) {
      const tMs = Number(r.time_ms) || 0;
      if (tMs < 1000) continue;
      if (r.tag_slug === playerSlug) {
        if (tMs < bestPlayerMs) bestPlayerMs = tMs;
        if (Number.isFinite(bestRivalMs)) {
          if (tMs <= bestRivalMs) playerWins++;
          else rivalWins++;
        }
      } else if (r.tag_slug === rivalSlug) {
        if (tMs < bestRivalMs) bestRivalMs = tMs;
        if (Number.isFinite(bestPlayerMs)) {
          if (tMs <= bestPlayerMs) rivalWins++;
          else playerWins++;
        }
      }
    }

    // If rival is a built-in seed (not in SQLite rows), compare each player run against seed baseline
    if (!Number.isFinite(bestRivalMs)) {
      const seedIdx = SEED_NAMES.findIndex((n) => tagToSlug(n) === rivalSlug);
      if (seedIdx >= 0) {
        const seedRun = buildSeedGhostRun(seedIdx, { romId: DEFAULT_ROM_ID, sprintId });
        bestRivalMs = seedRun.timeMs;
        playerWins = 0;
        rivalWins = 0;
        for (const r of rows) {
          if (r.tag_slug !== playerSlug) continue;
          const tMs = Number(r.time_ms) || 0;
          if (tMs <= bestRivalMs) playerWins++;
          else rivalWins++;
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      playerTag: cleanPlayer,
      rivalTag: cleanRival,
      playerWins,
      rivalWins,
      totalBouts: playerWins + rivalWins,
      parentSlug: parentSlug || null,
    };
  });
}

export function upsertCommunitySegment(segment: CustomRomSegment): CustomRomSegment[] {
  return withSqliteRetry((db) => {
    const romId = String(segment.romId || '').slice(0, 64);
    const sprintId = String(segment.sprintId || '').slice(0, 80);
    if (!romId || !sprintId) return [];
    const id = String(segment.id || sprintId).slice(0, 80);
    const code = String(segment.code || 'S1').slice(0, 8).toUpperCase();
    const name = String(segment.name || 'CUSTOM SPRINT').slice(0, 28).toUpperCase();
    const startWorldX = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(segment.startWorldX) || 0));
    const goalWorldX = Math.max(startWorldX + 120, Math.round(Number(segment.goalWorldX) || 640));
    const previewDataUrl =
      typeof segment.previewDataUrl === 'string' && segment.previewDataUrl.length <= 48_000
        ? segment.previewDataUrl
        : null;
    const createdAt = Math.round(Number(segment.createdAt) || Date.now());

    db.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO community_segments (
        id, rom_id, sprint_id, code, name, start_world_x, goal_world_x, preview_data_url, created_at
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(sprint_id) DO UPDATE SET
        code = excluded.code,
        name = excluded.name,
        start_world_x = excluded.start_world_x,
        goal_world_x = excluded.goal_world_x,
        preview_data_url = COALESCE(excluded.preview_data_url, community_segments.preview_data_url)`
    ).run(id, romId, sprintId, code, name, startWorldX, goalWorldX, previewDataUrl, createdAt);

    return listCommunitySegmentsForRom(romId);
  });
}

export function listCommunitySegmentsForRom(romId: string): CustomRomSegment[] {
  if (!romId || romId === CELESTE_ROM_ID) return [];
  return withSqliteRetry((db) => {
    const rows = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT * FROM community_segments
         WHERE rom_id = ?
         ORDER BY created_at ASC
         LIMIT 5`
      )
      .all(romId) as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;

    return rows.map((r) => ({
      id: String(r.id || r.sprint_id || ''),
      romId: String(r.rom_id || romId),
      sprintId: String(r.sprint_id || ''),
      code: String(r.code || 'S1'),
      name: String(r.name || 'CUSTOM SPRINT'),
      startWorldX: Number(r.start_world_x) || 48,
      goalWorldX: Number(r.goal_world_x) || 640,
      ...(typeof r.preview_data_url === 'string' && r.preview_data_url
        ? { previewDataUrl: r.preview_data_url }
        : {}),
      createdAt: Number(r.created_at) || Date.now(),
    }));
  });
}

/**
 * Stage 12: Computes Top-10 Overall Mountain Standings across all segments of `romId`
 * (combining SQLite PBs with the 10 seeded runners per course so the board is always populated).
 */
export function getMountainStandings(romId: string = CELESTE_ROM_ID): MountainStandingEntry[] {
  const targetRomId = romId || CELESTE_ROM_ID;
  return withSqliteRetry((db) => {
    const rows = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT sprint_id, tag, tag_slug, MIN(time_ms) AS pb_ms
         FROM ghost_runs
         WHERE rom_id = ? AND died_at_frame IS NULL
         GROUP BY sprint_id, tag_slug`
      )
      .all(targetRomId) as Array<{
      sprint_id?: string;
      tag?: string;
      tag_slug?: string;
      pb_ms?: number;
    }>;

    // Map sprintId -> (tagSlug -> { tag, pbMs })
    const sprintPbs = new Map<string, Map<string, { tag: string; pbMs: number }>>();

    // Pre-populate with seeded Celeste course times so all 6 rooms have full 10-runner baselines
    if (targetRomId === CELESTE_ROM_ID) {
      for (let cIdx = 0; cIdx < 6; cIdx++) {
        const sprintId = cIdx === 0 ? CELESTE_ROM_ID : `${CELESTE_ROM_ID}:c${cIdx}`;
        const champMs = CELESTE_CHAMPION_REPLAYS[cIdx]?.timeMs ?? 15_000;
        const map = new Map<string, { tag: string; pbMs: number }>();
        for (let i = 0; i < SEED_NAMES.length; i++) {
          const name = SEED_NAMES[i];
          const slug = tagToSlug(name);
          const seedMs = Math.round(champMs + i * 515);
          map.set(slug, { tag: name, pbMs: seedMs });
        }
        sprintPbs.set(sprintId, map);
      }
    }

    for (const r of rows) {
      const sprintId = String(r.sprint_id || '');
      const slug = String(r.tag_slug || '');
      const tag = sanitizeArcadeTag(String(r.tag || 'RUNNER'));
      const pbMs = Math.round(Number(r.pb_ms) || 0);
      if (!sprintId || !slug || pbMs < 1000) continue;

      // Normalize daily Celeste sprintIds onto their underlying course sprintId if applicable
      let canonicalSprint = sprintId;
      if (targetRomId === CELESTE_ROM_ID && sprintId.startsWith('daily-')) {
        const dailyNum = Number(sprintId.replace('daily-', ''));
        if (Number.isFinite(dailyNum) && dailyNum >= 1) {
          const d = getDailySprintByNumber(dailyNum);
          canonicalSprint =
            d.course.courseIndex === 0
              ? CELESTE_ROM_ID
              : `${CELESTE_ROM_ID}:c${d.course.courseIndex}`;
        }
      }

      let map = sprintPbs.get(canonicalSprint);
      if (!map) {
        map = new Map();
        sprintPbs.set(canonicalSprint, map);
      }
      const existing = map.get(slug);
      if (!existing || pbMs < existing.pbMs) {
        map.set(slug, { tag, pbMs });
      }
    }

    // Aggregate per-runner crowns, roomsCleared, totalTimeMs, bestTimeMs
    const runnerTotals = new Map<
      string,
      {
        tag: string;
        crowns: number;
        roomsCleared: number;
        totalTimeMs: number;
        bestTimeMs: number;
      }
    >();

    for (const [, map] of sprintPbs.entries()) {
      let topMs = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
      for (const entry of map.values()) {
        if (entry.pbMs < topMs) topMs = entry.pbMs;
      }
      for (const [slug, entry] of map.entries()) {
        const cur = runnerTotals.get(slug) ?? {
          tag: entry.tag,
          crowns: 0,
          roomsCleared: 0,
          totalTimeMs: 0,
          bestTimeMs: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
        };
        cur.tag = entry.tag;
        cur.roomsCleared += 1;
        cur.totalTimeMs += entry.pbMs;
        if (entry.pbMs < cur.bestTimeMs) cur.bestTimeMs = entry.pbMs;
        if (entry.pbMs === topMs) cur.crowns += 1;
        runnerTotals.set(slug, cur);
      }
    }

    const sorted = Array.from(runnerTotals.values()).sort((a, b) => {
      if (b.roomsCleared !== a.roomsCleared) return b.roomsCleared - a.roomsCleared;
      if (b.crowns !== a.crowns) return b.crowns - a.crowns;
      if (a.totalTimeMs !== b.totalTimeMs) return a.totalTimeMs - b.totalTimeMs;
      return a.bestTimeMs - b.bestTimeMs;
    });

    return sorted.slice(0, 10).map((item, idx) => ({
      rank: idx + 1,
      tag: item.tag,
      crowns: item.crowns,
      roomsCleared: item.roomsCleared,
      totalTimeMs: item.totalTimeMs,
      bestTimeMs: Number.isFinite(item.bestTimeMs) ? item.bestTimeMs : 0,
    }));
  });
}
```

`lib/headlessVerifier.ts`:

```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { Worker } from 'node:worker_threads';
import { getCourseByIndex, getDailySprintByNumber } from './dailySprints';
import { expandInputLogToFrameMasks } from './inputReplay';
import { CELESTE_ROM_ID } from './romProfiles';
import type { GhostKeyframe } from './types';

export interface HeadlessWasmVerifyParams {
  romId: string;
  sprintId: string;
  claimedTimeMs: number;
  inputLog: string;
  courseIndex?: number;
  dailyNumber?: number;
  goalWorldX?: number;
}

export interface HeadlessWasmVerifyResult {
  supported: boolean;
  ok: boolean;
  verified: boolean;
  simulatedTimeMs?: number;
  goalFrame?: number;
  frames?: GhostKeyframe[];
  elapsedCpuMs?: number;
  reason?: string;
}

interface WorkerJobPayload {
  coreJsPath: string;
  coreWasmPath: string;
  romPath: string;
  canonicalStatePath: string;
  gameKind: 'celeste' | 'nova';
  worldIndex?: number;
  stageIndex?: number;
  startWarp?: number;
  goalWorldX: number;
  goalWarps?: readonly number[];
  warpYMap?: Readonly<Record<number, number>>;
  frameMasks: Uint8Array;
}

interface WorkerRawResult {
  ok: boolean;
  reachedGoal: boolean;
  died: boolean;
  goalFrame?: number;
  simulatedTimeMs?: number;
  frames?: GhostKeyframe[];
  elapsedCpuMs?: number;
  reason?: string;
}

const JOB_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;
const MAX_CLOCK_DRIFT_MS = 550;

let sharedWorker: Worker | null = null;
let jobSeq = 0;
const pendingJobs = new Map<
  number,
  {
    resolve: (res: WorkerRawResult) => void;
    reject: (err: Error) => void;
    timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
  }
>();
let queueChain: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();

function resolveCanonicalStatePath(courseIndex: number): string {
  const customDb = process.env.BITGEIST_DB_PATH?.trim();
  const primaryDir = path.join(
    customDb ? path.dirname(customDb) : path.join(process.cwd(), 'data'),
    'canonical-states'
  );
  const bundledDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data', 'canonical-states');

  const v2Primary = path.join(primaryDir, `celeste_v2_c${courseIndex}.state`);
  if (fs.existsSync(v2Primary)) return v2Primary;

  // Seed persistent volume from bundled pre-warmed state if available so production verifies in ~50ms
  for (const name of [`celeste_v2_c${courseIndex}.state`, `celeste_c${courseIndex}.state`]) {
    const candidate = path.join(bundledDir, name);
    if (fs.existsSync(candidate)) {
      try {
        fs.mkdirSync(primaryDir, { recursive: true });
        fs.copyFileSync(candidate, v2Primary);
        return v2Primary;
      } catch {
        return candidate;
      }
    }
  }

  return v2Primary;
}

function resetWorkerWithError(err: Error): void {
  const w = sharedWorker;
  sharedWorker = null;
  if (w) {
    try {
      void w.terminate();
    } catch {
      // ignore termination error
    }
  }
  for (const [id, entry] of pendingJobs.entries()) {
    clearTimeout(entry.timer);
    pendingJobs.delete(id);
    entry.reject(err);
  }
}

function getOrSpawnWorker(): Worker {
  if (sharedWorker) return sharedWorker;

  const workerPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'lib', 'wasmReplayWorker.mjs');
  const w = new Worker(workerPath);

  w.on('message', (msg: { id?: number; result?: WorkerRawResult; error?: string }) => {
    if (typeof msg?.id !== 'number') return;
    const entry = pendingJobs.get(msg.id);
    if (!entry) return;
    clearTimeout(entry.timer);
    pendingJobs.delete(msg.id);
    if (pendingJobs.size === 0) {
      w.unref();
    }
    if (msg.error) {
      entry.reject(new Error(msg.error));
    } else if (msg.result) {
      entry.resolve(msg.result);
    } else {
      entry.reject(new Error('Empty response from headless WASM replay worker'));
    }
  });

  w.on('error', (err) => {
    resetWorkerWithError(err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)));
  });

  w.on('exit', (code) => {
    if (sharedWorker === w) {
      resetWorkerWithError(new Error(`Headless WASM worker exited with code ${code}`));
    }
  });

  w.unref();
  sharedWorker = w;
  return w;
}

function enqueueWorkerJob(job: WorkerJobPayload): Promise<WorkerRawResult> {
  const run = () =>
    new Promise<WorkerRawResult>((resolve, reject) => {
      let worker: Worker;
      try {
        worker = getOrSpawnWorker();
      } catch (err) {
        reject(err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)));
        return;
      }

      const id = ++jobSeq;
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        pendingJobs.delete(id);
        resetWorkerWithError(new Error(`Headless WASM verification timed out after ${JOB_TIMEOUT_MS}ms`));
      }, JOB_TIMEOUT_MS);

      pendingJobs.set(id, { resolve, reject, timer });
      worker.ref();
      worker.postMessage({ id, job });
    });

  const next = queueChain.then(run, run);
  queueChain = next.catch(() => undefined);
  return next;
}

function resolveCelesteCourseIndex(params: {
  sprintId: string;
  courseIndex?: number;
  dailyNumber?: number;
}): number {
  if (typeof params.courseIndex === 'number' && params.courseIndex >= 0 && params.courseIndex <= 5) {
    return params.courseIndex;
  }
  if (typeof params.dailyNumber === 'number' && params.dailyNumber >= 1) {
    return getDailySprintByNumber(params.dailyNumber).course.courseIndex;
  }
  const dailyMatch = /^daily-(\d+)$/.exec(params.sprintId);
  if (dailyMatch) {
    return getDailySprintByNumber(Number(dailyMatch[1])).course.courseIndex;
  }
  const courseMatch = /:c(\d+)$/.exec(params.sprintId);
  if (courseMatch) {
    return Number(courseMatch[1]);
  }
  return 0;
}

export function isHeadlessWasmSupportedRom(romId: string): boolean {
  if (romId === CELESTE_ROM_ID) {
    return fs.existsSync(path.join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'roms', 'celeste.nes'));
  }
  return false;
}

export async function verifyNesRunHeadless(
  params: HeadlessWasmVerifyParams
): Promise<HeadlessWasmVerifyResult> {
  const coreJsPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'cores', 'fceumm_libretro.js');
  const coreWasmPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'cores', 'fceumm_libretro.wasm');

  if (!fs.existsSync(coreJsPath) || !fs.existsSync(coreWasmPath)) {
    return {
      supported: false,
      ok: true,
      verified: false,
      reason: 'Headless fceumm core assets missing',
    };
  }

  if (!isHeadlessWasmSupportedRom(params.romId)) {
    return {
      supported: false,
      ok: true,
      verified: false,
    };
  }

  const trimmedLog = params.inputLog?.trim();
  if (!trimmedLog) {
    return {
      supported: true,
      ok: false,
      verified: false,
      reason: 'Deterministic inputLog is required for leaderboard verification',
    };
  }

  const frameMasks = expandInputLogToFrameMasks(trimmedLog);
  if (!frameMasks || frameMasks.length < 30) {
    return {
      supported: true,
      ok: false,
      verified: false,
      reason: 'Malformed or truncated inputLog',
    };
  }

  if (params.romId === CELESTE_ROM_ID) {
    const romPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'roms', 'celeste.nes');
    const resolvedIdx = resolveCelesteCourseIndex(params);
    const course = getCourseByIndex(resolvedIdx);
    const canonicalStatePath = resolveCanonicalStatePath(course.courseIndex);

    try {
      const raw = await enqueueWorkerJob({
        coreJsPath,
        coreWasmPath,
        romPath,
        canonicalStatePath,
        gameKind: 'celeste',
        worldIndex: course.worldIndex,
        startWarp: course.startWarp ?? course.stageIndex,
        goalWorldX: course.goalWorldX,
        goalWarps: course.goalWarps ?? [],
        warpYMap: course.warpYMap ?? {},
        frameMasks,
      });

      if (!raw.ok || !raw.reachedGoal || !raw.simulatedTimeMs) {
        return {
          supported: true,
          ok: false,
          verified: false,
          elapsedCpuMs: raw.elapsedCpuMs,
          reason: raw.reason || 'Headless WASM replay failed to reach finish gate',
        };
      }

      if (Math.abs(raw.simulatedTimeMs - params.claimedTimeMs) > MAX_CLOCK_DRIFT_MS) {
        return {
          supported: true,
          ok: false,
          verified: false,
          simulatedTimeMs: raw.simulatedTimeMs,
          goalFrame: raw.goalFrame,
          elapsedCpuMs: raw.elapsedCpuMs,
          reason: `Claimed time (${params.claimedTimeMs}ms) diverges from deterministic WASM simulation (${raw.simulatedTimeMs}ms)`,
        };
      }

      return {
        supported: true,
        ok: true,
        verified: true,
        simulatedTimeMs: raw.simulatedTimeMs,
        goalFrame: raw.goalFrame,
        frames: raw.frames,
        elapsedCpuMs: raw.elapsedCpuMs,
      };
    } catch (err) {
      return {
        supported: true,
        ok: false,
        verified: false,
        reason: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Headless WASM verifier error',
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    supported: false,
    ok: true,
    verified: false,
  };
}

export async function shutdownHeadlessVerifierForTests(): Promise<void> {
  const w = sharedWorker;
  sharedWorker = null;
  if (w) {
    await w.terminate();
  }
}
```

```ts
export type RunnerArchetypeId = 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;

export type RunnerPoseId = 'idleA' | 'idleB' | 'run1' | 'run2' | 'run3' | 'jump' | 'fall';

  main: HTMLCanvasElement;
  echo: HTMLCanvasElement;
}

const CURATED_TAG_ARCHETYPES: Record<string, RunnerArchetypeId> = {
  ALEX: 0, // Horned Dragon Champion
  DINKY: 0, // Horned Dragon Kid
  MADELINE: 2, // Billowing Headband Climber
  THEO: 1, // Visor Explorer
  BADELINE: 4, // Pointed-Ear Shadow Striker
  MIRA: 1, // Cyber-Visor Striker
  PIXEL: 1, // Cyber-Visor Striker
  KAI: 2, // Headband Shinobi
  RINA: 2, // Headband Shinobi
  ZED: 3, // Plumed Paladin Knight
  JAX: 3, // Plumed Paladin Knight
  MINKY: 4, // Pointed-Ear Astro Pilot
  LUMA: 4, // Pointed-Ear Astro Pilot
};

export function getRunnerArchetypeForTag(tag: string): RunnerArchetypeId {
  const upper = (tag || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (upper in CURATED_TAG_ARCHETYPES) {
    return CURATED_TAG_ARCHETYPES[upper];
  }
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < upper.length; i++) {
    h ^= upper.charCodeAt(i);
    h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
  }
  return ((h >>> 0) % 5) as RunnerArchetypeId;
}

function parseHexToRgb(hex: string): [number, number, number] {
  const clean = hex.replace('#', '').trim();
  if (clean.length === 3) {
    return [
      parseInt(clean[0] + clean[0], 16) || 255,
      parseInt(clean[1] + clean[1], 16) || 231,
      parseInt(clean[2] + clean[2], 16) || 76,
    ];
  }
  return [
    parseInt(clean.slice(0, 2), 16) || 255,
    parseInt(clean.slice(2, 4), 16) || 231,
    parseInt(clean.slice(4, 6), 16) || 76,
  ];
}

function mixRgb(
  a: [number, number, number],
  b: [number, number, number],
  t: number
): [number, number, number] {
  return [
    Math.round(a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t),
    Math.round(a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t),
    Math.round(a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t),
  ];
}

function rgbaStr(rgb: [number, number, number], alpha: number): string {
  return `rgba(${rgb[0]},${rgb[1]},${rgb[2]},${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
}

function pickAccentRgb(primary: [number, number, number]): [number, number, number] {
  // Warm golden/yellow runners (like Crowned @ALEX) get punchy Famicom Coral-Red horns/boots;
  // coral/pink runners get bright Golden-Yellow trim; cool blue/mint/violet runners get warm Gold trim.
  const isWarmYellow = primary[0] > 215 && primary[1] > 180 && primary[2] < 130;
  if (isWarmYellow) return [236, 92, 74]; // #EC5C4A
  const isReddish = primary[0] > 200 && primary[1] < 140;
  if (isReddish) return [255, 231, 76]; // #FFE74C
  return [255, 234, 112]; // #FFEA70
}

function buildCharacterGrid(
  archetype: RunnerArchetypeId,
  pose: RunnerPoseId,
  facingLeft: boolean
): string[][] {
  const grid: string[][] = Array.from({ length: GRID_H }, () =>
    Array.from({ length: GRID_W }, () => '.')
  );

  const head = ARCHETYPE_HEADS[archetype];
  const body = POSE_BODIES[pose];

  // Subtle vertical head bob (+1px on idleB crouch, -1px on airborne jump/run2 apex)
  const headOffsetY = pose === 'idleB' ? 2 : pose === 'jump' || pose === 'run2' ? 0 : 1;
  // Slight forward lean (+1px right) during full sprint strides
  const headOffsetX = pose === 'run1' || pose === 'run3' ? 1 : 0;

  for (let r = 0; r < head.length; r++) {
    const rowStr = head[r];
    const gy = r + headOffsetY;
    if (gy < 1 || gy >= GRID_H - 2) continue;
    for (let c = 0; c < GRID_W; c++) {
      const ch = rowStr[c] || '.';
      if (ch === '.') continue;
      const gx = c + headOffsetX;
      if (gx >= 1 && gx < GRID_W - 1) {
        grid[gy][gx] = ch;
      }
    }
  }

  // Animated Shinobi headband tail wave on run2 / jump / fall
  if (archetype === 2 && (pose === 'run2' || pose === 'jump' || pose === 'fall')) {
    const waveUp = pose === 'fall' ? -1 : 1;
    if (grid[5 + waveUp]) {
      grid[5 + waveUp][1] = 'A';
      grid[5 + waveUp][2] = 'A';
    }
  }

  for (let r = 0; r < body.length; r++) {
    const rowStr = body[r];
    const gy = 9 + r;
    if (gy >= GRID_H - 1) continue;
    for (let c = 0; c < GRID_W; c++) {
      const ch = rowStr[c] || '.';
      if (ch !== '.') {
        grid[gy][c] = ch;
      }
    }
  }

  // Archetype-specific back details: Dragon wagging tail (0) & Knight fluttering short cape (3)
  if (archetype === 0) {
    const tailY = pose === 'run1' || pose === 'jump' ? 12 : 13;
    grid[tailY][3] = 'P';
    grid[tailY][2] = 'A';
    grid[tailY - 1][2] = 'A';
  } else if (archetype === 3) {
    const capeLift = pose === 'run1' || pose === 'run3' || pose === 'fall' ? -1 : 0;
    grid[10][4] = 'A';
    grid[11 + capeLift][3] = 'A';
    grid[11 + capeLift][4] = 'A';
    grid[12 + capeLift][2] = 'A';
    grid[12 + capeLift][3] = 'A';
  }

  // Mirror horizontally if facing left
  if (facingLeft) {
    for (let y = 0; y < GRID_H; y++) {
      grid[y].reverse();
    }
  }

  // Automatic 4-connected 1px NES outer silhouette outline ('#')
  const outlined = grid.map((row) => [...row]);
  const dirs = [
    [-1, 0],
    [1, 0],
    [0, -1],
    [0, 1],
  ];
  for (let y = 0; y < GRID_H; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < GRID_W; x++) {
      if (grid[y][x] !== '.') continue;
      for (let d = 0; d < dirs.length; d++) {
        const ny = y + dirs[d][0];
        const nx = x + dirs[d][1];
        if (ny >= 0 && ny < GRID_H && nx >= 0 && nx < GRID_W && grid[ny][nx] !== '.') {
          outlined[y][x] = '#';
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return outlined;
}

const MAX_SPRITE_CACHE_ENTRIES = 512;
const spriteCache = new Map<string, BakedRunnerSprites>();

export function getHologramRunnerSprites(
  archetype: RunnerArchetypeId,
  primaryHex: string,
  pose: RunnerPoseId,
  facingLeft: boolean
): BakedRunnerSprites | null {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null;

  const key = `${archetype}|${primaryHex}|${pose}|${facingLeft ? 'L' : 'R'}`;
  const cached = spriteCache.get(key);
  if (cached) return cached;

  const grid = buildCharacterGrid(archetype, pose, facingLeft);
  const primary = parseHexToRgb(primaryHex);
  const highlight = mixRgb(primary, [255, 255, 255], 0.56);
  const shadow = mixRgb(primary, [18, 16, 32], 0.44);
  const accent = pickAccentRgb(primary);
  const visor: [number, number, number] = [255, 253, 245];
  const pupil: [number, number, number] = [20, 19, 28];
  const outline: [number, number, number] = [17, 17, 17];

  const mainCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  mainCanvas.width = GRID_W * PIXEL_SCALE;
  mainCanvas.height = GRID_H * PIXEL_SCALE;
  const mCtx = mainCanvas.getContext('2d');

  const echoCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  echoCanvas.width = GRID_W * PIXEL_SCALE;
  echoCanvas.height = GRID_H * PIXEL_SCALE;
  const eCtx = echoCanvas.getContext('2d');

  if (!mCtx || !eCtx) return null;

  for (let y = 0; y < GRID_H; y++) {
    // Subtle 8-bit hologram scanline shimmer on odd NES rows
    const scanAlpha = y % 2 === 0 ? 0.96 : 0.82;
    const echoScanAlpha = y % 2 === 0 ? 0.88 : 0.36;

    for (let x = 0; x < GRID_W; x++) {
      const token = grid[y][x];
      if (token === '.') continue;

      const px = x * PIXEL_SCALE;
      const py = y * PIXEL_SCALE;

      if (token === '#') {
        mCtx.fillStyle = rgbaStr(outline, 0.94);
        mCtx.fillRect(px, py, PIXEL_SCALE, PIXEL_SCALE);

        eCtx.fillStyle = rgbaStr(primary, 0.25 * echoScanAlpha);
        eCtx.fillRect(px, py, PIXEL_SCALE, PIXEL_SCALE);
        continue;
      }

      const rgb =
        token === 'H'
          ? highlight
          : token === 'S'
            ? shadow
            : token === 'A'
              ? accent
              : token === 'V'
                ? visor
                : token === 'E'
                  ? pupil
                  : primary;

      mCtx.fillStyle = rgbaStr(rgb, token === 'E' || token === 'V' ? 0.98 : scanAlpha);
      mCtx.fillRect(px, py, PIXEL_SCALE, PIXEL_SCALE);

      const echoRgb = token === 'H' || token === 'V' ? highlight : primary;
      eCtx.fillStyle = rgbaStr(echoRgb, echoScanAlpha);
      eCtx.fillRect(px, py, PIXEL_SCALE, PIXEL_SCALE);
    }
  }

  const pair: BakedRunnerSprites = { main: mainCanvas, echo: echoCanvas };
  if (spriteCache.size >= MAX_SPRITE_CACHE_ENTRIES) {
    const oldestKey = spriteCache.keys().next().value;
    if (typeof oldestKey === 'string') {
      spriteCache.delete(oldestKey);
    }
  }
  spriteCache.set(key, pair);
  return pair;
}

/**
 * Hand-crafted 13x8 NES Pixel-Art 3-Point Jeweled Golden Crown (26x16 at 2x canvas scale).
 */
const CROWN_GRID: readonly string[] = [
  '......#......',
  '.#...#W#...#.',
  '#W#.#WGG#.#W#',
  '#GG#GGRGG#GG#',
  '#GWGGWRWGGDG#',
  '.#GGGGRGGGD#.',
  '.#DDGGGGGDD#.',
  '..#########..',
];

let cachedCrownCanvas: HTMLCanvasElement | null = null;

export function getPixelCrownSprite(): HTMLCanvasElement | null {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null;
  if (cachedCrownCanvas) return cachedCrownCanvas;

  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = 13 * PIXEL_SCALE;
  c.height = 8 * PIXEL_SCALE;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) return null;

  const palette: Record<string, string> = {
    '#': '#111111',
    G: '#F5C342',
    W: '#FFF9C4',
    D: '#C98A18',
    R: '#EC5545',
  };

  for (let y = 0; y < CROWN_GRID.length; y++) {
    const row = CROWN_GRID[y];
    for (let x = 0; x < row.length; x++) {
      const color = palette[row[x]];
      if (!color) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      ctx.fillRect(x * PIXEL_SCALE, y * PIXEL_SCALE, PIXEL_SCALE, PIXEL_SCALE);
    }
  }

  cachedCrownCanvas = c;
  return c;
}

/**
 * Selects the natural NES platformer animation pose from instantaneous velocity & frame phase.
 */
export function selectRunnerPose(params: {
  isWaiting: boolean;
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  animPhase: number;
  runnerSeed: number;
  distanceX: number;
}): RunnerPoseId {
  const { isWaiting, vx, vy, animPhase, runnerSeed, distanceX } = params;
  if (isWaiting) {
    return Math.sin(animPhase * 0.75 + runnerSeed * 1.3) >= 0 ? 'idleA' : 'idleB';
  }
  if (vy < -0.42) {
    return 'jump';
  }
  if (vy > 0.48) {
    return 'fall';
  }
  if (Math.abs(vx) < 0.14) {
    return Math.sin(animPhase * 0.8 + runnerSeed) >= 0 ? 'idleA' : 'idleB';
  }
  // Distance-driven 4-step NES run cycle: run1 -> run2 -> run3 -> run2
  const cycleStep = Math.floor(Math.abs(distanceX) * 0.14 + runnerSeed * 2) & 3;
  if (cycleStep === 0) return 'run1';
  if (cycleStep === 2) return 'run3';
  return 'run2';
}

/**
 * Draws an 8-way NES Mega-style hologram de-rez burst when a rival perishes in a pit/hazard.
 */
export function drawHologramDerezBurst(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  colorHex: string,
  progress01: number
): void {
  const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress01));
  const radius = 6 + clamped * 34;
  const prevAlpha = ctx.globalAlpha;
  ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, (1 - clamped) * 0.9);

  for (let dir = 0; dir < 8; dir++) {
    const angle = (dir * Math.PI) / 4;
    const px = Math.round(cx + Math.cos(angle) * radius);
    const py = Math.round(cy + Math.sin(angle) * radius);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111111';
    ctx.fillRect(px - 4, py - 4, 8, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = dir % 2 === 0 ? colorHex : '#FFF9E6';
    ctx.fillRect(px - 2, py - 2, 4, 4);
  }

  ctx.globalAlpha = prevAlpha;
}
```
