`lib/inputReplay.ts`:

```ts
import type { GhostKeyframe } from './types';

export const NES_INPUT_RIGHT = 0x01;
export const NES_INPUT_LEFT = 0x02;
export const NES_INPUT_DOWN = 0x04;
export const NES_INPUT_UP = 0x08;
export const NES_INPUT_START = 0x10;
export const NES_INPUT_SELECT = 0x20;
export const NES_INPUT_B = 0x40;
export const NES_INPUT_A = 0x80;

export const NES_MASK_BUTTON_ENTRIES: ReadonlyArray<readonly [mask: number, button: string]> = [
  [NES_INPUT_RIGHT, 'right'],
  [NES_INPUT_LEFT, 'left'],
  [NES_INPUT_DOWN, 'down'],
  [NES_INPUT_UP, 'up'],
  [NES_INPUT_START, 'start'],
  [NES_INPUT_SELECT, 'select'],
  [NES_INPUT_A, 'a'],
  [NES_INPUT_B, 'b'],
];

const MAX_REPLAY_FRAMES = 36_000;
const MAX_RLE_SEGMENTS = 2_400;

interface RleInputSegment {
  mask: number;
  count: number;
}

/**
 * Records per-frame 8-bit NES joypad bitmasks at exact 60Hz race-frame resolution
 * and compresses consecutive identical frames via Run-Length Encoding (`maskHex:countBase36`).
 */
export class InputLogRecorder {
  private segments: RleInputSegment[] = [];
  private lastRecordedFrame = -1;

  reset(): void {
    this.segments = [];
    this.lastRecordedFrame = -1;
  }

  recordUpToFrame(targetFrame: number, mask: number): void {
    const clampedTarget = Math.min(MAX_REPLAY_FRAMES, Math.max(0, Math.round(targetFrame)));
    if (clampedTarget <= this.lastRecordedFrame) return;

    const deltaFrames = clampedTarget - this.lastRecordedFrame;
    const byteMask = mask & 0xff;
    const prev = this.segments[this.segments.length - 1];

    if (prev && prev.mask === byteMask) {
      prev.count += deltaFrames;
    } else if (this.segments.length < MAX_RLE_SEGMENTS) {
      this.segments.push({ mask: byteMask, count: deltaFrames });
    } else if (prev) {
      prev.count += deltaFrames;
    }

    this.lastRecordedFrame = clampedTarget;
  }

  serialize(): string {
    if (this.segments.length === 0) return '';
    return this.segments
      .map((seg) => `${seg.mask.toString(16)}:${seg.count.toString(36)}`)
      .join('.');
  }
}

function decodeRleInputLog(
  encoded: string
): { segments: RleInputSegment[]; totalFrames: number } | null {
  if (typeof encoded !== 'string') return null;
  const trimmed = encoded.trim();
  if (!trimmed || trimmed.length > 16_384) return null;
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{1,2}:[0-9a-z]+(\.[0-9a-f]{1,2}:[0-9a-z]+)*$/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return null;
  }

  const rawParts = trimmed.split('.');
  if (rawParts.length > MAX_RLE_SEGMENTS) return null;

  const segments: RleInputSegment[] = [];
  let totalFrames = 0;

  for (const part of rawParts) {
    const colonIdx = part.indexOf(':');
    if (colonIdx <= 0) return null;
    const mask = parseInt(part.slice(0, colonIdx), 16);
    const count = parseInt(part.slice(colonIdx + 1), 36);
    if (!Number.isFinite(mask) || !Number.isFinite(count) || mask < 0 || mask > 255 || count <= 0) {
      return null;
    }
    totalFrames += count;
    if (totalFrames > MAX_REPLAY_FRAMES + 600) return null;
    segments.push({ mask, count });
  }

  return { segments, totalFrames };
}

export function expandInputLogToFrameMasks(encoded: string): Uint8Array | null {
  const decoded = decodeRleInputLog(encoded);
  if (!decoded || decoded.totalFrames <= 0) return null;

  const out = new Uint8Array(decoded.totalFrames);
  let cursor = 0;
  for (const seg of decoded.segments) {
    out.fill(seg.mask, cursor, cursor + seg.count);
    cursor += seg.count;
  }
  return out;
}

export function computeFnv1aHex(input: string): string {
  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
    hash ^= input.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193);
  }
  return (hash >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

interface IntegrityCheckResult {
  ok: boolean;
  hardReject: boolean;
  verified: boolean;
  inputDigest?: string;
  reason?: string;
}

/**
 * Two-tier Anti-Cheat Validator for POST /api/ghosts:
 * 1. Physics & Chronology Guard (Hard-rejects spoofed telemetry / speedhacks with HTTP 422).
 * 2. RLE Joypad Input-Log Verification (Validates frame duration, directional correlation,
 *    and computes a deterministic FNV-1a inputDigest to award `verified: true`).
 */
export function verifyGhostRunIntegrity(params: {
  romId: string;
  timeMs: number;
  frames: GhostKeyframe[];
  maxPxPerFrame?: number;
  inputLog?: string;
}): IntegrityCheckResult {
  const { romId, timeMs, frames } = params;
  const maxPxPerFrame = params.maxPxPerFrame ?? 6.5;

  if (frames.length < 2) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      hardReject: true,
      verified: false,
      reason: 'Insufficient telemetry keyframes',
    };
  }

  // 1. Monotonic frame timestamps & duration alignment
  let minX = frames[0][1];
  let maxX = frames[0][1];

  for (let i = 1; i < frames.length; i++) {
    const [prevF, prevX] = frames[i - 1];
    const [curF, curX] = frames[i];
    if (curF < prevF) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        hardReject: true,
        verified: false,
        reason: 'Non-monotonic keyframe timestamps',
      };
    }
    if (curX < minX) minX = curX;
    if (curX > maxX) maxX = curX;

    const df = Math.max(1, curF - prevF);
    const stepDx = Math.abs(curX - prevX);
    // Reject blatant single-step horizontal teleports (>320px within <=6 frames)
    if (df <= 6 && stepDx > 320) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        hardReject: true,
        verified: false,
        reason: 'Impossible single-step horizontal teleport detected',
      };
    }
  }

  const expectedFrames = (timeMs / 1000) * 60;
  const lastFrame = frames[frames.length - 1][0];
  const frameDriftAllowance = Math.max(28, expectedFrames * 0.2);

  if (Math.abs(lastFrame - expectedFrames) > frameDriftAllowance) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      hardReject: true,
      verified: false,
      reason: 'Finish time does not match recorded keyframe duration',
    };
  }

  const spanX = Math.max(0, maxX - minX);
  const avgPxPerFrame = spanX / Math.max(1, expectedFrames);
  if (avgPxPerFrame > maxPxPerFrame * 1.45) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      hardReject: true,
      verified: false,
      reason: `Average horizontal speed (${avgPxPerFrame.toFixed(2)} px/f) exceeds cartridge physics bound`,
    };
  }

  // 2. Optional RLE Input-Log Verification
  if (!params.inputLog) {
    return { ok: true, hardReject: false, verified: false };
  }

  const decoded = decodeRleInputLog(params.inputLog);
  if (!decoded) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      hardReject: false,
      verified: false,
      reason: 'Malformed RLE inputLog',
    };
  }

  const inputDriftAllowance = Math.max(28, expectedFrames * 0.2);
  if (Math.abs(decoded.totalFrames - expectedFrames) > inputDriftAllowance) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      hardReject: false,
      verified: false,
      reason: 'Input log frame count mismatch',
    };
  }

  let rightFrames = 0;
  let propulsionFrames = 0;
  let activeFrames = 0;
  const propulsionMask = NES_INPUT_RIGHT | NES_INPUT_UP | NES_INPUT_A | NES_INPUT_B;
  for (const seg of decoded.segments) {
    if ((seg.mask & NES_INPUT_RIGHT) !== 0) {
      rightFrames += seg.count;
    }
    if ((seg.mask & propulsionMask) !== 0) {
      propulsionFrames += seg.count;
    }
    if (seg.mask !== 0) {
      activeFrames += seg.count;
    }
  }

  const netForwardX = frames[frames.length - 1][1] - frames[0][1];
  const netClimbY = Math.abs(frames[frames.length - 1][2] - frames[0][2]);
  const rightRatio = rightFrames / Math.max(1, decoded.totalFrames);
  const propulsionRatio = propulsionFrames / Math.max(1, decoded.totalFrames);
  const isVerticalClimbCourse = netClimbY >= 120;

  const lacksDirectionalCorrelation =
    netForwardX >= 250 &&
    (isVerticalClimbCourse
      ? rightRatio < 0.05 || propulsionRatio < 0.18
      : rightRatio < 0.16 && propulsionRatio < 0.24);

  if (activeFrames < 15 || lacksDirectionalCorrelation) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      hardReject: false,
      verified: false,
      reason: 'Insufficient directional input correlation',
    };
  }

  const inputDigest = computeFnv1aHex(`${romId}|${Math.round(timeMs)}|${params.inputLog}`);
  return {
    ok: true,
    hardReject: false,
    verified: true,
    inputDigest,
  };
}
```

`lib/localPbGhosts.ts`:

```ts
import type { GhostRun } from './types';

const PB_GHOSTS_STORAGE_KEY = 'bitgeist_pb_ghosts_v1';
const MAX_STORED_PB_GHOSTS = 24;

interface StoredPbGhostMap {
  [sprintId: string]: GhostRun;
}

export function getLocalPbGhost(sprintId: string): GhostRun | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !sprintId) return null;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(PB_GHOSTS_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as StoredPbGhostMap;
    const entry = parsed?.[sprintId];
    if (
      !entry ||
      typeof entry.timeMs !== 'number' ||
      !Array.isArray(entry.frames) ||
      entry.frames.length < 2
    ) {
      return null;
    }
    return entry;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function saveLocalPbGhostIfFaster(sprintId: string, candidate: GhostRun): GhostRun {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !sprintId) return candidate;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(PB_GHOSTS_STORAGE_KEY);
    const parsed: StoredPbGhostMap = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as StoredPbGhostMap) : {};
    const existing = parsed[sprintId];
    if (existing && typeof existing.timeMs === 'number' && existing.timeMs < candidate.timeMs) {
      return existing;
    }

    const boundedCandidate: GhostRun = {
      ...candidate,
      sprintId,
      frames: candidate.frames.slice(0, 450),
      color: '#4CC9F0',
    };
    parsed[sprintId] = boundedCandidate;

    const entries = Object.entries(parsed).sort((a, b) => {
      const ta = Date.parse(a[1]?.createdAt || '') || 0;
      const tb = Date.parse(b[1]?.createdAt || '') || 0;
      return tb - ta;
    });

    const trimmed: StoredPbGhostMap = {};
    for (const [k, v] of entries.slice(0, MAX_STORED_PB_GHOSTS)) {
      trimmed[k] = v;
    }
    localStorage.setItem(PB_GHOSTS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(trimmed));
    return boundedCandidate;
  } catch {
    return candidate;
  }
}
```

`lib/nesRamBridge.ts`:

```ts
import type { Nostalgist } from 'nostalgist';
import type { ConsoleSystemId } from './types';

export interface SystemRamRegion {
  offset: number;
  size: number;
}

const EXPECTED_RAM_BYTES: Record<ConsoleSystemId, number> = {
  nes: 0x800, // 2KB CPU RAM
  snes: 0x20000, // 128KB WRAM ($7E0000-$7FFFFF)
  genesis: 0x10000, // 64KB 68000 Work RAM ($FF0000-$FFFFFF)
  gb: 0x2000, // 8KB DMG/CGB Base WRAM ($C000-$DFFF)
  gba: 0x8000, // 32KB Fast IWRAM ($03000000-$03007FFF)
};

async function unwrapStateBytes(blob: Blob): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const raw = new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer());
  if (raw.length > 2 && typeof DecompressionStream !== 'undefined') {
    const isGzip = raw[0] === 0x1f && raw[1] === 0x8b;
    const isZlib =
      raw[0] === 0x78 &&
      (raw[1] === 0x01 || raw[1] === 0x5e || raw[1] === 0x9c || raw[1] === 0xda);

    if (isGzip || isZlib) {
      try {
        const ds = new DecompressionStream(isGzip ? 'gzip' : 'deflate');
        const stream = blob.stream().pipeThrough(ds);
        return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());
      } catch {
        return raw;
      }
    }
  }
  return raw;
}

function extractFceummRamFromSaveState(stateBytes: Uint8Array): Uint8Array | null {
  const limit = stateBytes.length - 2056;
  for (let i = 0; i <= limit; i++) {
    if (
      stateBytes[i] === 0x52 &&
      stateBytes[i + 1] === 0x41 &&
      stateBytes[i + 2] === 0x4d &&
      stateBytes[i + 3] === 0x00 &&
      stateBytes[i + 4] === 0x00 &&
      stateBytes[i + 5] === 0x08 &&
      stateBytes[i + 6] === 0x00 &&
      stateBytes[i + 7] === 0x00
    ) {
      return stateBytes.subarray(i + 8, i + 8 + 0x800);
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function extractMgbaIwramFromSaveState(stateBytes: Uint8Array): Uint8Array | null {
  // mGBA GBASerializedState (~528KB) stores 32KB GBA Fast IWRAM ($03000000-$03007FFF) at 0x19000..0x21000
  if (stateBytes.length >= 0x80000 && stateBytes.length <= 0x90000) {
    return stateBytes.subarray(0x19000, 0x21000);
  }
  return null;
}

async function pickLiveMutatingCandidate(
  nostalgist: Nostalgist,
  candidates: number[],
  targetSize: number
): Promise<number | null> {
  if (candidates.length === 0) return null;
  if (candidates.length === 1) return candidates[0];

  const mod = nostalgist.getEmscriptenModule() as unknown as { HEAPU8?: Uint8Array };
  const heap = mod?.HEAPU8;
  if (!heap) return candidates[0];

  const probeLen = Math.min(targetSize, 0x8000);
  const beforeSlices = candidates.map((ptr) => heap.slice(ptr, ptr + probeLen));
  nostalgist.resume();
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 55));
  nostalgist.pause();

  const freshHeap = (nostalgist.getEmscriptenModule() as unknown as { HEAPU8?: Uint8Array }).HEAPU8;
  if (freshHeap) {
    for (let idx = 0; idx < candidates.length; idx++) {
      const ptr = candidates[idx];
      const prev = beforeSlices[idx];
      for (let b = 0; b < probeLen; b += 4) {
        if (freshHeap[ptr + b] !== prev[b]) {
          return ptr;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return candidates[0];
}

function extractSnes9xWramFromSaveState(stateBytes: Uint8Array): Uint8Array | null {
  // snes9x labels 128KB Work RAM as ASCII "RAM:131072:" followed by 0x20000 raw WRAM bytes
  const tag = 'RAM:131072:';
  const limit = stateBytes.length - (tag.length + 0x20000);
  for (let i = 0; i <= limit; i++) {
    if (stateBytes[i] !== 0x52) continue;
    let ok = true;
    for (let k = 1; k < tag.length; k++) {
      if (stateBytes[i + k] !== tag.charCodeAt(k)) {
        ok = false;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (ok) {
      return stateBytes.subarray(i + tag.length, i + tag.length + 0x20000);
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function matchSnapshotInHeap(
  heap: Uint8Array,
  snapshot: Uint8Array,
  targetSize: number
): number[] {
  const candidates: number[] = [];
  if (snapshot.length < targetSize || heap.length < targetSize) return candidates;

  // Pick a non-trivial 4-byte anchor inside the snapshot
  let anchorOffset = Math.min(0x1fc, targetSize - 8);
  for (let probe = 0x40; probe < Math.min(targetSize - 8, 0x1000); probe += 16) {
    const a = snapshot[probe];
    const b = snapshot[probe + 1];
    const c = snapshot[probe + 2];
    const d = snapshot[probe + 3];
    if ((a !== 0 || b !== 0 || c !== 0 || d !== 0) && !(a === b && b === c && c === d)) {
      anchorOffset = probe;
      break;
    }
  }

  const a0 = snapshot[anchorOffset];
  const a1 = snapshot[anchorOffset + 1];
  const a2 = snapshot[anchorOffset + 2];
  const a3 = snapshot[anchorOffset + 3];
  const maxPtr = heap.length - targetSize;
  const sampleStride = Math.max(31, Math.floor(targetSize / 64));

  for (let ptr = 0; ptr <= maxPtr; ptr += 4) {
    if (
      heap[ptr + anchorOffset] === a0 &&
      heap[ptr + anchorOffset + 1] === a1 &&
      heap[ptr + anchorOffset + 2] === a2 &&
      heap[ptr + anchorOffset + 3] === a3
    ) {
      let matches = 0;
      let checks = 0;
      for (let k = 0x20; k < targetSize; k += sampleStride) {
        checks++;
        if (heap[ptr + k] === snapshot[k]) matches++;
      }
      if (checks > 0 && matches >= Math.floor(checks * 0.88)) {
        candidates.push(ptr);
        if (candidates.length >= 8) break;
      }
    }
  }
  return candidates;
}

function locateGenericWramInHeapFromState(
  heap: Uint8Array,
  stateBytes: Uint8Array,
  expectedSize: number
): number | null {
  if (stateBytes.length < expectedSize || heap.length < expectedSize) return null;

  // Scan stateBytes in 2KB steps for a high-entropy RAM region that mirrors a live block in HEAPU8
  const step = 0x800;
  for (let off = 0; off + expectedSize <= stateBytes.length; off += step) {
    const windowSlice = stateBytes.subarray(off, off + expectedSize);
    let nonZero = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(0x400, expectedSize); i += 16) {
      if (windowSlice[i] !== 0 && windowSlice[i] !== 0xff) nonZero++;
    }
    if (nonZero < 4) continue;

    const hits = matchSnapshotInHeap(heap, windowSlice, expectedSize);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
      return hits[0];
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function isFceummStateChunkHeaderBefore(heap: Uint8Array, ptr: number): boolean {
  return (
    ptr >= 8 &&
    heap[ptr - 8] === 0x52 &&
    heap[ptr - 7] === 0x41 &&
    heap[ptr - 6] === 0x4d &&
    heap[ptr - 5] === 0x00 &&
    heap[ptr - 4] === 0x00 &&
    heap[ptr - 3] === 0x08 &&
    heap[ptr - 2] === 0x00 &&
    heap[ptr - 1] === 0x00
  );
}

/**
 * Pinpoints the exact byte offset of fceumm's 2KB NES CPU System RAM (`uint8 RAM[0x800]`)
 * inside `EmscriptenModule.HEAPU8`.
 * Pauses the core BEFORE `_cmd_save_state` so zero frames elapse between snapshot & heap scan,
 * excludes serialized `"RAM\0"` savestate buffers in heap memory, and disambiguates multiple
 * candidates via live frame-step mutation.
 */
async function locateNesSystemRamOffset(nostalgist: Nostalgist): Promise<number | null> {
  const shouldRestoreRunning = nostalgist.getStatus() === 'running';
  try {
    const mod = nostalgist.getEmscriptenModule() as unknown as {
      HEAPU8?: Uint8Array;
      _cmd_save_state?: () => void;
    };
    const canSaveWhilePaused = typeof mod?._cmd_save_state === 'function';

    if (canSaveWhilePaused) {
      if (nostalgist.getStatus() === 'running') {
        nostalgist.pause();
      }
    } else if (nostalgist.getStatus() === 'paused') {
      nostalgist.resume();
    }

    const { state } = await nostalgist.saveState();
    if (nostalgist.getStatus() === 'running') {
      nostalgist.pause();
    }

    const stateBytes = await unwrapStateBytes(state);
    const ramSnapshot = extractFceummRamFromSaveState(stateBytes);
    const heap = (nostalgist.getEmscriptenModule() as unknown as { HEAPU8?: Uint8Array })?.HEAPU8;

    if (!ramSnapshot || !heap || heap.length < 0x800) {
      return null;
    }

    const maxOffset = heap.length - 0x800;
    const candidates: number[] = [];

    // Pass 1: Exact frozen 2,048-byte match (excluding `"RAM\0"` serialized savestate buffers in HEAPU8)
    const a0 = ramSnapshot[0x000];
    const a1 = ramSnapshot[0x1ff];
    const a2 = ramSnapshot[0x400];
    for (let ptr = 0; ptr <= maxOffset; ptr += 4) {
      if (
        heap[ptr] !== a0 ||
        heap[ptr + 0x1ff] !== a1 ||
        heap[ptr + 0x400] !== a2 ||
        isFceummStateChunkHeaderBefore(heap, ptr)
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      let mismatches = 0;
      for (let k = 0; k < 0x800; k++) {
        if (heap[ptr + k] !== ramSnapshot[k]) {
          mismatches++;
          if (mismatches > 16) break;
        }
      }
      if (mismatches <= 16) {
        candidates.push(ptr);
        if (candidates.length >= 32) break;
      }
    }

    // Pass 2: Drift-tolerant Work-RAM ($0300-$07FF) + Stack ($0180-$01FF) fallback if core ran during saveState
    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      const workBytes = 0x500 + 0x80; // 1,408 bytes excluding volatile ZP ($0000-$00FF) & OAM ($0200-$02FF)
      const maxWorkMismatches = Math.floor(workBytes * 0.1);
      for (let ptr = 0; ptr <= maxOffset; ptr += 4) {
        if (isFceummStateChunkHeaderBefore(heap, ptr)) continue;
        let mismatches = 0;
        for (let k = 0x180; k < 0x200; k++) {
          if (heap[ptr + k] !== ramSnapshot[k] && ++mismatches > maxWorkMismatches) break;
        }
        if (mismatches <= maxWorkMismatches) {
          for (let k = 0x300; k < 0x800; k++) {
            if (heap[ptr + k] !== ramSnapshot[k] && ++mismatches > maxWorkMismatches) break;
          }
        }
        if (mismatches <= maxWorkMismatches) {
          candidates.push(ptr);
          if (candidates.length >= 32) break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (candidates.length === 1) {
      return candidates[0];
    }

    if (candidates.length > 1) {
      // Step ~3 frames WITHOUT calling saveState() so only true live CPU RAM mutates
      const beforeSlices = candidates.map((ptr) => heap.slice(ptr, ptr + 0x300));
      nostalgist.resume();
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 48));
      nostalgist.pause();

      const freshHeap = (nostalgist.getEmscriptenModule() as unknown as { HEAPU8?: Uint8Array })
        ?.HEAPU8;
      if (freshHeap) {
        for (let idx = 0; idx < candidates.length; idx++) {
          const ptr = candidates[idx];
          const prev = beforeSlices[idx];
          for (let b = 0; b < 0x300; b++) {
            if (freshHeap[ptr + b] !== prev[b]) {
              return ptr;
            }
          }
        }
      }

      return candidates[0];
    }

    return null;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[Bitgeist] RAM offset locator warning:', err);
    return null;
  } finally {
    try {
      const current = nostalgist.getStatus();
      if (shouldRestoreRunning && current === 'paused') {
        nostalgist.resume();
      } else if (!shouldRestoreRunning && current === 'running') {
        nostalgist.pause();
      }
    } catch {
      // Instance may have been exited concurrently during abort
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Multi-Console Libretro Work-RAM Locator (`fceumm`, `snes9x`, `genesis_plus_gx`, `gambatte`, `mgba`).
 */
export async function locateSystemRamRegion(
  nostalgist: Nostalgist,
  consoleSystem: ConsoleSystemId
): Promise<SystemRamRegion | null> {
  if (consoleSystem === 'nes') {
    const offset = await locateNesSystemRamOffset(nostalgist);
    return offset !== null ? { offset, size: 0x800 } : null;
  }

  const expectedSize = EXPECTED_RAM_BYTES[consoleSystem] || 0x2000;
  const shouldRestoreRunning = nostalgist.getStatus() === 'running';
  try {
    if (nostalgist.getStatus() === 'paused') {
      nostalgist.resume();
    }

    const { state } = await nostalgist.saveState();
    nostalgist.pause();

    const stateBytes = await unwrapStateBytes(state);
    const mod = nostalgist.getEmscriptenModule() as unknown as { HEAPU8?: Uint8Array };
    const heap = mod?.HEAPU8;
    if (!heap) return null;

    if (consoleSystem === 'gba') {
      const gbaSnap = extractMgbaIwramFromSaveState(stateBytes);
      if (gbaSnap) {
        const hits = matchSnapshotInHeap(heap, gbaSnap, 0x8000);
        const livePtr = await pickLiveMutatingCandidate(nostalgist, hits, 0x8000);
        if (livePtr !== null) {
          return { offset: livePtr, size: 0x8000 };
        }
      }
    }

    if (consoleSystem === 'snes') {
      const snesSnap = extractSnes9xWramFromSaveState(stateBytes);
      if (snesSnap) {
        const hits = matchSnapshotInHeap(heap, snesSnap, 0x20000);
        const livePtr = await pickLiveMutatingCandidate(nostalgist, hits, 0x20000);
        if (livePtr !== null) {
          return { offset: livePtr, size: 0x20000 };
        }
      }
    }

    const genericOffset = locateGenericWramInHeapFromState(heap, stateBytes, expectedSize);
    if (genericOffset !== null) {
      return { offset: genericOffset, size: expectedSize };
    }

    return null;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[Bitgeist] ${consoleSystem} WRAM locator warning:`, err);
    return null;
  } finally {
    try {
      const current = nostalgist.getStatus();
      if (shouldRestoreRunning && current === 'paused') {
        nostalgist.resume();
      } else if (!shouldRestoreRunning && current === 'running') {
        nostalgist.pause();
      }
    } catch {
      // Instance may have been exited concurrently during abort
    }
  }
}

export function getSystemRamView(
  nostalgist: Nostalgist,
  region: SystemRamRegion | null
): Uint8Array | null {
  if (!region) return null;
  try {
    const mod = nostalgist.getEmscriptenModule() as unknown as { HEAPU8?: Uint8Array };
    const heap = mod?.HEAPU8;
    if (!heap || region.offset < 0 || region.offset + region.size > heap.length) return null;
    return heap.subarray(region.offset, region.offset + region.size);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function getNesRamView(nostalgist: Nostalgist, ramOffset: number): Uint8Array | null {
  return getSystemRamView(nostalgist, { offset: ramOffset, size: 0x800 });
}
```

`lib/playerIdentity.ts`:

```ts
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import type { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
import type { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { sanitizeArcadeTag, tagToSlug } from './ghostShare';
import { withGhostSqliteDb } from './ghostStore';
import type { ArcadeIdentityInfo } from './types';

export const IDENTITY_COOKIE_NAME = 'bg_sid';
const COOKIE_MAX_AGE_SEC = 365 * 24 * 60 * 60;
const RESERVED_BOT_TAG_SLUGS = new Set(['alex']);
const MAX_TAGS_PER_OWNER = 5;

let cachedHmacSecret: string | null = null;
const initializedTablesForDb: WeakSet<DatabaseSync> = new WeakSet();

function resolveSecretFilePath(): string {
  const dbPath =
    process.env.BITGEIST_DB_PATH?.trim() ||
    path.join(process.cwd(), 'data', 'bitgeist.sqlite');
  return path.join(path.dirname(dbPath), '.bitgeist_identity_secret');
}

function getIdentityHmacSecret(): string {
  const envSecret = process.env.BITGEIST_IDENTITY_SECRET?.trim();
  if (envSecret && envSecret.length >= 16) {
    return envSecret;
  }
  if (cachedHmacSecret) {
    return cachedHmacSecret;
  }
  const secretPath = resolveSecretFilePath();
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(secretPath)) {
      const existing = fs.readFileSync(secretPath, 'utf8').trim();
      if (existing.length >= 32) {
        cachedHmacSecret = existing;
        return existing;
      }
    }
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(secretPath), { recursive: true });
    const generated = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    fs.writeFileSync(secretPath, generated, { mode: 0o600 });
    cachedHmacSecret = generated;
    return generated;
  } catch {
    cachedHmacSecret = 'bitgeist-fallback-local-dev-hmac-secret-v1';
    return cachedHmacSecret;
  }
}

function ensureIdentityTables(db: DatabaseSync): void {
  if (initializedTablesForDb.has(db)) return;
  db.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS arcade_tags (
      tag_slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      tag TEXT NOT NULL,
      owner_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_arcade_tags_owner
      ON arcade_tags (owner_hash, updated_at DESC);

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS arcade_sessions (
      owner_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      streak_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      last_daily_number INTEGER,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    );
  `);
  initializedTablesForDb.add(db);
}

function sha256Hex(value: string): string {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
}

function signOwnerCookieValue(ownerId: string): string {
  const sig = crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', getIdentityHmacSecret())
    .update(`sid:${ownerId}`)
    .digest('hex')
    .slice(0, 32);
  return `${ownerId}.${sig}`;
}

export function verifyOwnerCookieValue(rawCookie: string | undefined): string | null {
  if (!rawCookie || typeof rawCookie !== 'string') return null;
  const dot = rawCookie.indexOf('.');
  if (dot <= 0) return null;
  const ownerId = rawCookie.slice(0, dot).toLowerCase();
  const providedSig = rawCookie.slice(dot + 1).toLowerCase();
  if (!/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(ownerId) || !/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(providedSig)) {
    return null;
  }
  const expected = signOwnerCookieValue(ownerId).slice(dot + 1);
  try {
    const a = Buffer.from(providedSig, 'hex');
    const b = Buffer.from(expected, 'hex');
    if (a.length !== b.length || !crypto.timingSafeEqual(a, b)) {
      return null;
    }
    return ownerId;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function buildBackupClaimKey(ownerId: string): string {
  const cleanOwner = ownerId.toLowerCase();
  const check = crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', getIdentityHmacSecret())
    .update(`backup-v1:${cleanOwner}`)
    .digest('hex')
    .slice(0, 10)
    .toUpperCase();
  return `BG1-${cleanOwner.toUpperCase()}-${check}`;
}

export function verifyBackupClaimKey(rawKey: string): string | null {
  if (typeof rawKey !== 'string') return null;
  const normalized = rawKey.trim().toUpperCase();
  const match = /^BG1-([A-F0-9]{32})-([A-F0-9]{10})$/.exec(normalized);
  if (!match) return null;
  const ownerId = match[1].toLowerCase();
  const expectedKey = buildBackupClaimKey(ownerId);
  try {
    const a = Buffer.from(normalized, 'utf8');
    const b = Buffer.from(expectedKey, 'utf8');
    if (a.length !== b.length || !crypto.timingSafeEqual(a, b)) {
      return null;
    }
    return ownerId;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function getOrCreateOwnerSession(req: NextRequest): {
  ownerId: string;
  cookieValue: string;
  isNewSession: boolean;
} {
  const existingCookie = req.cookies.get(IDENTITY_COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
  const verifiedOwnerId = verifyOwnerCookieValue(existingCookie);
  if (verifiedOwnerId) {
    return {
      ownerId: verifiedOwnerId,
      cookieValue: existingCookie!,
      isNewSession: false,
    };
  }
  const freshOwnerId = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
  return {
    ownerId: freshOwnerId,
    cookieValue: signOwnerCookieValue(freshOwnerId),
    isNewSession: true,
  };
}

export function attachIdentityCookie(res: NextResponse, ownerId: string): void {
  res.cookies.set({
    name: IDENTITY_COOKIE_NAME,
    value: signOwnerCookieValue(ownerId),
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: 'lax',
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    path: '/',
    maxAge: COOKIE_MAX_AGE_SEC,
  });
}

function allocateAvailableFallbackTag(db: DatabaseSync, baseTag: string): string {
  const stem = sanitizeArcadeTag(baseTag).replace(/_?\d+$/, '').slice(0, 6) || 'RUNNER';
  const checkStmt = db.prepare('SELECT tag_slug FROM arcade_tags WHERE tag_slug = ? LIMIT 1');
  for (let n = 2; n <= 99; n++) {
    const candidate = sanitizeArcadeTag(`${stem}_${n}`);
    const slug = tagToSlug(candidate);
    if (RESERVED_BOT_TAG_SLUGS.has(slug)) continue;
    const hit = checkStmt.get(slug);
    if (!hit) return candidate;
  }
  const randSuffix = Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900);
  return sanitizeArcadeTag(`${stem.slice(0, 5)}${randSuffix}`);
}

function updateDailyStreakInTx(
  db: DatabaseSync,
  ownerHash: string,
  dailyNumber?: number
): { streakCount: number; lastDailyNumber: number | null } {
  const existing = db
    .prepare(
      'SELECT streak_count, last_daily_number FROM arcade_sessions WHERE owner_hash = ? LIMIT 1'
    )
    .get(ownerHash) as
    | { streak_count?: number; last_daily_number?: number | null }
    | undefined;

  let streakCount = Math.max(0, Number(existing?.streak_count ?? 0));
  let lastDaily =
    typeof existing?.last_daily_number === 'number' ? existing.last_daily_number : null;

  if (typeof dailyNumber === 'number' && Number.isFinite(dailyNumber) && dailyNumber >= 1) {
    const dn = Math.round(dailyNumber);
    if (lastDaily === null) {
      streakCount = 1;
      lastDaily = dn;
    } else if (dn === lastDaily) {
      streakCount = Math.max(1, streakCount);
    } else if (dn === lastDaily + 1) {
      streakCount = Math.max(1, streakCount) + 1;
      lastDaily = dn;
    } else if (dn > lastDaily + 1) {
      streakCount = 1;
      lastDaily = dn;
    }
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    db.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO arcade_sessions (owner_hash, streak_count, last_daily_number, updated_at)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
       ON CONFLICT(owner_hash) DO UPDATE SET
         streak_count = excluded.streak_count,
         last_daily_number = excluded.last_daily_number,
         updated_at = excluded.updated_at`
    ).run(ownerHash, streakCount, lastDaily, nowIso);
  }

  return { streakCount, lastDailyNumber: lastDaily };
}

export function getIdentityInfoForOwner(
  ownerId: string,
  requestedTag?: string
): ArcadeIdentityInfo {
  const ownerHash = sha256Hex(ownerId);
  return withGhostSqliteDb((db) => {
    ensureIdentityTables(db);
    const { streakCount, lastDailyNumber } = updateDailyStreakInTx(db, ownerHash);

    let activeTagRow: { tag: string; tag_slug: string; owner_hash: string } | undefined;
    if (requestedTag) {
      const clean = sanitizeArcadeTag(requestedTag);
      const slug = tagToSlug(clean);
      if (clean !== 'PLAYER') {
        activeTagRow = db
          .prepare('SELECT tag, tag_slug, owner_hash FROM arcade_tags WHERE tag_slug = ? LIMIT 1')
          .get(slug) as typeof activeTagRow;
        if (!activeTagRow) {
          return {
            tag: clean,
            tagSlug: slug,
            claimed: false,
            ownedBySession: false,
            claimKey: buildBackupClaimKey(ownerId),
            streakCount,
            lastDailyNumber,
          };
        }
        const owned = activeTagRow.owner_hash === ownerHash;
        return {
          tag: activeTagRow.tag,
          tagSlug: activeTagRow.tag_slug,
          claimed: true,
          ownedBySession: owned,
          claimKey: owned ? buildBackupClaimKey(ownerId) : null,
          streakCount,
          lastDailyNumber,
        };
      }
    }

    const latestOwned = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT tag, tag_slug, owner_hash
         FROM arcade_tags
         WHERE owner_hash = ?
         ORDER BY updated_at DESC
         LIMIT 1`
      )
      .get(ownerHash) as typeof activeTagRow;

    if (latestOwned) {
      return {
        tag: latestOwned.tag,
        tagSlug: latestOwned.tag_slug,
        claimed: true,
        ownedBySession: true,
        claimKey: buildBackupClaimKey(ownerId),
        streakCount,
        lastDailyNumber,
      };
    }

    return {
      tag: null,
      tagSlug: null,
      claimed: false,
      ownedBySession: false,
      claimKey: buildBackupClaimKey(ownerId),
      streakCount,
      lastDailyNumber,
    };
  });
}

export function resolveTagForSubmission(params: {
  ownerId: string;
  requestedTag: string;
  dailyNumber?: number;
  strictClaimOnly?: boolean;
}): {
  assignedTag: string;
  tagConflict?: {
    requestedTag: string;
    assignedTag: string;
    reason: string;
  };
  identity: ArcadeIdentityInfo;
} {
  const ownerHash = sha256Hex(params.ownerId);
  const cleanRequested = sanitizeArcadeTag(params.requestedTag || 'PLAYER');
  const requestedSlug = tagToSlug(cleanRequested);

  return withGhostSqliteDb((db) => {
    ensureIdentityTables(db);
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE;');
    try {
      const streak = updateDailyStreakInTx(db, ownerHash, params.dailyNumber);

      // Default 'PLAYER' tag stays shared/unclaimed so first-time runners have zero friction
      if (cleanRequested === 'PLAYER') {
        db.exec('COMMIT;');
        return {
          assignedTag: 'PLAYER',
          identity: {
            tag: 'PLAYER',
            tagSlug: 'player',
            claimed: false,
            ownedBySession: false,
            claimKey: buildBackupClaimKey(params.ownerId),
            streakCount: streak.streakCount,
            lastDailyNumber: streak.lastDailyNumber,
          },
        };
      }

      // Protect built-in #1 champion bot @ALEX from impersonation
      if (RESERVED_BOT_TAG_SLUGS.has(requestedSlug)) {
        const fallback = allocateAvailableFallbackTag(db, cleanRequested);
        db.exec('COMMIT;');
        return {
          assignedTag: fallback,
          tagConflict: {
            requestedTag: cleanRequested,
            assignedTag: fallback,
            reason: `@${cleanRequested} is the built-in #1 Champion Bot`,
          },
          identity: {
            tag: fallback,
            tagSlug: tagToSlug(fallback),
            claimed: false,
            ownedBySession: false,
            claimKey: buildBackupClaimKey(params.ownerId),
            streakCount: streak.streakCount,
            lastDailyNumber: streak.lastDailyNumber,
          },
        };
      }

      const existing = db
        .prepare('SELECT tag, tag_slug, owner_hash FROM arcade_tags WHERE tag_slug = ? LIMIT 1')
        .get(requestedSlug) as
        | { tag: string; tag_slug: string; owner_hash: string }
        | undefined;

      if (existing) {
        if (existing.owner_hash === ownerHash) {
          db.prepare('UPDATE arcade_tags SET tag = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE tag_slug = ?').run(
            cleanRequested,
            nowIso,
            requestedSlug
          );
          db.exec('COMMIT;');
          return {
            assignedTag: cleanRequested,
            identity: {
              tag: cleanRequested,
              tagSlug: requestedSlug,
              claimed: true,
              ownedBySession: true,
              claimKey: buildBackupClaimKey(params.ownerId),
              streakCount: streak.streakCount,
              lastDailyNumber: streak.lastDailyNumber,
            },
          };
        }

        // Owned by another runner -> assign collision-free fallback tag so run is never lost!
        const fallback = allocateAvailableFallbackTag(db, cleanRequested);
        if (!params.strictClaimOnly) {
          const fbSlug = tagToSlug(fallback);
          db.prepare(
            `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO arcade_tags (tag_slug, tag, owner_hash, created_at, updated_at)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`
          ).run(fbSlug, fallback, ownerHash, nowIso, nowIso);
        }
        db.exec('COMMIT;');
        return {
          assignedTag: fallback,
          tagConflict: {
            requestedTag: cleanRequested,
            assignedTag: fallback,
            reason: `@${cleanRequested} is already claimed by another speedrunner`,
          },
          identity: {
            tag: params.strictClaimOnly ? cleanRequested : fallback,
            tagSlug: tagToSlug(params.strictClaimOnly ? cleanRequested : fallback),
            claimed: true,
            ownedBySession: !params.strictClaimOnly,
            claimKey: !params.strictClaimOnly ? buildBackupClaimKey(params.ownerId) : null,
            streakCount: streak.streakCount,
            lastDailyNumber: streak.lastDailyNumber,
          },
        };
      }

      // Unclaimed tag! Enforce reasonable per-device cap by pruning oldest tag if > MAX_TAGS_PER_OWNER
      const ownedRows = db
        .prepare(
          'SELECT tag_slug FROM arcade_tags WHERE owner_hash = ? ORDER BY updated_at ASC'
        )
        .all(ownerHash) as Array<{ tag_slug: string }>;

      if (ownedRows.length >= MAX_TAGS_PER_OWNER) {
        const oldest = ownedRows[0]?.tag_slug;
        if (oldest) {
          db.prepare('DELETE FROM arcade_tags WHERE tag_slug = ? AND owner_hash = ?').run(
            oldest,
            ownerHash
          );
        }
      }

      db.prepare(
        `INSERT INTO arcade_tags (tag_slug, tag, owner_hash, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`
      ).run(requestedSlug, cleanRequested, ownerHash, nowIso, nowIso);

      db.exec('COMMIT;');
      return {
        assignedTag: cleanRequested,
        identity: {
          tag: cleanRequested,
          tagSlug: requestedSlug,
          claimed: true,
          ownedBySession: true,
          claimKey: buildBackupClaimKey(params.ownerId),
          streakCount: streak.streakCount,
          lastDailyNumber: streak.lastDailyNumber,
        },
      };
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      throw err;
    }
  });
}
```

`lib/rateLimit.ts`:

```ts
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server';

interface RateBucket {
  timestamps: number[];
  lastSeen: number;
}

const MAX_TRACKED_BUCKETS = 4096;
const buckets = new Map<string, RateBucket>();

export function extractClientIp(req: NextRequest): string {
  const xff = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for');
  if (xff) {
    const first = xff.split(',')[0]?.trim();
    if (first) return first.slice(0, 64);
  }
  const realIp = req.headers.get('x-real-ip')?.trim();
  if (realIp) return realIp.slice(0, 64);
  return '127.0.0.1';
}

export function checkSlidingWindowRateLimit(params: {
  key: string;
  maxRequests: number;
  windowMs: number;
  nowMs?: number;
}): {
  allowed: boolean;
  remaining: number;
  retryAfterSec: number;
} {
  const now = params.nowMs ?? Date.now();
  const cutoff = now - params.windowMs;

  if (buckets.size > MAX_TRACKED_BUCKETS) {
    for (const [k, b] of buckets) {
      if (b.lastSeen < cutoff) {
        buckets.delete(k);
      }
      if (buckets.size <= MAX_TRACKED_BUCKETS / 2) break;
    }
  }

  let bucket = buckets.get(params.key);
  if (!bucket) {
    bucket = { timestamps: [], lastSeen: now };
    buckets.set(params.key, bucket);
  }

  // Drop expired timestamps outside sliding window
  while (bucket.timestamps.length > 0 && bucket.timestamps[0] <= cutoff) {
    bucket.timestamps.shift();
  }
  bucket.lastSeen = now;

  if (bucket.timestamps.length >= params.maxRequests) {
    const oldest = bucket.timestamps[0] ?? now;
    const retryAfterMs = Math.max(1000, oldest + params.windowMs - now);
    return {
      allowed: false,
      remaining: 0,
      retryAfterSec: Math.ceil(retryAfterMs / 1000),
    };
  }

  bucket.timestamps.push(now);
  return {
    allowed: true,
    remaining: Math.max(0, params.maxRequests - bucket.timestamps.length),
    retryAfterSec: 0,
  };
}

export function resetRateLimitBucketsForTests(): void {
  buckets.clear();
}
```

```ts
const SFX_MUTE_STORAGE_KEY = 'bitgeist_sfx_muted';
const MUSIC_MUTE_STORAGE_KEY = 'bitgeist_music_muted';

let sharedAudioCtx: AudioContext | null = null;

export function getMusicMuted(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(MUSIC_MUTE_STORAGE_KEY) === '1';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function setMusicMuted(muted: boolean): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(MUSIC_MUTE_STORAGE_KEY, muted ? '1' : '0');
  } catch {
    // ignore storage errors
  }
}

export function getSfxMuted(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(SFX_MUTE_STORAGE_KEY) === '1';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function setSfxMuted(muted: boolean): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(SFX_MUTE_STORAGE_KEY, muted ? '1' : '0');
  } catch {
    // ignore storage errors
  }
}

function getReadyAudioContext(): AudioContext | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  if (getSfxMuted()) return null;
  try {
    if (!sharedAudioCtx) {
      const Ctx =
        window.AudioContext ||
        (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
      if (!Ctx) return null;
      sharedAudioCtx = new Ctx();
    }
    if (sharedAudioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
      void sharedAudioCtx.resume().catch(() => undefined);
    }
    return sharedAudioCtx;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function scheduleChipTone(
  ctx: AudioContext,
  opts: {
    freqHz: number;
    endFreqHz?: number;
    startOffsetSec: number;
    durationSec: number;
    type?: OscillatorType;
    peakGain?: number;
  }
) {
  const start = ctx.currentTime + opts.startOffsetSec;
  const stop = start + opts.durationSec;
  const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
  const gain = ctx.createGain();

  osc.type = opts.type || 'square';
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(opts.freqHz, start);
  if (opts.endFreqHz && opts.endFreqHz !== opts.freqHz) {
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40, opts.endFreqHz), stop);
  }

  const peak = opts.peakGain ?? 0.055;
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start);
  gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak, start + 0.006);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, stop);

  osc.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(ctx.destination);
  osc.start(start);
  osc.stop(stop + 0.005);
}
```

`lib/romPatcher.ts`:

```ts
const MAX_PATCHED_ROM_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024; // 16 MB safety ceiling

export function detectRomPatchFormat(
  fileName: string,
  bytes?: Uint8Array
): 'ips' | 'bps' | null {
  if (bytes && bytes.length >= 5) {
    if (
      bytes[0] === 0x50 && // 'P'
      bytes[1] === 0x41 && // 'A'
      bytes[2] === 0x54 && // 'T'
      bytes[3] === 0x43 && // 'C'
      bytes[4] === 0x48 // 'H'
    ) {
      return 'ips';
    }
    if (
      bytes[0] === 0x42 && // 'B'
      bytes[1] === 0x50 && // 'P'
      bytes[2] === 0x53 && // 'S'
      bytes[3] === 0x31 // '1'
    ) {
      return 'bps';
    }
  }
  const lower = fileName.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (lower.endsWith('.ips')) return 'ips';
  if (lower.endsWith('.bps')) return 'bps';
  return null;
}

export function applyIpsPatch(baseBytes: Uint8Array, patchBytes: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  if (
    patchBytes.length < 8 ||
    patchBytes[0] !== 0x50 ||
    patchBytes[1] !== 0x41 ||
    patchBytes[2] !== 0x54 ||
    patchBytes[3] !== 0x43 ||
    patchBytes[4] !== 0x48
  ) {
    throw new Error('Invalid .IPS patch file (missing "PATCH" header).');
  }

  let out = new Uint8Array(baseBytes.byteLength);
  out.set(baseBytes);

  const ensureCapacity = (requiredLen: number) => {
    if (requiredLen > MAX_PATCHED_ROM_BYTES) {
      throw new Error('Patched ROM exceeds the 16 MB cartridge limit.');
    }
    if (requiredLen <= out.length) return;
    const grown = new Uint8Array(requiredLen);
    grown.set(out);
    out = grown;
  };

  let ptr = 5;
  while (ptr < patchBytes.length) {
    // Check for "EOF" marker (0x45 0x4F 0x46)
    if (
      ptr + 3 <= patchBytes.length &&
      patchBytes[ptr] === 0x45 &&
      patchBytes[ptr + 1] === 0x4f &&
      patchBytes[ptr + 2] === 0x46
    ) {
      ptr += 3;
      // Optional 3-byte Lunar IPS truncation extension
      if (ptr + 3 === patchBytes.length) {
        const truncLen =
          (patchBytes[ptr] << 16) | (patchBytes[ptr + 1] << 8) | patchBytes[ptr + 2];
        if (truncLen > 0 && truncLen <= MAX_PATCHED_ROM_BYTES) {
          if (truncLen < out.length) {
            out = out.slice(0, truncLen);
          } else {
            ensureCapacity(truncLen);
          }
        }
      }
      return out;
    }

    if (ptr + 5 > patchBytes.length) {
      throw new Error('Corrupt .IPS patch (unexpected end of file before EOF marker).');
    }

    const offset =
      (patchBytes[ptr] << 16) | (patchBytes[ptr + 1] << 8) | patchBytes[ptr + 2];
    const size = (patchBytes[ptr + 3] << 8) | patchBytes[ptr + 4];
    ptr += 5;

    if (size === 0) {
      // RLE record: 2-byte count + 1-byte value
      if (ptr + 3 > patchBytes.length) {
        throw new Error('Corrupt .IPS patch (truncated RLE hunk).');
      }
      const rleCount = (patchBytes[ptr] << 8) | patchBytes[ptr + 1];
      const rleVal = patchBytes[ptr + 2];
      ptr += 3;
      ensureCapacity(offset + rleCount);
      out.fill(rleVal, offset, offset + rleCount);
    } else {
      if (ptr + size > patchBytes.length) {
        throw new Error('Corrupt .IPS patch (truncated data hunk).');
      }
      ensureCapacity(offset + size);
      out.set(patchBytes.subarray(ptr, ptr + size), offset);
      ptr += size;
    }
  }

  return out;
}

export function applyBpsPatch(baseBytes: Uint8Array, patchBytes: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  if (
    patchBytes.length < 19 ||
    patchBytes[0] !== 0x42 ||
    patchBytes[1] !== 0x50 ||
    patchBytes[2] !== 0x53 ||
    patchBytes[3] !== 0x31
  ) {
    throw new Error('Invalid .BPS patch file (missing "BPS1" header).');
  }

  const bodyEnd = patchBytes.length - 12; // 3 x CRC32 footer
  let ptr = 4;

  const readVarInt = (): number => {
    let data = 0;
    let shift = 1;
    while (true) {
      if (ptr >= bodyEnd) {
        throw new Error('Corrupt .BPS patch (truncated variable-length integer).');
      }
      const x = patchBytes[ptr++];
      data += (x & 0x7f) * shift;
      if ((x & 0x80) !== 0) break;
      shift *= 128;
      data += shift;
    }
    return data;
  };

  const sourceSize = readVarInt();
  const targetSize = readVarInt();
  const metadataLen = readVarInt();

  if (targetSize <= 0 || targetSize > MAX_PATCHED_ROM_BYTES) {
    throw new Error('Invalid .BPS target size (exceeds 16 MB cartridge limit).');
  }
  if (ptr + metadataLen > bodyEnd) {
    throw new Error('Corrupt .BPS patch (truncated metadata block).');
  }
  ptr += metadataLen;

  // Allow iNES 16-byte header offset if patch expects raw PRG+CHR or vice versa
  let effectiveBase = baseBytes;
  if (sourceSize !== baseBytes.length && baseBytes.length === sourceSize + 16) {
    effectiveBase = baseBytes.subarray(16);
  }

  const target = new Uint8Array(targetSize);
  let outputOffset = 0;
  let sourceRelativeOffset = 0;
  let targetRelativeOffset = 0;

  while (ptr < bodyEnd) {
    const command = readVarInt();
    const action = command & 3;
    let length = (command >> 2) + 1;

    if (outputOffset + length > targetSize) {
      throw new Error('Corrupt .BPS patch (command writes past target size).');
    }

    if (action === 0) {
      // SourceRead
      for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        target[outputOffset] = effectiveBase[outputOffset] ?? 0;
        outputOffset++;
      }
    } else if (action === 1) {
      // TargetRead
      if (ptr + length > bodyEnd) {
        throw new Error('Corrupt .BPS patch (truncated TargetRead payload).');
      }
      target.set(patchBytes.subarray(ptr, ptr + length), outputOffset);
      ptr += length;
      outputOffset += length;
    } else if (action === 2) {
      // SourceCopy
      const rawOffset = readVarInt();
      const signedDelta = (rawOffset & 1 ? -1 : 1) * (rawOffset >> 1);
      sourceRelativeOffset += signedDelta;
      while (length-- > 0) {
        target[outputOffset++] = effectiveBase[sourceRelativeOffset++] ?? 0;
      }
    } else {
      // TargetCopy
      const rawOffset = readVarInt();
      const signedDelta = (rawOffset & 1 ? -1 : 1) * (rawOffset >> 1);
      targetRelativeOffset += signedDelta;
      while (length-- > 0) {
        target[outputOffset++] = target[targetRelativeOffset++] ?? 0;
      }
    }
  }

  return target;
}

export function applyRomPatchBytes(
  baseBytes: Uint8Array,
  patchBytes: Uint8Array,
  patchFileName = 'patch.ips'
): { bytes: Uint8Array; format: 'ips' | 'bps' } {
  const format = detectRomPatchFormat(patchFileName, patchBytes);
  if (format === 'ips') {
    return { bytes: applyIpsPatch(baseBytes, patchBytes), format: 'ips' };
  }
  if (format === 'bps') {
    return { bytes: applyBpsPatch(baseBytes, patchBytes), format: 'bps' };
  }
  throw new Error('Unsupported patch format. Drop a valid .IPS or .BPS ROM patch file.');
}
```

```ts
export const CELESTE_ROM_ID = '4cd56ce8fdd4b921684fe56bdcc3bec0db33d6b3';

function fixed12_4ToPixels(raw16: number): number {
  return raw16 >= 0xe000 ? (raw16 << 16) >> 20 : raw16 >> 4;
}

function clampScreenY(val: number): number {
  return Math.max(16, Math.min(248, Math.round(val)));
}

function cleanCartTitle(rawName: string, fallback: string): string {
  return (
    rawName
      .replace(/\.(nes|sfc|smc|md|gen|bin|gb|gbc|gba)$/i, '')
      .replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase()
      .slice(0, 22) || fallback
  );
}

/**
 * Exact 6502 RAM layout disassembled directly from CelesteNES (celeste.nes, MMC3 Mapper 4, demo-1.00):
 * - $001C: gamemode ($00 = gm_game, $01 = gm_title, $02 = gm_titletra, $03 = gm_overwld, $04 = gm_prologue)
 * - $0021: gamestate (bit 0 [$01] = gs_1stfr active gameplay loop)
 * - $004B / $004C: player_x (0..255) & player_y (0..239; 16px tall Madeline metasprite)
 * - $0066: gamectrl3 ($02 = g3_transitU 30-row upward room scroll, $10 = g3_transitX death transition)
 * - $0067:$00CC: 16-bit camera_x_pg:camera_x (anchored at $4000 on room load; continuous across R & U warps!)
 * - $007A: ntrowhead2 (counts 29 -> 0 -> $FF during g3_transitU upward scroll)
 * - $00C5: playerctrl ($01 = pl_left, $20 = pl_dead)
 * - $00F2: paused ($00 = unpaused)
 * - $050A: levelnumber (0 = Prologue, 1 = Forsaken City, 2 = Old Site)
 * - $053B / $053C: currroom / respawnroom (active warp index within chapter)
 */
export function createCelesteCourseProfile(opts?: {
  courseIndex?: number;
  dailyNumber?: number;
  sprintId?: string;
  stageLabelOverride?: string;
}): RomProfile {
  const course = getCourseByIndex(opts?.courseIndex);
  const sprintId =
    opts?.sprintId ||
    (opts?.dailyNumber
      ? `daily-${opts.dailyNumber}`
      : course.courseIndex === 0
        ? CELESTE_ROM_ID
        : `${CELESTE_ROM_ID}:c${course.courseIndex}`);
  const warpYMap = course.warpYMap || {};
  const goalWarps = course.goalWarps || [];

  return {
    romId: CELESTE_ROM_ID,
    consoleSystem: 'nes',
    sprintId,
    title: 'CELESTE',
    stageLabel: opts?.stageLabelOverride || course.stageLabel,
    profileKind: 'exact-ram',
    startWorldX: course.startWorldX,
    goalWorldX: course.goalWorldX,
    maxPxPerFrame: 10.5,
    courseIndex: course.courseIndex,
    worldIndex: course.worldIndex,
    stageIndex: course.stageIndex,
    startWarp: course.startWarp ?? course.stageIndex,
    goalWarps,
    finishDeltaY: course.finishDeltaY ?? 0,
    dailyNumber: opts?.dailyNumber,
    extractTelemetry(ram: Uint8Array, prev: TelemetryTrackerState): TelemetryFrame {
      const gamemode = ram[0x001c];
      const gamestate = ram[0x0021];
      const gamectrl3 = ram[0x0066];
      const playerctrl = ram[0x00c5];
      const currroom = ram[0x053b];

      const camRaw16 = (ram[0x0067] << 8) | ram[0x00cc];
      const cameraX =
        camRaw16 >= 0x3800 && camRaw16 < 0x8000 ? Math.max(0, camRaw16 - 0x4000) : prev.cameraX;

      const mappedRelY = warpYMap[currroom];
      const roomRelY = typeof mappedRelY === 'number' ? mappedRelY : (prev.cameraY ?? 0);
      let cameraY = roomRelY;
      if ((gamectrl3 & 0x02) !== 0) {
        const ntRowHead2 = ram[0x007a];
        const rowsRem = ntRowHead2 >= 0x80 ? 0 : Math.min(30, ntRowHead2 + 1);
        cameraY = roomRelY + rowsRem * 8;
      }

      const screenX = ram[0x004b];
      const rawScreenY = ram[0x004c];
      const screenFeetY = clampScreenY((rawScreenY || 168) + 16);

      const playerWorldX = cameraX + screenX;
      const playerWorldY = cameraY + screenFeetY;
      const facingLeft = (playerctrl & 0x01) !== 0;

      const isDying = (playerctrl & 0x20) !== 0 || (gamectrl3 & 0x10) !== 0;
      const isInitialLoading =
        !prev.hadGameplay &&
        !prev.manualSyncUnlocked &&
        (ram[0x0031] !== 0 || ram[0x00a1] !== 0 || ram[0x001a] !== 0);
      const inGameplay =
        gamemode === 0x00 && (gamestate & 0x01) !== 0 && !isDying && !isInitialLoading;
      const isDead = prev.hadGameplay && gamemode === 0x00 && isDying;
      const hitGoalWarp = goalWarps.length > 0 && goalWarps.includes(currroom);
      const reachedGoal = inGameplay && (hitGoalWarp || playerWorldX >= this.goalWorldX);

      return {
        inGameplay,
        playerWorldX,
        playerWorldY,
        cameraX,
        cameraY,
        facingLeft,
        isDead,
        reachedGoal,
        roomId: currroom,
      };
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Exact 6502 RAM layout disassembled directly from Twin Dragons (twindragons.nes, UNROM Mapper 2)
 * (retained for players who drop twindragons.nes manually into [+ DROP .NES]):
 */
function createTwinDragonsProfile(
  romId: string,
  title = 'TWIN DRAGONS'
): RomProfile {
  return {
    romId,
    consoleSystem: 'nes',
    sprintId: romId,
    title,
    stageLabel: title,
    profileKind: 'exact-ram',
    startWorldX: 27,
    goalWorldX: 1480,
    maxPxPerFrame: 5.5,
    extractTelemetry(ram: Uint8Array, prev: TelemetryTrackerState): TelemetryFrame {
      const gameState = ram[0x0025];
      const playerType = ram[0x0300];
      const playerFlags = ram[0x0320];
      const playerStateByte = ram[0x0340];
      const playerAction = playerStateByte & 0x0f;
      const hearts = ram[0x0380] & 0x0f;
      const rawY = ram[0x0494];

      const camHi = ram[0x0078];
      const cameraX = camHi >= 0xf0 ? 0 : (camHi << 8) | ram[0x0077];

      const pxHi = ram[0x046c];
      const playerWorldX = pxHi >= 0xf0 ? 0 : (pxHi << 8) | ram[0x0458];
      const playerWorldY = clampScreenY(rawY || 192);
      const facingLeft = (playerFlags & 0x08) !== 0;

      const isDying =
        playerAction === 0x06 ||
        playerAction === 0x07 ||
        (playerStateByte & 0x80) !== 0 ||
        hearts === 0 ||
        rawY >= 0xf4;

      const inGameplay =
        gameState === 0x06 && playerType !== 0xff && ram[0x002d] === 0 && !isDying;
      const isDead = prev.hadGameplay && gameState === 0x06 && isDying;
      const reachedGoal = inGameplay && playerWorldX >= this.goalWorldX;

      return {
        inGameplay,
        playerWorldX,
        playerWorldY,
        cameraX,
        facingLeft,
        isDead,
        reachedGoal,
      };
    },
  };
}

export function createDailyDefaultProfile(now?: Date): RomProfile {
  const daily = getDailySprintForDate(now);
  return createDailyDefaultProfileByNumber(daily.dailyNumber);
}

export function createDailyDefaultProfileByNumber(dailyNumber: number): RomProfile {

  return createCelesteCourseProfile({
    courseIndex: daily.course.courseIndex,
    dailyNumber: daily.dailyNumber,
    sprintId: daily.sprintId,
```
