`lib/videoClipRecorder.ts`:

```ts
export interface VideoClipHudMeta {
  stageLabel: string;
  tag: string;
  timeText: string;
  hostLabel?: string;
}

export interface FinalizedVideoClip {
  url: string;
  ext: 'mp4' | 'webm';
  mimeType: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
}

const PREFERRED_VIDEO_MIME_TYPES = [
  'video/mp4;codecs=avc1.42E01E',
  'video/mp4;codecs=avc1',
  'video/mp4',
  'video/webm;codecs=vp9',
  'video/webm;codecs=vp8',
  'video/webm',
];

function pickSupportedVideoMimeType(): string | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof MediaRecorder === 'undefined') {
    return null;
  }
  for (const candidate of PREFERRED_VIDEO_MIME_TYPES) {
    try {
      if (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(candidate)) {
        return candidate;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore unsupported codec probe
    }
  }
  return '';
}

export class VideoClipRecorder {
  private canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | null = null;
  private ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D | null = null;
  private recorder: MediaRecorder | null = null;
  private stream: MediaStream | null = null;
  private chunks: BlobPart[] = [];
  private activeMimeType = 'video/webm';
  private startedAtMs = 0;
  private lastDrawAtMs = 0;
  private lastUrl: string | null = null;

  public isRecording(): boolean {
    return this.recorder !== null && this.recorder.state === 'recording';
  }

  public startRecording(): boolean {
    this.stopInternal(false);

    if (typeof document === 'undefined' || typeof MediaRecorder === 'undefined') {
      return false;
    }

    const mimeType = pickSupportedVideoMimeType();
    if (mimeType === null) return false;

    if (!this.canvas) {
      const c = document.createElement('canvas');
      c.width = 512;
      c.height = 448;
      this.canvas = c;
      this.ctx = c.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
    }

    if (!this.canvas || !this.ctx || typeof this.canvas.captureStream !== 'function') {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      this.chunks = [];
      const stream = this.canvas.captureStream(30);
      const options: MediaRecorderOptions = {
        videoBitsPerSecond: 3_200_000,
      };
      if (mimeType) {
        options.mimeType = mimeType;
      }

      const recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, options);
      this.activeMimeType = recorder.mimeType || mimeType || 'video/webm';
      recorder.ondataavailable = (ev: BlobEvent) => {
        if (ev.data && ev.data.size > 0) {
          this.chunks.push(ev.data);
        }
      };
      recorder.start(250);
      this.stream = stream;
      this.recorder = recorder;
      this.startedAtMs = performance.now();
      this.lastDrawAtMs = 0;
      return true;
    } catch {
      this.stopInternal(false);
      return false;
    }
  }

  public captureFrame(
    emulatorCanvas: HTMLCanvasElement | null,
    ghostOverlayCanvas: HTMLCanvasElement | null,
    meta: VideoClipHudMeta,
    forceDraw = false
  ): void {
    if (!this.isRecording() || !this.canvas || !this.ctx || !emulatorCanvas) {
      return;
    }

    const now = performance.now();
    // Cap recording buffer at 35 seconds so abandoned runs never accumulate unbounded chunks
    if (now - this.startedAtMs > 35_000) {
      this.stopInternal(false);
      return;
    }
    if (!forceDraw && now - this.lastDrawAtMs < 31) {
      return;
    }
    this.lastDrawAtMs = now;

    const ctx = this.ctx;
    const W = this.canvas.width; // 512
    const HEADER_H = 36;
    const GAME_H = 384; // Exact 4:3 CRT aspect (512x384)
    const FOOTER_Y = HEADER_H + GAME_H; // 420
    const FOOTER_H = 28;

    // 1. Top Arcade Bezel Header
    ctx.fillStyle = '#09090D';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HEADER_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#F5C342';
    ctx.fillRect(0, HEADER_H - 2, W, 2);

    ctx.font = '900 13px monospace';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFE74C';
    ctx.fillText('BITGEIST', 12, 18);

    ctx.font = '900 11px monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFDF7';
    const stageStr = `• ${meta.stageLabel.slice(0, 26)}`;
    ctx.fillText(stageStr, 86, 18);

    const rightHud = `@${meta.tag} • ${meta.timeText}`;
    const rw = ctx.measureText(rightHud).width;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7FD1AE';
    ctx.fillText(rightHud, Math.max(260, W - rw - 12), 18);

    // 2. Crisp Pixel-Art 4:3 CRT Frame + Live 1v1 Ghost Overlay
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.fillRect(0, HEADER_H, W, GAME_H);
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    try {
      ctx.drawImage(emulatorCanvas, 0, HEADER_H, W, GAME_H);
      if (ghostOverlayCanvas) {
        ctx.drawImage(ghostOverlayCanvas, 0, HEADER_H, W, GAME_H);
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore transient canvas draw errors
    }

    // 3. Bottom Brag Strip
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111111';
    ctx.fillRect(0, FOOTER_Y, W, FOOTER_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFE74C';
    ctx.fillRect(0, FOOTER_Y, W, 2);

    ctx.font = '900 10px monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#EFE6CE';
    ctx.fillText('15-SECOND RETRO SPEEDRUNS • BEAT THIS GHOST', 12, FOOTER_Y + 15);

    const host = meta.hostLabel || 'BITGEIST.GG';
    const hw = ctx.measureText(host).width;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFE74C';
    ctx.fillText(host.toUpperCase(), W - hw - 12, FOOTER_Y + 15);
  }

  public async stopAndFinalize(): Promise<FinalizedVideoClip | null> {
    const rec = this.recorder;
    if (!rec || rec.state === 'inactive') {
      this.stopInternal(false);
      return null;
    }

    const mimeType = this.activeMimeType || rec.mimeType || 'video/webm';
    return new Promise<FinalizedVideoClip | null>((resolve) => {
      const finalizeBlob = () => {
        const chunks = this.chunks.slice();
        this.stopInternal(false);
        if (chunks.length === 0) {
          resolve(null);
          return;
        }
        const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: mimeType });
        if (blob.size < 256) {
          resolve(null);
          return;
        }
        if (this.lastUrl) {
          try {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(this.lastUrl);
          } catch {
            // ignore
          }
        }
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        this.lastUrl = url;
        const ext: 'mp4' | 'webm' = mimeType.toLowerCase().includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : 'webm';
        resolve({
          url,
          ext,
          mimeType,
          sizeBytes: blob.size,
        });
      };

      rec.onstop = finalizeBlob;
      rec.onerror = () => {
        this.stopInternal(false);
        resolve(null);
      };

      try {
        rec.stop();
      } catch {
        finalizeBlob();
      }
    });
  }

  public discard(): void {
    this.stopInternal(false);
  }

  public dispose(): void {
    this.stopInternal(true);
  }

  private stopInternal(revokeLastUrl: boolean): void {
    if (this.recorder) {
      this.recorder.ondataavailable = null;
      this.recorder.onstop = null;
      this.recorder.onerror = null;
      if (this.recorder.state !== 'inactive') {
        try {
          this.recorder.stop();
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
      }
      this.recorder = null;
    }
    if (this.stream) {
      for (const track of this.stream.getTracks()) {
        try {
          track.stop();
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
      }
      this.stream = null;
    }
    this.chunks = [];
    if (revokeLastUrl && this.lastUrl) {
      try {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(this.lastUrl);
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      this.lastUrl = null;
    }
  }
}
```

```mjs
function createEventTargetMock() {
  const listeners = new Map();
  return {
    listeners,
    addEventListener(type, fn) {
      const list = listeners.get(type) || [];
      list.push(fn);
      listeners.set(type, list);
    },
    removeEventListener(type, fn) {
      const list = listeners.get(type);
      if (!list) return;
      const idx = list.indexOf(fn);
      if (idx >= 0) list.splice(idx, 1);
    },
    dispatchEvent(evt) {
      const list = listeners.get(evt.type);
      if (!list) return true;
      for (const fn of [...list]) {
        fn(evt);
      }
      return !evt.defaultPrevented;
    },
  };

// ============================================================================
// NES Bitmask <-> RetroArch rwebinput Key Mapping (matches BitgeistArena.tsx)

const NES_BIT_KEYS = [
  [0x01, { code: 'ArrowRight', key: 'ArrowRight', keyCode: 39 }],
  [0x02, { code: 'ArrowLeft', key: 'ArrowLeft', keyCode: 37 }],
  [0x04, { code: 'ArrowDown', key: 'ArrowDown', keyCode: 40 }],
  [0x08, { code: 'ArrowUp', key: 'ArrowUp', keyCode: 38 }],
  [0x10, { code: 'Enter', key: 'Enter', keyCode: 13 }],
  [0x20, { code: 'ShiftRight', key: 'Shift', keyCode: 16, location: 2 }],
  [0x40, { code: 'KeyZ', key: 'z', keyCode: 90 }],
  [0x80, { code: 'Space', key: ' ', keyCode: 32 }],
];

let heldMask = 0;

function dispatchKey(type, spec) {
  const evt = {
    type,
    code: spec.code,
    key: spec.key,
    keyCode: spec.keyCode,
    which: spec.keyCode,
    charCode: 0,
    location: spec.location || 0,
    ctrlKey: 0,
    shiftKey: spec.code === 'ShiftRight' ? 1 : 0,
    altKey: 0,
    metaKey: 0,
    repeat: 0,
    timeStamp: virtualNowMs,
    defaultPrevented: false,
    preventDefault() {
      this.defaultPrevented = true;
    },
    stopPropagation() {},
  };
  docTarget.dispatchEvent(evt);
  winTarget.dispatchEvent(evt);
  canvasTarget.dispatchEvent(evt);
}

function setJoypadMask(nextMask) {
  const clean = nextMask & 0xff;
  if (clean === heldMask) return;
  for (const [bit, spec] of NES_BIT_KEYS) {
    const wasDown = (heldMask & bit) !== 0;
    const isDown = (clean & bit) !== 0;
    if (isDown && !wasDown) {
      dispatchKey('keydown', spec);
    } else if (!isDown && wasDown) {
      dispatchKey('keyup', spec);
    }
  }
  heldMask = clean;
}

let activeCore = null; // { romPath, mod, ramOffset }

function extractFceummRamFromSaveState(stateBytes) {
  const limit = stateBytes.length - 2056;
  for (let i = 0; i <= limit; i++) {
    if (
      stateBytes[i] === 0x52 &&
      stateBytes[i + 1] === 0x41 &&
      stateBytes[i + 2] === 0x4d &&
      stateBytes[i + 3] === 0x00 &&
      stateBytes[i + 4] === 0x00 &&
      stateBytes[i + 5] === 0x08 &&
      stateBytes[i + 6] === 0x00 &&
      stateBytes[i + 7] === 0x00
    ) {
      return stateBytes.subarray(i + 8, i + 8 + 0x800);
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function stepFrames(count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    virtualNowMs += 1000 / 60;
    const cb = pendingRafCb;
    if (cb) {
      cb(virtualNowMs);
    }
  }
}

function findStateFilePath(FS) {
  const roots = ['/states', '/home/web_user/retroarch/userdata/states', '/'];
  const visit = (dir, depth) => {
    if (depth > 3) return null;
    let entries;
    try {
      entries = FS.readdir(dir);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
    for (const name of entries) {
      if (name === '.' || name === '..') continue;
      const full = path.posix.join(dir, name);
      if (name.endsWith('.state') || /\.state\d+$/.test(name)) {
        return full;
      }
      try {
        const stat = FS.stat(full);
        if (FS.isDir(stat.mode)) {
          const found = visit(full, depth + 1);
          if (found) return found;
        }
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    }
    return null;
  };
  for (const root of roots) {
    const found = visit(root, 0);
    if (found) return found;
  }
  return '/states/rom.state';
}

function saveCoreStateBytes(mod) {
  const existing = findStateFilePath(mod.FS);
  try {
    mod.FS.unlink(existing);
  } catch {
    // ignore if absent
  }
  mod._cmd_save_state();
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    stepFrames(1);
    const statePath = findStateFilePath(mod.FS);
    try {
      const data = mod.FS.readFile(statePath);
      if (data && data.length > 64) {
        return new Uint8Array(data);
      }
    } catch {
      // keep stepping until written
    }
  }
  const finalPath = findStateFilePath(mod.FS);
  return new Uint8Array(mod.FS.readFile(finalPath));
}

function loadCoreStateBytes(mod, bytes) {
  const statePath = findStateFilePath(mod.FS);
  try {
    mod.FS.mkdirTree(path.posix.dirname(statePath));
  } catch {
    // dir already exists
  }
  mod.FS.writeFile(statePath, bytes);
  mod._cmd_load_state();
  stepFrames(1);
}

function locateNesRamOffset(mod) {
  stepFrames(10);
  const stateBytes = saveCoreStateBytes(mod);
  const ramSnap = extractFceummRamFromSaveState(stateBytes);
  const heap = mod.HEAPU8;
  if (!ramSnap || !heap) return null;

  const s1 = ramSnap[0x1fe];
  const s2 = ramSnap[0x1ff];
  const maxOffset = heap.length - 0x800;
  const candidates = [];

  for (let ptr = 0; ptr <= maxOffset; ptr += 4) {
    if (heap[ptr + 0x1fe] === s1 && heap[ptr + 0x1ff] === s2) {
      let matches = 0;
      for (let k = 0x20; k < 0x800; k += 31) {
        if (heap[ptr + k] === ramSnap[k]) matches++;
      }
      if (matches >= 54) {
        candidates.push(ptr);
      }
    }
  }
  return candidates[0] ?? null;
}

async function ensureCoreBootedForRom(coreJsPath, coreWasmPath, romPath) {
  if (activeCore && activeCore.romPath === romPath) {
    setJoypadMask(0);
    return activeCore;
  }

  const coreUrl = pathToFileURL(coreJsPath).href;
  const rawCoreJs = fs
    .readFileSync(coreJsPath, 'utf8')
    .replaceAll('import.meta.url', JSON.stringify(coreUrl))
    .replace(/export\s+default\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_$]+)\s*;?/, 'return $1;');
  const createFceumm = new Function(rawCoreJs)();
  const wasmBinary = fs.readFileSync(coreWasmPath);
  const romBytes = fs.readFileSync(romPath);

  const mod = await createFceumm({
    noInitialRun: true,
    wasmBinary,
    canvas: mockCanvas,
    print() {},
    printErr() {},
  });

  try {
    mod.FS.mkdirTree('/states');
    mod.FS.mkdirTree('/home/web_user/retroarch/userdata/config');
    mod.FS.mkdirTree('/home/web_user/retroarch/userdata/states/FCEUmm');
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
  mod.FS.writeFile('/home/web_user/retroarch/userdata/retroarch.cfg', RETROARCH_HEADLESS_CFG);
  mod.FS.writeFile('/retroarch.cfg', RETROARCH_HEADLESS_CFG);
  mod.FS.writeFile('/rom.nes', romBytes);

  mod.callMain(['/rom.nes', '-c', '/retroarch.cfg']);
  const ramOffset = locateNesRamOffset(mod);
  if (ramOffset === null) {
    throw new Error('Failed to locate 2KB 6502 RAM in headless fceumm HEAPU8');
  }

  activeCore = { romPath, mod, ramOffset };
  return activeCore;
}

function getRamView(core) {
  return core.mod.HEAPU8.subarray(core.ramOffset, core.ramOffset + 0x800);
}

function coldBootCelesteRoomAndSaveState(core, targetLevel, targetWarp) {
  setJoypadMask(0);
  const ram = getRamView(core);

  // Reset core cleanly before navigating title -> overworld -> targetWarp
  core.mod._cmd_reset();
  stepFrames(12);

  for (let iter = 0; iter < 900; iter++) {
    const gm = ram[0x001c];
    const gs = ram[0x0021];
    const fade = ram[0x0031];

    if (
      gm === 0x00 &&
      (gs & 0x01) !== 0 &&
      fade === 0 &&
      ram[0x00a1] === 0 &&
      ram[0x001a] === 0 &&
      (ram[0x00c5] & 0x20) === 0 &&
      (ram[0x0066] & 0x1f) === 0
    ) {
      break;
    }

    if (gm === 0x01 && (gs & 0x01) !== 0 && fade === 0) {
      setJoypadMask(0x10); // START
      stepFrames(3);
      setJoypadMask(0);
      stepFrames(5);
      continue;
    }

    if (gm === 0x03) {
      ram[0x005a] = targetLevel;
      if ((gs & 0x01) !== 0 && fade === 0) {
        if (ram[0x0054] === 0) {
          ram[0x0054] = 1;
          ram[0x005c] = 0;
        }
        setJoypadMask(0x80); // A
        stepFrames(3);
        setJoypadMask(0);
        stepFrames(5);
        continue;
      }
    }

    if (gm === 0x04 && (gs & 0x01) !== 0 && fade === 0) {
      setJoypadMask(0x10); // START
      stepFrames(3);
      setJoypadMask(0);
      stepFrames(5);
      continue;
    }

    stepFrames(2);
  }

  if (targetWarp > 0) {
    if (targetLevel === 2) {
      ram[0x054a] = targetWarp >= 73 ? 0x03 : 0x01;
    }
    ram[0x053c] = targetWarp;
    ram[0x00c5] |= 0x20;
    ram[0x00f0] = 23;

    for (let w = 0; w < 300; w++) {
      stepFrames(2);
      if (
        ram[0x001c] === 0x00 &&
        ram[0x053b] === targetWarp &&
        (ram[0x00c5] & 0x20) === 0 &&
        ram[0x00a1] === 0 &&
        ram[0x001a] === 0 &&
        (ram[0x0066] & 0x1f) === 0 &&
        (ram[0x0021] & 0x01) !== 0
      ) {
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Match BitgeistArena.tsx post-warp console flags
  ram[0x0048] = 0x01;
  ram[0x0506] = 0x00;
  ram[0x0507] = 0x00;
  if (targetLevel === 0) {
    ram[0x0065] &= ~0x40;
  } else if (targetLevel === 2) {
    ram[0x054a] = targetWarp >= 73 ? 0x03 : 0x01;
  }
  stepFrames(4);
  return saveCoreStateBytes(core.mod);
}

function coldBootGenericNesGameplayAndSaveState(core, gameKind, targetStage = 0) {
  setJoypadMask(0);
  const ram = getRamView(core);
  core.mod._cmd_reset();
  stepFrames(20);

  if (gameKind === 'nova') {
    // Nova the Squirrel: Title (START) -> MainMenu (A) -> LevelSelect (A) -> PreLevel (ram[14]=0, A) -> Gameplay
    stepFrames(35);
    setJoypadMask(0x10); // START on Title Screen
    stepFrames(4);
    setJoypadMask(0);
    stepFrames(24);

    setJoypadMask(0x80); // A on Main Menu ("Start the game!")
    stepFrames(4);
    setJoypadMask(0);
    stepFrames(28);

    setJoypadMask(0x80); // A on Level Select (selects 1-1)
    stepFrames(4);
    setJoypadMask(0);
    stepFrames(28);

    // On Pre-Level Screen, Cursor lives at ZP $0E (3 = "Show Intro" if uncleared; 0 = "Start!")
    ram[0x0e] = 0;
    stepFrames(2);
    setJoypadMask(0x80); // A on "Start!"
    stepFrames(4);
    setJoypadMask(0);

    for (let iter = 0; iter < 240; iter++) {
      stepFrames(2);
      if (ram[0x3d] === 0xf0 && ram[0x4b] > 0) {
        break;
      }
    }

    // Native Zero-Page level warp ($A7 = LevelNumber, $A8 = StartedLevelNumber, $A9 = NeedLevelReload)
    if (targetStage > 0 && ram[0x3d] === 0xf0) {
      ram[0xa7] = targetStage;
      ram[0xa8] = targetStage;
      ram[0xa9] = 1;
      for (let w = 0; w < 180; w++) {
        stepFrames(2);
        if (ram[0xa9] === 0 && ram[0xa7] === targetStage && ram[0x3d] === 0xf0 && ram[0x4b] > 0) {
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    stepFrames(8);
    return saveCoreStateBytes(core.mod);
  }

  // Generic pulse START twice
  stepFrames(28);
  setJoypadMask(0x10);
  stepFrames(5);
  setJoypadMask(0);
  stepFrames(24);
  setJoypadMask(0x10);
  stepFrames(5);
  setJoypadMask(0);
  stepFrames(18);
  return saveCoreStateBytes(core.mod);
}

function fixed12_4ToPixels(raw16) {
  return raw16 >= 0xe000 ? (raw16 << 16) >> 20 : raw16 >> 4;
}

function extractHeadlessTelemetry(ram, job, prevCamX, prevCamY, hadGameplay) {
  if (job.gameKind === 'celeste') {
    const gamemode = ram[0x001c];
    const gamestate = ram[0x0021];
    const gamectrl3 = ram[0x0066];
    const playerctrl = ram[0x00c5];
    const currroom = ram[0x053b];
    const camRaw16 = (ram[0x0067] << 8) | ram[0x00cc];
    const cameraX =
      camRaw16 >= 0x3800 && camRaw16 < 0x8000 ? Math.max(0, camRaw16 - 0x4000) : prevCamX;

    const warpYMap = job.warpYMap || {};
    const mappedRelY = warpYMap[currroom];
    const roomRelY = typeof mappedRelY === 'number' ? mappedRelY : prevCamY;
    let cameraY = roomRelY;
    if ((gamectrl3 & 0x02) !== 0) {
      const ntRowHead2 = ram[0x007a];
      const rowsRem = ntRowHead2 >= 0x80 ? 0 : Math.min(30, ntRowHead2 + 1);
      cameraY = roomRelY + rowsRem * 8;
    }

    const screenX = ram[0x004b];
    const rawScreenY = ram[0x004c];
    const screenFeetY = Math.max(16, Math.min(248, Math.round((rawScreenY || 168) + 16)));
    const playerWorldX = cameraX + screenX;
    const playerWorldY = cameraY + screenFeetY;
    const isDying = (playerctrl & 0x20) !== 0 || (gamectrl3 & 0x10) !== 0;
    const inGameplay = gamemode === 0x00 && (gamestate & 0x01) !== 0 && !isDying;
    const isDead = hadGameplay && gamemode === 0x00 && isDying;
    const goalWarps = job.goalWarps || [];
    const hitGoalWarp = goalWarps.length > 0 && goalWarps.includes(currroom);
    const reachedGoal = inGameplay && (hitGoalWarp || playerWorldX >= job.goalWorldX);
    return { inGameplay, playerWorldX, playerWorldY, cameraX, cameraY, isDead, reachedGoal };
  }

  if (job.gameKind === 'nova') {
    const enemyRightEdge = ram[0x3d];
    const health = ram[0x4b];
    const inGameplay = enemyRightEdge === 0xf0 && health > 0;
    const cameraSub = ram[0x1f] | (ram[0x20] << 8);
    const playerXSub = ram[0x25] | (ram[0x26] << 8);
    const playerYSub = (ram[0x27] << 8) | ram[0x28];
    const cameraX = Math.max(0, fixed12_4ToPixels(cameraSub));
    const playerWorldX = Math.max(0, fixed12_4ToPixels(playerXSub));
    const playerWorldY = fixed12_4ToPixels(playerYSub);
    const isDead =
      hadGameplay && enemyRightEdge === 0xf0 && (playerWorldY > 246 || health === 0);
    const reachedGoal = inGameplay && playerWorldX >= job.goalWorldX;
    return { inGameplay, playerWorldX, playerWorldY, cameraX, cameraY: 0, isDead, reachedGoal };
  }

  return {
    inGameplay: false,
    playerWorldX: 0,
    playerWorldY: 180,
    cameraX: 0,
    cameraY: 0,
    isDead: false,
    reachedGoal: false,
  };
}

export async function runVerificationJob(job) {
  const t0 = realPerfNow();
  const core = await ensureCoreBootedForRom(job.coreJsPath, job.coreWasmPath, job.romPath);

  let startStateBytes = null;
  if (job.canonicalStatePath && fs.existsSync(job.canonicalStatePath)) {
    startStateBytes = new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync(job.canonicalStatePath));
  } else {
    if (job.gameKind === 'celeste') {
      startStateBytes = coldBootCelesteRoomAndSaveState(
        core,
        job.worldIndex ?? 1,
        job.startWarp ?? 0
      );
    } else {
      startStateBytes = coldBootGenericNesGameplayAndSaveState(
        core,
        job.gameKind,
        job.stageIndex ?? 0
      );
    }
    if (job.canonicalStatePath && startStateBytes) {
      try {
        fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(job.canonicalStatePath), { recursive: true });
        fs.writeFileSync(job.canonicalStatePath, startStateBytes);
      } catch {
        // non-fatal cache write failure
      }
    }
  }

  setJoypadMask(0);
  loadCoreStateBytes(core.mod, startStateBytes);

  const ram = getRamView(core);
  const masks = job.frameMasks;
  const maxFrames = Math.min(36_000, masks.length + 24);

  let prevCamX = 0;
  let prevCamY = 0;
  let hadGameplay = false;
  const keyframes = [];
  let died = false;
  let goalFrame = null;

  for (let f = 0; f < maxFrames; f++) {
    const mask = f < masks.length ? masks[f] : 0;
    setJoypadMask(mask);
    stepFrames(1);

    const t = extractHeadlessTelemetry(ram, job, prevCamX, prevCamY, hadGameplay);
    if (t.inGameplay) {
      hadGameplay = true;
      prevCamX = t.cameraX;
      prevCamY = t.cameraY;
      if (f % 3 === 0) {
        keyframes.push([f, t.playerWorldX, t.playerWorldY]);
      }
    }

    if (t.isDead && f > 12) {
      died = true;
      break;
    }

    if (t.reachedGoal && f > 30) {
      goalFrame = f + 1;
      const last = keyframes[keyframes.length - 1];
      if (!last || last[0] !== f) {
        keyframes.push([f, t.playerWorldX, t.playerWorldY]);
      }
      break;
    }
  }

  setJoypadMask(0);
  const elapsedCpuMs = Math.round((realPerfNow() - t0) * 100) / 100;

  if (goalFrame === null) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reachedGoal: false,
      died,
      elapsedCpuMs,
      reason: died
        ? 'Headless WASM replay died before reaching finish gate'
        : 'Headless WASM replay did not reach finish gate',
    };
  }

  const simulatedTimeMs = Math.max(1000, Math.round((goalFrame / 60) * 1000));
  return {
    ok: true,
    reachedGoal: true,
    died: false,
    goalFrame,
    simulatedTimeMs,
    frames: keyframes,
    elapsedCpuMs,
  };
}

if (parentPort) {
  parentPort.on('message', async (msg) => {
    const { id, job } = msg;
    try {
      const result = await runVerificationJob(job);
      parentPort.postMessage({ id, result });
    } catch (err) {
      parentPort.postMessage({
        id,
        error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
      });
    }
  });
}
```

```mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { registerHooks } from 'node:module';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { after, before, describe, it } from 'node:test';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';

const PROJECT_ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');

function tryResolveCandidateFile(basePath) {
  const candidates = [
    basePath,
    `${basePath}.ts`,
    `${basePath}.tsx`,
    `${basePath}.mjs`,
    `${basePath}.js`,
    path.join(basePath, 'index.ts'),
    path.join(basePath, 'index.js'),
  ];
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    try {
      if (fs.existsSync(candidate) && fs.statSync(candidate).isFile()) {
        return pathToFileURL(candidate).href;
      }
    } catch {
      // continue checking candidates
    }
  }
  return null;
}

// Enable seamless extensionless TypeScript & @/* alias resolution under Node 24 --experimental-strip-types
registerHooks({
  resolve(specifier, context, nextResolve) {
    if (specifier === 'next/server') {
      return nextResolve('next/server.js', context);
    }

    if (specifier.startsWith('@/')) {
      const target = path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, specifier.slice(2));
      const found = tryResolveCandidateFile(target);
      if (found) {
        return { url: found, shortCircuit: true };
      }
    }

    if (
      (specifier.startsWith('./') || specifier.startsWith('../')) &&
      context.parentURL?.startsWith('file://') &&
      !path.extname(specifier)
    ) {
      const parentDir = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(context.parentURL));
      const target = path.resolve(parentDir, specifier);
      const found = tryResolveCandidateFile(target);
      if (found) {
        return { url: found, shortCircuit: true };
      }
    }

    return nextResolve(specifier, context);
  },
});

function buildSingleEntryZipBytes(entryName, payloadBytes, useDeflate = false) {
  const nameBytes = Buffer.from(entryName, 'utf8');
  const rawBuf = Buffer.from(payloadBytes);
  const compBuf = useDeflate ? zlib.deflateRawSync(rawBuf) : rawBuf;
  const method = useDeflate ? 8 : 0;

  const localHeader = Buffer.alloc(30 + nameBytes.length);
  localHeader.writeUInt32LE(0x04034b50, 0);
  localHeader.writeUInt16LE(20, 4);
  localHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 6);
  localHeader.writeUInt16LE(method, 8);
  localHeader.writeUInt32LE(0, 14); // crc32 (unchecked by extractor)
  localHeader.writeUInt32LE(compBuf.length, 18);
  localHeader.writeUInt32LE(rawBuf.length, 22);
  localHeader.writeUInt16LE(nameBytes.length, 26);
  localHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 28);
  nameBytes.copy(localHeader, 30);

  const centralOffset = localHeader.length + compBuf.length;
  const centralHeader = Buffer.alloc(46 + nameBytes.length);
  centralHeader.writeUInt32LE(0x02014b50, 0);
  centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(20, 4);
  centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(20, 6);
  centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 8);
  centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(method, 10);
  centralHeader.writeUInt32LE(0, 16);
  centralHeader.writeUInt32LE(compBuf.length, 20);
  centralHeader.writeUInt32LE(rawBuf.length, 24);
  centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(nameBytes.length, 28);
  centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 30);
  centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 32);
  centralHeader.writeUInt32LE(0, 42); // local header offset = 0
  nameBytes.copy(centralHeader, 46);

  const eocd = Buffer.alloc(22);
  eocd.writeUInt32LE(0x06054b50, 0);
  eocd.writeUInt16LE(1, 8);
  eocd.writeUInt16LE(1, 10);
  eocd.writeUInt32LE(centralHeader.length, 12);
  eocd.writeUInt32LE(centralOffset, 16);

  return new Uint8Array(Buffer.concat([localHeader, compBuf, centralHeader, eocd]));
}

  before(() => {
    rateLimitMod.resetRateLimitBucketsForTests();
  });

  it('enforces per-IP sliding-window API rate limits and recovers after window expiry', () => {
    const key = 'ghosts:198.51.100.42';
    const windowMs = 10_000;
    const t0 = 1_000_000;

    const r1 = rateLimitMod.checkSlidingWindowRateLimit({
      key,
      maxRequests: 2,
      windowMs,
      nowMs: t0,
    });
    assert.equal(r1.allowed, true);
    assert.equal(r1.remaining, 1);

    const r2 = rateLimitMod.checkSlidingWindowRateLimit({
      key,
      maxRequests: 2,
      windowMs,
      nowMs: t0 + 500,
    });
    assert.equal(r2.allowed, true);
    assert.equal(r2.remaining, 0);

    const blocked = rateLimitMod.checkSlidingWindowRateLimit({
      key,
      maxRequests: 2,
      windowMs,
      nowMs: t0 + 1000,
    });
    assert.equal(blocked.allowed, false);
    assert.ok(blocked.retryAfterSec >= 1);

    const recovered = rateLimitMod.checkSlidingWindowRateLimit({
      key,
      maxRequests: 2,
      windowMs,
      nowMs: t0 + windowMs + 1,
    });
    assert.equal(recovered.allowed, true);
  });

  it('claims zero-signup arcade tags, prevents impersonation, tracks streaks, and verifies BG1 claim keys', () => {
    const ownerA = 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa';
    const ownerB = 'bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb';

    // Owner A claims @SPEEDY on Daily #43
    const claimA = identityMod.resolveTagForSubmission({
      ownerId: ownerA,
      requestedTag: 'speedy',
      dailyNumber: 43,
    });
    assert.equal(claimA.assignedTag, 'SPEEDY');
    assert.equal(claimA.tagConflict, undefined);
    assert.equal(claimA.identity.claimed, true);
    assert.equal(claimA.identity.ownedBySession, true);
    assert.equal(claimA.identity.streakCount, 1);

    // Owner A completes consecutive Daily #44 -> streak increments to 2
    const streakA = identityMod.resolveTagForSubmission({
      ownerId: ownerA,
      requestedTag: 'SPEEDY',
      dailyNumber: 44,
    });
    assert.equal(streakA.assignedTag, 'SPEEDY');
    assert.equal(streakA.identity.streakCount, 2);

    // Owner B attempting @SPEEDY receives collision-free fallback @SPEEDY_2
    const conflictB = identityMod.resolveTagForSubmission({
      ownerId: ownerB,
      requestedTag: 'SPEEDY',
      dailyNumber: 44,
    });
    assert.equal(conflictB.assignedTag, 'SPEEDY_2');
    assert.ok(conflictB.tagConflict);
    assert.equal(conflictB.tagConflict.requestedTag, 'SPEEDY');

    // Built-in #1 champion bot @ALEX is protected against impersonation
    const botAttempt = identityMod.resolveTagForSubmission({
      ownerId: ownerB,
      requestedTag: 'ALEX',
    });
    assert.equal(botAttempt.assignedTag, 'ALEX_2');
    assert.ok(botAttempt.tagConflict);

    // Multi-device BG1 backup claim key round-trips and rejects tampering
    const backupKey = identityMod.buildBackupClaimKey(ownerA);
    assert.match(backupKey, /^BG1-[A-F0-9]{32}-[A-F0-9]{10}$/);
    assert.equal(identityMod.verifyBackupClaimKey(backupKey), ownerA);
    const tampered = `${backupKey.slice(0, -1)}${backupKey.endsWith('A') ? 'B' : 'A'}`;
    assert.equal(identityMod.verifyBackupClaimKey(tampered), null);
  });

    const cleanRes = romVaultMod.inspectNesRomBytes(cleanRom);
    assert.equal(cleanRes.valid, true);
    assert.equal(cleanRes.mapper, 4);
    assert.equal(cleanRes.isNes2, false);
    assert.equal(cleanRes.dirtyHeaderCleaned, false);

    // 2. Valid NES 2.0 Extended Mapper (Submapper 2, Mapper 0x104 = 260)
    const nes2Rom = new Uint8Array(16 + 16_384);
    nes2Rom.set([0x4e, 0x45, 0x53, 0x1a, 1, 0, 0x40, 0x08, 0x21, 0x00], 0);
    const nes2Res = romVaultMod.inspectNesRomBytes(nes2Rom);
    assert.equal(nes2Res.valid, true);
    assert.equal(nes2Res.isNes2, true);
    assert.equal(nes2Res.mapper, 0x104);
    assert.equal(nes2Res.submapper, 2);

    // 3. Dirty "DiskDude!" iNES header polluting flags7..15 (would mis-detect NROM Mapper 0 as Mapper 64!)
    const dirtyRom = new Uint8Array(16 + 16_384);
    dirtyRom.set([0x4e, 0x45, 0x53, 0x1a, 1, 0, 0x01], 0);
    Buffer.from('DiskDude!').copy(dirtyRom, 7);
    const dirtyRes = romVaultMod.inspectNesRomBytes(dirtyRom);
    assert.equal(dirtyRes.valid, true);
    assert.equal(dirtyRes.dirtyHeaderCleaned, true);
    assert.equal(dirtyRes.mapper, 0);
    assert.equal(dirtyRes.sanitizedBytes[7], 0);
    assert.equal(dirtyRes.sanitizedBytes[15], 0);

    // 4. Truncated .NES file (claims 2x16KB = 32KB PRG, only 8KB body present)
    const truncated = new Uint8Array(16 + 8_192);
    truncated.set([0x4e, 0x45, 0x53, 0x1a, 2, 0, 0x00, 0x00], 0);
    const truncRes = romVaultMod.inspectNesRomBytes(truncated);
    assert.equal(truncRes.valid, false);
    assert.match(truncRes.error || '', /Truncated or corrupt \.NES/i);

    // 5. FDS and UNIF clear user-facing errors
    const fdsBytes = new Uint8Array(64);
    fdsBytes.set([0x46, 0x44, 0x53, 0x1a], 0);
    assert.match(romVaultMod.inspectNesRomBytes(fdsBytes).error || '', /Famicom Disk System/i);

    const unifBytes = new Uint8Array(64);
    unifBytes.set([0x55, 0x4e, 0x49, 0x46], 0);
    assert.match(romVaultMod.inspectNesRomBytes(unifBytes).error || '', /UNIF/i);
  });

  it('extracts Stored and Deflated .NES cartridges from .ZIP archives in-memory', async () => {
    const sampleNes = new Uint8Array(16 + 16_384);
    sampleNes.set([0x4e, 0x45, 0x53, 0x1a, 1, 0, 0x00, 0x00], 0);
    for (let i = 16; i < sampleNes.length; i++) {
      sampleNes[i] = (i * 31) & 0xff;
    }

    const storedZip = buildSingleEntryZipBytes('folder/homebrew_test.nes', sampleNes, false);
    const storedOut = await romVaultMod.extractRomFromZipBytes(storedZip);
    assert.equal(storedOut.fileName, 'homebrew_test.nes');
    assert.deepEqual(storedOut.bytes, sampleNes);

    const deflatedZip = buildSingleEntryZipBytes('nested/deflated_cart.nes', sampleNes, true);
    const deflatedOut = await romVaultMod.extractRomFromZipBytes(deflatedZip);
    assert.equal(deflatedOut.fileName, 'deflated_cart.nes');
    assert.deepEqual(deflatedOut.bytes, sampleNes);
  });

  it('auto-detects non-$0200 NES OAM shadow pages ($0700) and advances universal NES sprint progress', () => {
    const customId = '1111111111111111111111111111111111111111';
    const profile = romProfilesMod.applyCustomSprintBounds(
      romProfilesMod.resolveRomProfile(customId, 'micro_homebrew.nes'),
      { startWorldX: 48, goalWorldX: 240 }
    );
    assert.equal(profile.consoleSystem, 'nes');
    assert.equal(profile.profileKind, 'universal-oam');
    assert.equal(profile.goalWorldX, 240);

    // Populate $0200 with non-OAM state variables, while $0700 holds authentic 64-sprite OAM DMA buffer
    const ram = new Uint8Array(0x800);
    for (let i = 0x0200; i < 0x0300; i++) {
      ram[i] = (i * 17) & 0x7f; // zero hidden-sprite markers -> not an OAM page
    }
    for (let s = 0; s < 64; s++) {
      ram[0x0700 + s * 4] = 0xf8; // PPU hardware hidden sprite Y >= $EF
    }
    // Sprite 0 HUD hit at Y=24, X=8; Sprite 1 Player at Y=160, Tile=0x12, Attr=0x00, X=120
    ram[0x0700] = 24;
    ram[0x0703] = 8;
    ram[0x0704] = 160;
    ram[0x0705] = 0x12;
    ram[0x0706] = 0x00;
    ram[0x0707] = 120;

    const tracker = typesMod.createInitialTrackerState();
    let reached = false;
    for (let f = 0; f < 120; f++) {
      ram[0x0705] = 0x12 + (f & 1); // animate walk tile
      const frame = profile.extractTelemetry(
        ram,
        tracker,
        inputReplayMod.NES_INPUT_RIGHT | inputReplayMod.NES_INPUT_B
      );
      tracker.hadGameplay = tracker.hadGameplay || frame.inGameplay;
      tracker.cameraX = frame.cameraX;
      tracker.oamX = 120;
      tracker.oamTile = frame.oamTile ?? tracker.oamTile;
      if (frame.reachedGoal) {
        reached = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    assert.equal(reached, true, 'Universal NES profile should reach goalWorldX using $0700 OAM shadow page');
  });

  it('gates inGameplay=false across loading screens, title menus, and story cutscenes for all game profiles', () => {
    // 1. Celeste NES: Title, Overworld, Prologue Story Card, and Initial Fade/Load stay false
    const celeste = romProfilesMod.createCelesteCourseProfile({ courseIndex: 0 });
    const celesteRam = new Uint8Array(0x800);
    const celesteTracker = typesMod.createInitialTrackerState();
    celesteRam[0x001c] = 0x01; // gm_title
    celesteRam[0x0021] = 0x01;
    assert.equal(celeste.extractTelemetry(celesteRam, celesteTracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    celesteRam[0x001c] = 0x04; // gm_prologue story card
    assert.equal(celeste.extractTelemetry(celesteRam, celesteTracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    celesteRam[0x001c] = 0x00; // gm_game, but still fading in ($0031 != 0)
    celesteRam[0x0031] = 0x04;
    assert.equal(celeste.extractTelemetry(celesteRam, celesteTracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    celesteRam[0x0031] = 0x00; // fade complete -> controllable gameplay!
    celesteRam[0x006f] = 24;
    celesteRam[0x0071] = 176;
    assert.equal(celeste.extractTelemetry(celesteRam, celesteTracker, 0).inGameplay, true);

    // 2. Super Mario Bros. 1: Title, "WORLD 1-1" black loading screen ($0772 < 3), and Pipe Auto-Walk Intro ($000E = 0x07)
    const smb1 = romProfilesMod.resolveRomProfile('2222222222222222222222222222222222222222', 'Super Mario Bros. (World).nes');
    const smb1Ram = new Uint8Array(0x800);
    const smb1Tracker = typesMod.createInitialTrackerState();
    smb1Ram[0x0770] = 0x01; // GameModeValue = Gameplay
    smb1Ram[0x0772] = 0x01; // OperMode_Task = "WORLD 1-1 / MARIO x 3" black loading screen!
    smb1Ram[0x0086] = 40;
    smb1Ram[0x00ce] = 176;
    smb1Ram[0x000e] = 0x08;
    assert.equal(smb1.extractTelemetry(smb1Ram, smb1Tracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    smb1Ram[0x0772] = 0x03; // GameCoreRoutine active, but Player_State = 0x07 (pre-level pipe auto-walk intro)
    smb1Ram[0x000e] = 0x07;
    assert.equal(smb1.extractTelemetry(smb1Ram, smb1Tracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    smb1Ram[0x000e] = 0x08; // Normal controllable Mario!
    assert.equal(smb1.extractTelemetry(smb1Ram, smb1Tracker, 0).inGameplay, true);

    // 3. Super Mario Bros. 3: Curtain Title Mario & Luigi story skit and Overworld Map ($05EE..$05F0 = 0,0,0)
    const smb3 = romProfilesMod.resolveRomProfile('3333333333333333333333333333333333333333', 'Super Mario Bros. 3 (USA).nes');
    const smb3Ram = new Uint8Array(0x800);
    const smb3Tracker = typesMod.createInitialTrackerState();
    smb3Ram[0x0090] = 96; // Mario & Luigi running across title curtain skit!
    smb3Ram[0x00a2] = 160;
    assert.equal(smb3.extractTelemetry(smb3Ram, smb3Tracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    smb3Ram[0x05ee] = 3; // Active stage timer 300 -> real stage gameplay!
    assert.equal(smb3.extractTelemetry(smb3Ram, smb3Tracker, 0).inGameplay, true);

    // 4. Mega Man 2 ("READY" beam-down) & Ninja Gaiden (Tecmo Cinema Story Cutscene)
    const mm2 = romProfilesMod.resolveRomProfile('4444444444444444444444444444444444444444', 'Mega Man 2 (USA).nes');
    const mm2Ram = new Uint8Array(0x800);
    const mm2Tracker = typesMod.createInitialTrackerState();
    mm2Ram[0x0400] = 0x01; // "READY" / teleporting beam
    mm2Ram[0x0420] = 0x80; // Active entity flag
    mm2Ram[0x06c0] = 28; // Full Mega Man HP
    mm2Ram[0x0460] = 64;
    mm2Ram[0x04a0] = 160;
    assert.equal(mm2.extractTelemetry(mm2Ram, mm2Tracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    mm2Ram[0x0400] = 0x02; // Materialized & controllable
    assert.equal(mm2.extractTelemetry(mm2Ram, mm2Tracker, 0).inGameplay, true);

    const ng = romProfilesMod.resolveRomProfile('5555555555555555555555555555555555555555', 'Ninja Gaiden (USA).nes');
    const ngRam = new Uint8Array(0x800);
    const ngTracker = typesMod.createInitialTrackerState();
    ngRam[0x0086] = 48;
    ngRam[0x008a] = 160;
    ngRam[0x0065] = 16; // Ryu HP full ($0065), while stage timer $0063/$0064 is 0 during Tecmo Story Cinema!
    assert.equal(ng.extractTelemetry(ngRam, ngTracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    ngRam[0x0063] = 1; // Stage timer active
    assert.equal(ng.extractTelemetry(ngRam, ngTracker, 0).inGameplay, true);

    // 5. Super Mario World (SNES) & Sonic the Hedgehog (Genesis)
    const smw = romProfilesMod.resolveRomProfile(
      '6666666666666666666666666666666666666666',
      'Super Mario World (USA).sfc',
      undefined,
      'snes'
    );
    const smwRam = new Uint8Array(0x20000);
    const smwTracker = typesMod.createInitialTrackerState();
    smwRam[0x0100] = 0x12; // "MARIO START!" black loading card
    smwRam[0x0094] = 32;
    smwRam[0x0096] = 160;
    assert.equal(smw.extractTelemetry(smwRam, smwTracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    smwRam[0x0100] = 0x14;
    smwRam[0x1426] = 0x01; // "Welcome to Dinosaur Land!" intro message box active
    assert.equal(smw.extractTelemetry(smwRam, smwTracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    smwRam[0x1426] = 0x00; // Message dismissed -> controllable gameplay!
    assert.equal(smw.extractTelemetry(smwRam, smwTracker, 0).inGameplay, true);

    const sonic = romProfilesMod.resolveRomProfile(
      '7777777777777777777777777777777777777777',
      'Sonic the Hedgehog (USA, Europe).md',
      undefined,
      'genesis'
    );
    const sonicRam = new Uint8Array(0x10000);
    const sonicTracker = typesMod.createInitialTrackerState();
    sonicRam[0xf600] = 0x00; // SEGA Splash
    assert.equal(sonic.extractTelemetry(sonicRam, sonicTracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    sonicRam[0xf600] = 0x08; // Attract Demo
    sonicRam[0xd008] = 80;
    sonicRam[0xd00c] = 160;
    sonicRam[0xd024] = 0x02;
    assert.equal(sonic.extractTelemetry(sonicRam, sonicTracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    sonicRam[0xf600] = 0x8c; // "GREEN HILL ZONE ACT 1" title card overlay
    assert.equal(sonic.extractTelemetry(sonicRam, sonicTracker, 0).inGameplay, false);
    sonicRam[0xf600] = 0x0c; // Active level without title card!
    assert.equal(sonic.extractTelemetry(sonicRam, sonicTracker, 0).inGameplay, true);

    // 6. Universal NES OAM: Blank loading screens & autonomous story cutscenes stay inGameplay=false
    const uniNes = romProfilesMod.resolveRomProfile('8888888888888888888888888888888888888888', 'unknown_story_game.nes');
    const uniRam = new Uint8Array(0x800);
    for (let s = 0; s < 64; s++) {
      uniRam[0x0200 + s * 4] = 0xf8; // All 64 sprites hidden (blank loading / text story card)
    }
    const uniTracker = typesMod.createInitialTrackerState();
    assert.equal(uniNes.extractTelemetry(uniRam, uniTracker, inputReplayMod.NES_INPUT_RIGHT).inGameplay, false);

    // Autonomous story cutscene sprite moving across screen with ZERO player input stays false
    uniRam[0x0204] = 160;
    uniRam[0x0205] = 0x20;
    uniRam[0x0206] = 0x00;
    for (let f = 0; f < 10; f++) {
      uniRam[0x0207] = 40 + f * 2;
      const out = uniNes.extractTelemetry(uniRam, uniTracker, 0);
      assert.equal(out.inGameplay, false, 'Autonomous story cutscene sprite must not trigger inGameplay');
    }

    // Causal player-driven movement (Right held while sprite responds for >= 3 frames) unlocks gameplay
    let unlocked = false;
    for (let f = 0; f < 5; f++) {
      uniRam[0x0207] = 64 + f * 2;
      const out = uniNes.extractTelemetry(uniRam, uniTracker, inputReplayMod.NES_INPUT_RIGHT);
      if (out.inGameplay) {
        unlocked = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    assert.equal(unlocked, true);

    // 7. Universal Multi-Console WRAM: Bulk loading decompression & pre-Start intro never advance playerWorldX
    const uniSnes = romProfilesMod.resolveRomProfile(
      '9999999999999999999999999999999999999999',
      'unknown_adventure.sfc',
      undefined,
      'snes'
    );
    const uniSnesRam = new Uint8Array(0x20000);
    const uniSnesTracker = typesMod.createInitialTrackerState();
    for (let f = 0; f < 10; f++) {
      const out = uniSnes.extractTelemetry(uniSnesRam, uniSnesTracker, inputReplayMod.NES_INPUT_RIGHT);
      assert.equal(out.inGameplay, false);
      assert.equal(out.playerWorldX, uniSnes.startWorldX);
    }
    // Press Start to pass Title Screen, let WRAM settle, then hold Right in gameplay
    uniSnes.extractTelemetry(uniSnesRam, uniSnesTracker, inputReplayMod.NES_INPUT_START);
    let snesUnlocked = false;
    for (let f = 0; f < 16; f++) {
      const out = uniSnes.extractTelemetry(uniSnesRam, uniSnesTracker, inputReplayMod.NES_INPUT_RIGHT);
      if (out.inGameplay) {
        snesUnlocked = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    assert.equal(snesUnlocked, true);

    // Simulate mid-game bulk WRAM level-load decompression (>= 22/64 distributed WRAM samples rewritten) -> drops inGameplay=false!
    for (let i = 0; i < uniSnesRam.length; i += 256) {
      uniSnesRam[i] = (uniSnesRam[i] + 0x5a + (i & 0x7f)) & 0xff;
    }
    const duringLoad = uniSnes.extractTelemetry(uniSnesRam, uniSnesTracker, inputReplayMod.NES_INPUT_RIGHT);
    assert.equal(duringLoad.inGameplay, false);
  });

  it('computes Stage 6 & 7 Gold/Mint/Coral sector and 3-room relay splits accurately', () => {
    const playerFrames = [
      [0, 32, 176],
      [180, 480, 176],
      [360, 920, 176],
      [540, 1264, 176],
    ];
    const rivalFrames = [
      [0, 32, 176],
      [210, 480, 176],
      [390, 920, 176],
      [600, 1264, 176],
    ];

    const sectorSplits = splitTrackerMod.computeRunSplitEntries({
      startWorldX: 32,

      targetGhost: {
        id: 'rival-1',
        slug: 'rival-1',
        tag: 'RIVAL',
        romId: romProfilesMod.CELESTE_ROM_ID,
        consoleSystem: 'nes',
        sprintId: `${romProfilesMod.CELESTE_ROM_ID}:c0`,
        romTitle: 'CELESTE 1-A',
        timeMs: 10_000,
        beatenCount: 1,
        totalGhosts: 10,
        emojiReceipt: '⚡🏁',
        frames: rivalFrames,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    });
    assert.equal(sectorSplits.length, 3);
    assert.equal(sectorSplits[0].label, 'S1 • 33%');
    assert.equal(sectorSplits[2].label, 'FINISH');
    assert.equal(sectorSplits[2].status, 'gold');
    assert.equal(sectorSplits[2].deltaVsRivalMs, -1_000);

    const relaySplits = splitTrackerMod.computeRunSplitEntries({
      startWorldX: 32,
      goalWorldX: 1264,
      runnerFrames: playerFrames,
      runnerTimeMs: 31_200,
      relayLegTimesMs: [10_100, 10_400, 10_700],
    });
    assert.equal(relaySplits.length, 3);
    assert.equal(relaySplits[0].label, 'LEG 1');
    assert.equal(relaySplits[0].runnerMs, 10_100);
    assert.equal(relaySplits[2].label, 'LEG 3');
    assert.equal(relaySplits[2].runnerMs, 31_200);
  });

  it('applies Stage 9 IPS and BPS ROM patches in-memory without mutating base ROMs', () => {
    const baseRom = new Uint8Array([0x4e, 0x45, 0x53, 0x1a, 0x10, 0x20, 0x30, 0x40, 0x50, 0x60]);

    // Build an IPS patch: overwrite offset 4 with [0xaa, 0xbb] and RLE fill offset 6 with 3x 0xff
    const ipsPatch = new Uint8Array([
      0x50, 0x41, 0x54, 0x43, 0x48, // "PATCH"
      0x00, 0x00, 0x04, // offset 4
      0x00, 0x02, // size 2
      0xaa, 0xbb,
      0x00, 0x00, 0x06, // offset 6
      0x00, 0x00, // RLE marker
      0x00, 0x03, // RLE count 3
      0xff, // RLE byte
      0x45, 0x4f, 0x46, // "EOF"
    ]);
    assert.equal(romPatcherMod.detectRomPatchFormat('kaizo.ips', ipsPatch), 'ips');
    const ipsOut = romPatcherMod.applyIpsPatch(baseRom, ipsPatch);
    assert.deepEqual(
      Array.from(ipsOut),
      [0x4e, 0x45, 0x53, 0x1a, 0xaa, 0xbb, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0x60]
    );
    // Base ROM remains untouched
    assert.equal(baseRom[4], 0x10);
  });

  it('tracks Stage 7 Head-to-Head Rivalry Series scores and Stage 9 Community Segments in SQLite', async () => {
    const sprintId = `${romProfilesMod.CELESTE_ROM_ID}:c2`;
    const sampleFrames = [
      [0, 32, 176],
      [300, 1264, 160],
    ];

    const dare1 = await ghostStoreMod.saveGhostRun({
      tag: 'ALPHA',
      romId: romProfilesMod.CELESTE_ROM_ID,
      consoleSystem: 'nes',
      sprintId,
      romTitle: 'CELESTE 1-C • RIDGE DASH',
      timeMs: 13_500,
      beatenCount: 1,
      totalGhosts: 5,
      emojiReceipt: '⚡⚡🏁',
      frames: sampleFrames,
    });

    await ghostStoreMod.saveGhostRun({
      tag: 'BRAVO',
      romId: romProfilesMod.CELESTE_ROM_ID,
      consoleSystem: 'nes',
      sprintId,
      romTitle: 'CELESTE 1-C • RIDGE DASH',
      timeMs: 12_900,
      beatenCount: 2,
      totalGhosts: 5,
      emojiReceipt: '⚡⚡⚡🏁',
      frames: sampleFrames,
      parentSlug: dare1.slug,
    });

    const series = ghostStoreMod.getRivalrySeriesSummary(sprintId, 'BRAVO', 'ALPHA', dare1.slug);
    assert.ok(series);
    assert.equal(series.playerWins, 1);
    assert.equal(series.rivalWins, 0);
    assert.equal(series.totalBouts, 1);
    assert.equal(series.parentSlug, dare1.slug);

    // Stage 9 Community Segment directory
    const segs = ghostStoreMod.upsertCommunitySegment({
      id: 'deadbeef:custom-1',
      sprintId: 'deadbeef:custom-1',
      romId: 'deadbeef',
      code: 'S1',
      name: 'BOSS RUSH SPLIT',
      startWorldX: 128,
      goalWorldX: 1024,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    });
    assert.equal(segs.length, 1);
    const list = ghostStoreMod.listCommunitySegmentsForRom('deadbeef');
    assert.equal(list.length, 1);
    assert.equal(list[0].name, 'BOSS RUSH SPLIT');
    assert.equal(list[0].startWorldX, 128);
    assert.equal(list[0].goalWorldX, 1024);
  });

  it('evaluates Stage 12 4-Tier Room Medals (DEV, GOLD, SILVER, BRONZE) and Mountain King Standings', () => {
    const devMedal = dailySprintsMod.evaluateRoomMedal(17_200, 17_500);
    assert.equal(devMedal.tier, 'dev');
    assert.equal(devMedal.emoji, '💎');
    assert.equal(devMedal.nextTier, undefined);
    assert.equal(devMedal.msToNext, undefined);

    const goldMedal = dailySprintsMod.evaluateRoomMedal(18_400, 17_500);
    assert.equal(goldMedal.tier, 'gold');
    assert.equal(goldMedal.emoji, '🥇');
    assert.equal(goldMedal.nextTier, 'dev');
    assert.equal(goldMedal.msToNext, 900);

    const silverMedal = dailySprintsMod.evaluateRoomMedal(19_800, 17_500);
    assert.equal(silverMedal.tier, 'silver');
    assert.equal(silverMedal.emoji, '🥈');
    assert.equal(silverMedal.nextTier, 'gold');

    const bronzeMedal = dailySprintsMod.evaluateRoomMedal(24_000, 17_500);
    assert.equal(bronzeMedal.tier, 'bronze');
    assert.equal(bronzeMedal.emoji, '🥉');
    assert.equal(bronzeMedal.nextTier, 'silver');

    const standings = ghostStoreMod.getMountainStandings(romProfilesMod.CELESTE_ROM_ID);
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(standings));
    assert.ok(standings.length >= 3);
    assert.ok(standings[0].roomsCleared >= 1);
    assert.ok(standings[0].totalTimeMs >= 1000);
  });
});
```

`types/node-sqlite.d.ts`:

```ts
declare module 'node:sqlite' {
  export type SQLInputValue = null | number | bigint | string | Uint8Array;

  export interface StatementResultingChanges {
    changes: number | bigint;
    lastInsertRowid: number | bigint;
  }

  export class StatementSync {
    all(...params: SQLInputValue[]): Record<string, unknown>[];
    get(...params: SQLInputValue[]): Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    run(...params: SQLInputValue[]): StatementResultingChanges;
  }

  export interface DatabaseSyncOptions {
    open?: boolean;
    readOnly?: boolean;
    enableForeignKeyConstraints?: boolean;
  }

  export class DatabaseSync {
    constructor(location: string, options?: DatabaseSyncOptions);
    close(): void;
    exec(sql: string): void;
    prepare(sql: string): StatementSync;
  }
}
```
